description.en: When investigating how AI describes a brand, compare mention frequency and sentiment with competitors and review the sources behind the answers.
description.zh: 调查 AI 如何描述品牌时，对比自有品牌与竞品的提及频率和情绪，并复查回答背后的来源。

summary.en: Compare brand portrayal, sentiment and influential sources.
summary.zh: 比较品牌呈现、情绪及影响来源。

label.en: Brandlight visibility, sentiment and citation analysis
label.zh: Brandlight 曝光、情绪与引用分析

label.en: Brandlight official product and sales access
label.zh: Brandlight 官方产品与销售入口

label.en: Brandlight enterprise orders, fees and usage limits
label.zh: Brandlight 企业订单、费用与使用限制

description.en: Pricing is provided through a sales agreement or tailored package. No fixed public amount for this feature was verified; confirm the monitoring scope, required integrations and contract term in the quote.
description.zh: 费用通过销售协议或定制方案确定。本轮未核实到该功能的固定公开金额，需在报价中确认监测范围、必要集成和合同期限。

summary.en: Enterprise quote; confirm engines, scope and term.
summary.zh: 企业询价，确认引擎、范围与合同期限。

description.en: Enterprise access is arranged through sales; confirm the required engines and usage limits in the order.
description.zh: 企业服务需联系销售；所需引擎与使用限制应在订单中确认。

summary.en: Engine access and usage limits must be confirmed in the order.
summary.zh: 引擎权限与用量限制需在订单确认。

description.en: Compare query intent, sentiment and influential-source analysis for the brand task you need. Ask sales to scope engines and limits instead of assuming every enterprise engagement includes the same coverage.
description.zh: 按品牌任务比较查询意图、情绪和影响来源分析。应要求销售明确引擎与额度，不假设每次企业合作都包含相同覆盖。

description.en: Monitor brand mentions, cited sources and competitors across AI search engines.
description.zh: 监测品牌在 AI 搜索中的提及、引用来源与竞品表现。

en: Track brand visibility and cited sources across selected prompts and compare competitors.
Discover relevant questions with Prompt Universe and review content and technical recommendations.
zh: 按选定提示词追踪品牌曝光与引用来源，并对比竞品。
通过 Prompt Universe 发现相关问题，查看内容与技术改进建议。

audience.en: Marketing teams researching and monitoring brand discovery in AI answers.
audience.zh: 需要研究并持续监测 AI 回答中品牌发现表现的营销团队。

description.en: When choosing questions to monitor, use Prompt Universe to explore related questions and review their visibility, citations and improvement suggestions.
description.zh: 选择监测问题时，通过 Prompt Universe 发现相关问题，再查看其曝光、引用与改进建议。

summary.en: Find questions with Prompt Universe; review citations and gaps.
summary.zh: 通过 Prompt Universe 研究问题、引用及缺口。

label.zh: Searchable 方案与引擎附加项

description.en: The annual pricing display shows Pro at $125/month, Scale at $400/month and Enterprise at $999/month. Three models are included; additional models are separately selectable. These are annual-billing rates.
description.zh: 年付显示 Pro 折算 $125/月、Scale $400/月、Enterprise $999/月。包含 3 个模型，额外模型需另选；这些金额采用年付口径。

summary.en: Annual rates: Pro $125/month, Scale $400, Enterprise $999; three included models.
summary.zh: 年付折算：Pro $125/月、Scale $400、Enterprise $999；包含 3 模型。

description.en: Paid plans include ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity; additional engines require paid add-ons.
description.zh: 付费方案包含 ChatGPT、Google AI Overviews 和 Perplexity；更多引擎需另购附加项。

summary.en: ChatGPT, AI Overviews, Perplexity included; extra engines paid.
summary.zh: 含 ChatGPT、AI Overviews、Perplexity；额外引擎另购。

description.en: Compare included versus additional models and the scope of Prompt Universe research. The annual Pro price is not an all-engine monthly plan, so build the comparison around the engines actually required.
description.zh: 重点比较所含与另购模型，以及 Prompt Universe 的研究范围。年付 Pro 价格不是包含所有引擎的月付方案，应按实际需要的平台组合选型。

description.en: Track custom questions, brand mentions and competitors in AI-generated answers.
description.zh: 追踪自定义问题在 AI 回答中的品牌提及与竞品表现。

en: Define the exact questions to monitor and follow changes in AI answers over time.
Organize questions by language and location, track brand aliases and compare competitors and cited sources.
zh: 定义需要监测的具体问题，持续跟踪 AI 回答变化。
按语言与地区组织问题，跟踪品牌别名，对比竞品和引用来源。

audience.en: SEO and brand teams monitoring a defined set of customer questions.
audience.zh: 需要持续监测特定客户问题的 SEO 与品牌团队。

description.en: For a multilingual market review, define specific questions by language and region and follow how answers mention brand aliases and competitors over time.
description.zh: 开展多语言市场复盘时，按语言和地区设定具体问题，持续观察回答如何提及品牌别名与竞品。

summary.en: Track defined questions across languages and regions.
summary.zh: 按语言和地区持续追踪指定问题。

description.en: Starter is USD 59/month and Growth USD 199/month; Enterprise is custom-priced. The official page also offers annual billing, which should be checked separately from the displayed monthly price.
description.zh: Starter 为 59 美元/月，Growth 为 199 美元/月，Enterprise 定制报价。官方另提供年付，应与所示月度价格分别核对。

summary.en: Starter USD 59/month; Growth USD 199; Enterprise quoted. Annual option separate.
summary.zh: Starter 59 美元/月、Growth 199 美元；企业版询价，年付另选。

description.en: Starter covers ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews and AI Mode; broader engine coverage requires higher paid plans.
description.zh: Starter 覆盖 ChatGPT、Google AI Overviews 和 AI Mode；更多引擎需较高档付费方案。

summary.en: Starter: ChatGPT, AI Overviews, AI Mode; more engines need higher tiers.
summary.zh: Starter 含 ChatGPT、AI Overviews、AI Mode；更多引擎需升档。

description.en: For teams with known questions in several languages or regions, compare question definition and brand-alias handling. Broader engine access may require Growth or Enterprise rather than Starter.
description.zh: 已有跨语言或地区问题集合的团队，应比较问题定义与品牌别名处理能力。更广的引擎访问可能需要 Growth 或 Enterprise，而非 Starter。

description.en: Compare brand mentions and citations with competitors on the same AI search prompts.
description.zh: 在相同 AI 搜索提示词下对比品牌与竞品的提及和引用表现。

en: Compare mention rates and citation frequencies across brands using shared prompts.
Find questions where competitors appear and identify the sources and content gaps behind those answers.
zh: 基于相同提示词比较各品牌的提及率与引用频次。
找出竞品获得曝光的问题，查看回答引用的来源与内容缺口。

audience.en: Marketing teams comparing competitive visibility and planning content improvements.
audience.zh: 需要对比竞品曝光并规划内容改进的营销团队。

description.en: When investigating a competitive gap, compare brands on the same prompts and inspect which cited sources accompany competitors' mentions.
description.zh: 调查竞争缺口时，在相同提示词下比较品牌，并检查竞品提及所伴随的引用来源。

summary.en: Compare competitors on the same questions and sources.
summary.zh: 在相同问题与来源下比较竞品。

description.en: Growth costs $599/month with 600 daily prompts and three core platforms. Enterprise is custom-priced and changes the monitoring, content, seats and support scope.
description.zh: Growth 为 $599/月，含每日 600 个提示词及 3 个核心平台；Enterprise 定制报价，监测、内容、席位及支持范围按约定调整。

summary.en: Growth $599/month: 600 daily prompts, three platforms. Enterprise quoted.
summary.zh: Growth $599/月：600 个每日提示词、3 平台；企业版询价。

description.en: Growth includes ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Microsoft Copilot; Enterprise adds Google AI Overviews, Gemini and Perplexity.
description.zh: Growth 包含 ChatGPT、Google AI Mode 和 Microsoft Copilot；Enterprise 增加 Google AI Overviews、Gemini 和 Perplexity。

summary.en: Growth: three core platforms; Enterprise adds AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity.
summary.zh: Growth 含 3 个核心平台；企业版增加 AI Overviews、Gemini、Perplexity。

description.en: Compare Growth's daily prompt capacity and content workflow with Enterprise's sentiment and export requirements. Do not assume the self-service price includes the full enterprise reporting scope.
description.zh: 应将 Growth 的每日提示词容量和内容流程，与 Enterprise 的情绪及导出需求比较。不应假设自助价格已包含完整企业报表范围。

description.en: Inspect cited sources and brand recommendations in scheduled AI search reports.
description.zh: 通过定期 AI 搜索报告查看引用来源与品牌推荐表现。

en: Run custom prompts and inspect the websites cited alongside brand and competitor mentions.
Schedule reports to track recommendation visibility and changes across supported engines.
zh: 运行自定义提示词，查看品牌及竞品提及时引用的网站。
定期生成报告，追踪各支持引擎的推荐曝光与变化。

audience.en: Brands and agencies reviewing AI answer citations and recurring visibility reports.
audience.zh: 需要检查 AI 回答引用与定期曝光报告的品牌及代理机构。

description.en: For recurring brand reports, run custom prompts and review changes in recommendations alongside the websites cited for brand and competitor mentions.
description.zh: 定期制作品牌报告时，运行自定义提示词，结合品牌及竞品提及所引用的网站，复查推荐呈现的变化。

summary.en: Report recommendation changes from custom prompts.
summary.zh: 用自定义提示词复盘推荐变化。

description.en: The annual display lists Starter at about $39/month, billed $470/year, and Pro at about $71/month, billed $855/year. These are rounded effective monthly rates; compare the annual invoice and included report credits.
description.zh: 年付显示 Starter 约 $39/月，实际年账单 $470；Pro 约 $71/月，年账单 $855。这些是四舍五入的月度折算价，选型应核对年度账单及报告积分。

summary.en: Annual invoices: Starter $470/year (~$39/month); Pro $855/year (~$71/month).
summary.zh: Starter 年付 $470（约 $39/月）；Pro 年付 $855（约 $71/月）。

description.en: Paid subscriptions use report credits; introductory credits and a trial are limited offers.
description.zh: 付费订阅按报告积分使用；初始赠送积分与试用均有限制。

summary.en: Report credits are metered; introductory credits and trials are limited.
summary.zh: 按报告积分计量；初始积分与试用有限。

description.en: Select by report credits, brands and seats, then compare annual invoices rather than rounded monthly equivalents. A report-credit allowance is not the same as unlimited daily prompt tracking.
description.zh: 按报告积分、品牌数和席位选型，并比较年账单，而非只看取整月度折算价。报告积分不等于无限每日提示词追踪。

description.en: Identify content and technical gaps affecting brand visibility in AI answers.
description.zh: 识别影响品牌在 AI 回答中曝光的内容与技术缺口。

en: Monitor brand mentions and citations, and prioritize content and technical improvements.
Inspect issues such as blocked crawlers, structured data gaps and broken pages; supported integrations can deploy and roll back fixes.
zh: 监测品牌提及与引用，确定内容及技术改进优先级。
检查爬虫受阻、结构化数据缺失和失效页面等问题；支持的集成可部署或回滚修复。

audience.en: Enterprise teams coordinating AI visibility measurement and website optimization.
audience.zh: 需要协同 AI 曝光分析与网站优化的企业团队。

description.en: When prioritizing technical work for AI discovery, review visibility findings alongside blocked crawlers, missing structured data and broken pages.
description.zh: 为 AI 发现安排技术工作时，结合曝光发现，复查爬虫受阻、结构化数据缺失和失效页面等问题。

summary.en: Prioritize crawler-access and page-structure fixes.
summary.zh: 安排爬虫访问及页面结构修复。

label.en: Adobe Brand Visibility product and sales information
label.zh: Adobe Brand Visibility 产品与销售说明

description.en: Enterprise pricing requires a sales quote. A verified public list price is not available; confirm the required integrations and service scope in the quote.
description.zh: 企业价格需联系销售。暂无已核实的公开标准金额，应在报价中确认所需集成与服务范围。

summary.en: Enterprise quote; no verified public list amount.
summary.zh: 企业询价，暂无已核实的公开标准金额。

description.en: Formerly Adobe LLM Optimizer; enterprise plans are available through sales.
description.zh: 前身为 Adobe LLM Optimizer；企业方案需联系销售。

summary.en: Formerly Adobe LLM Optimizer; enterprise purchase through sales.
summary.zh: 前身为 Adobe LLM Optimizer；企业采购需联系销售。

description.en: Evaluate monitoring and technical remediation as a combined enterprise workflow. If deployment or rollback is required, confirm the supported integration and contract scope rather than assuming recommendations are automatically applied.
description.zh: 可按企业监测加技术修复的整体流程评估。需要部署或回滚时，应确认受支持集成与合同范围，不能假设建议都会自动执行。

description.en: Measure brand mentions, sentiment and citations in ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews.
description.zh: 衡量品牌在 ChatGPT 与 Google AI Overviews 中的提及、情绪和引用表现。

en: Compare brand mentions, rankings, sentiment and cited sources by topic and competitor.
Review suggested actions and optionally connect visibility data with Amplitude analytics for downstream analysis.
zh: 按主题与竞品对比品牌提及、排名、情绪和引用来源。
查看改进建议，可将曝光数据接入 Amplitude 分析后续行为。

audience.en: Brand and growth teams connecting AI discovery with product analytics.
audience.zh: 需要结合 AI 发现与产品分析的品牌和增长团队。

description.en: When reviewing brand topics, compare competitor mentions and citations, then use the supported Amplitude connection to investigate subsequent behavior.
description.zh: 复盘品牌主题时，对比竞品提及与引用，再通过受支持的 Amplitude 连接研究后续行为。

summary.en: Link brand visibility with downstream Amplitude behavior.
summary.zh: 关联品牌曝光与 Amplitude 后续行为。

label.zh: Amplitude AI Visibility 公开工具

description.en: Every Amplitude plan, including Free, includes AI Visibility with plan-dependent capacity. The Free platform allowance is two million events/month; this is not a promise of unlimited prompts or daily AI Visibility refreshes.
description.zh: Amplitude 各方案均包含 AI Visibility，包括 Free，但容量取决于方案。平台免费额度为每月 200 万事件，不代表无限提示词或每日 AI 曝光刷新。

summary.en: Included on all plans, including Free; free platform allowance is 2M events/month.
summary.zh: 各档均含，Free 平台每月 200 万事件；不代表无限提示词。

description.en: AI Visibility is included across Amplitude plans, including the ongoing free plan; prompt limits and refresh settings depend on the plan.
description.zh: Amplitude 各方案均包含 AI Visibility，包括持续免费方案；提示词额度与刷新设置取决于方案。

summary.en: Prompt capacity and refresh cadence depend on plan/account.
summary.zh: 提示词容量与刷新频率取决于套餐和账户配置。

description.en: Choose between a limited standalone free report and in-account monitoring. If ingesting visibility events into Amplitude, include those events and the refresh schedule in the plan comparison.
description.zh: 应区分独立的有限免费报告与账户内监测。若将曝光事件接入 Amplitude，比较套餐时需把这些事件及刷新频率计入用量。

description.en: Analyze AI citations, referral sessions and crawler activity for your website.
description.zh: 分析网站的 AI 引用、来源会话与爬虫活动。

en: Inspect cited pages, topic coverage and the share of sessions arriving from AI referrals.
Analyze bot activity through supported server or CDN log integrations; crawling alone does not establish an AI citation.
zh: 查看被引用页面、主题覆盖与 AI 来源会话占比。
通过支持的服务器或 CDN 日志集成分析爬虫活动；爬取行为本身不代表 AI 已引用页面。

audience.en: Website teams comparing AI referral traffic, citations and crawler access.
audience.zh: 需要结合 AI 来源流量、引用和爬虫访问进行分析的网站团队。

description.en: When reviewing content discovery, inspect cited pages and AI referral sessions; use supported log integrations separately to investigate crawler activity.
description.zh: 复盘内容发现情况时，查看被引页面与 AI 来源会话；另通过受支持的日志集成调查爬虫活动。

summary.en: Review cited pages, AI referrals and separate bot activity.
summary.zh: 查看被引页面、AI 引荐及独立爬虫活动。

label.zh: Clarity 爬虫活动与集成要求
Clarity 功能与免费服务说明

description.en: Microsoft documents Clarity as a permanently free service. Supported server or CDN log collection can still incur charges from the infrastructure provider.
description.zh: Microsoft 官方将 Clarity 说明为永久免费服务；受支持的服务器或 CDN 日志采集仍可能产生基础设施服务商费用。

summary.en: Clarity is free; external log infrastructure may charge.
summary.zh: Clarity 免费；外部日志基础设施可能收费。

description.en: Clarity is free; log collection and transfer may incur charges from your infrastructure provider.
description.zh: Clarity 免费使用；日志收集和传输可能产生基础设施服务商费用。

summary.en: Log collection and transport may incur provider fees.
summary.zh: 日志采集与传输可能产生服务商费用。

description.en: Assess citations and AI referral sessions separately from log-based bot activity. Free Clarity access does not remove the integration work or possible CDN/log transport costs.
description.zh: 应将引用及 AI 引荐会话与基于日志的爬虫活动分开评估。Clarity 免费不代表无需集成工作，也不消除 CDN 或日志传输的可能费用。

description.en: Monitor brand mentions, recommendation positions and sentiment in Chinese AI apps.
description.zh: 监测品牌在中文 AI 应用中的提及、推荐位置与情绪。

Compare competitors, inspect cited sources and export monitoring reports.
zh: 跟踪品牌提及率、推荐位置、情绪，以及与品牌知识库的信息一致度。
对比竞品、查看引用来源并导出监测报告。

audience.en: Brands monitoring their presence across Chinese AI answer platforms.
audience.zh: 需要监测中文 AI 回答平台中品牌表现的团队。

description.en: When checking brand-message consistency, compare AI answers with the brand knowledge base and review competitor mentions and cited sources.
description.zh: 检查品牌信息一致性时，将 AI 回答与品牌知识库对照，并复查竞品提及和引用来源。

summary.en: Check AI claims against the brand knowledge base.
summary.zh: 将 AI 品牌信息与知识库核对。

label.en: MicoSeek service terms and plan limitations
label.zh: 觅恒服务条款与方案说明

description.en: Monitoring consumes credits under the published terms. No current public unit price was verified; initial experience credits should not be treated as a recurring free allowance.
description.zh: 已公布条款说明检测消耗积分。本轮未核实公开的当前积分单价，初始体验积分不能当作持续免费额度。

summary.en: Credit-metered monitoring; current unit price unconfirmed.
summary.zh: 按积分检测，当前单价待确认。

description.en: The service terms allow app, web or API sampling. Detection consumes credits; free configuration slots and introductory credits do not establish ongoing free detection.
description.zh: 服务条款包含 App、网页或 API 采样方式；检测消耗积分，免费配置额度和初始体验积分不代表持续免费检测。

summary.en: App/web/API collection permitted; introductory credits are not recurring free checks.
summary.zh: 允许 App／网页／API 采样；初始积分不是持续免费检测。

description.en: Compare the required Chinese platforms and knowledge-base consistency checks. The public site emphasizes mobile-app sampling, while the terms allow other collection modes; confirm the actual sampling mode rather than treating every task as an app test.
description.zh: 重点比较所需中文平台与知识库一致性检查。官网强调手机 App 采样，但条款允许其他采集方式，应确认实际任务模式，不将所有检测都当作 App 实测。

description.en: Track local business recommendations with city-specific AI search questions.
description.zh: 通过带有城市条件的 AI 搜索问题追踪本地商家推荐表现。

en: Monitor city-specific questions through web-search-enabled AI APIs and compare business mentions and cited pages.
Track AI recommendations alongside a separate Google Maps grid; these measure different discovery channels.
zh: 通过启用联网搜索的 AI API 监测带城市条件的问题，对比商家提及与引用页面。
结合独立的 Google Maps 网格查看 AI 推荐；两者衡量不同的发现渠道。

audience.en: Local businesses and agencies comparing city-level AI recommendations.
audience.zh: 需要对比城市级 AI 推荐表现的本地商家与代理机构。

description.en: For a city-specific business review, monitor location-qualified questions through web-enabled AI APIs and compare recommendations with a separate map-grid view.
description.zh: 复盘某个城市的商家表现时，通过启用联网搜索的 AI API 监测带地区条件的问题，并与独立地图网格视图对照查看。

summary.en: Compare city-specific AI recommendations and map grids.
summary.zh: 比较城市级 AI 推荐与独立地图网格。

label.zh: Rank.ai 本地 AI 搜索追踪

label.en: Rank.ai plans and AI tracking limits
label.zh: Rank.ai 方案与 AI 追踪限制

description.en: Starter is $49/month or $39/month billed yearly, with five AI questions. Growth is $129/month or $99/month billed yearly, with 25 AI questions. The $0 writing offer is not continuing AI question tracking.
description.zh: Starter 月付 $49，年付折算 $39/月，含 5 个 AI 问题；Growth 月付 $129，年付折算 $99/月，含 25 个问题。$0 写作入口不代表持续 AI 问题追踪。

summary.en: Starter $49/month or $39 yearly-rate/month: five AI questions. Growth $129/$99: 25.
summary.zh: Starter 月付 $49／年付折算 $39/月，5 个 AI 问题；Growth $129／$99，25 个。

description.en: Ongoing AI question tracking starts on paid plans; free writing allowances and a time-limited trial do not include ongoing free tracking.
description.zh: 持续 AI 问题追踪从付费方案开始；免费写作额度与限时试用不代表持续免费监测。

summary.en: Continuing AI tracking is paid; free writing/trials do not include ongoing monitoring.
summary.zh: 持续 AI 追踪需付费；免费写作与试用不等于长期监测。

description.en: Choose by the number of location-qualified AI questions and the city covered. Its web-enabled API results and its separate map grid should be compared with equivalent sampling methods, not treated as the same ranking.
description.zh: 按带地区条件的 AI 问题数和所覆盖城市选型。其联网 API 结果与独立地图网格，应分别与相同采样方法比较，不能当作同一种排名。

description.en: Research questions, improve content coverage and track brand mentions in AI answers.
description.zh: 研究用户问题、改善内容覆盖，并跟踪品牌在 AI 回答中的提及。

en: Find relevant questions and use intent and term recommendations to draft or revise content.
Track queries across ChatGPT and Gemini; the homepage also lists Claude, while plan coverage should be confirmed.
zh: 发现相关问题，结合搜索意图和用词建议撰写或修改内容。
定价页明确支持 ChatGPT 和 Gemini 问题追踪；首页另列 Claude，具体方案覆盖需确认。

audience.en: Content teams combining AI search research, editing and visibility reporting.
audience.zh: 需要结合 AI 搜索研究、编辑和曝光报告的内容团队。

description.en: When writing or revising an article, use related questions and search-intent guidance to identify topics and wording that need editorial attention.
description.zh: 撰写或修改文章时，通过相关问题与搜索意图建议，找出需要编辑复查的主题和用词。

summary.en: Review article topics, intent and wording.
summary.zh: 复查文章主题、意图和用词。

label.zh: Clearscope 内容与 AI 曝光工作流

label.en: Clearscope plans and query tracking coverage
label.zh: Clearscope 方案与问题追踪范围

description.en: Essentials is $129/month with 50 tracked queries; Business is $399/month with 300 tracked queries. Additional pages and drafts have separate capacity pricing.
description.zh: Essentials 为 $129/月，含 50 个追踪查询；Business 为 $399/月，含 300 个查询。额外页面和草稿另有容量计费。

summary.en: Essentials $129/month/50 queries; Business $399/300. Extra pages/drafts cost separately.
summary.zh: Essentials $129/月/50 查询；Business $399/300 查询。额外页面／草稿另计。

description.en: Subscriptions include a limited trial; a free start does not mean ongoing free monitoring.
description.zh: 订阅提供限时试用，免费开始不代表持续免费监测。

summary.en: Limited trial, not continuing free monitoring.
summary.zh: 仅限时试用，不是持续免费监测。

description.en: Compare content research and tracked-query capacity together. Essentials and Business differ in query and page limits; confirm current engine entitlement where the homepage and plan table describe different coverage.
description.zh: 应同时比较内容研究和追踪查询容量。Essentials 与 Business 的查询及页面额度不同，首页与套餐表覆盖说明有出入时，应确认当前引擎权限。

description.en: Analyze AI crawler activity and the human visits referred by AI chat platforms.
description.zh: 分析 AI 爬虫活动，以及 AI 聊天平台带来的真人访问。

en: Inspect automated traffic separately from human referrals after connecting your website.
Compare AI referral platforms and receiving pages; crawler requests alone do not prove answer citations.
zh: 连接网站后，分别查看自动化流量与真人来源访问。
比较 AI 来源平台与落地页；爬虫请求本身不能证明页面被回答引用。

audience.en: Website owners and analytics teams investigating AI discovery and referral traffic.
audience.zh: 需要分析 AI 发现过程与来源访问的网站运营者和分析团队。

description.en: When evaluating AI acquisition, compare referral platforms and landing pages for human visitors while investigating automated requests separately.
description.zh: 评估 AI 获客时，比较真人访客的来源平台和落地页，同时单独调查自动化请求。

summary.en: Separate human AI referrals from automated requests.
summary.zh: 区分真人 AI 引荐与自动化请求。

label.zh: Known Agents 爬虫与 Agent 分析

label.en: Known Agents AI chat referral tracking
label.zh: Known Agents AI 聊天来源追踪

label.en: Known Agents free allowance and paid plans
label.zh: Known Agents 免费额度与付费方案

description.en: Free is $0/month for one project; Startup is $29/month for three projects; Growth is $299/month for ten projects. Event allowances and advanced functions differ by plan.
description.zh: Free 为 $0/月、1 个项目；Startup 为 $29/月、3 个项目；Growth 为 $299/月、10 个项目。事件额度和高级功能随方案不同。

summary.en: Free: one project; Startup $29/month/three; Growth $299/ten. Event limits vary.
summary.zh: 免费 1 项目；Startup $29/月/3 项目；Growth $299/10 项目，事件额度按档位。

description.en: Offers a recurring free event allowance and paid plans; usage limits and premium features vary.
description.zh: 提供持续免费的事件额度及付费方案，使用上限与高级功能依方案而异。

summary.en: Free event allowance is capped; advanced functions depend on plan.
summary.zh: 免费事件有上限；高级功能按套餐提供。

description.en: Choose referral tracking for human acquisition questions and bot reporting for automated access questions. Compare project and event capacity, keeping both datasets separate from answer-level citations.
description.zh: 真人获客问题使用引荐追踪，自动访问问题使用机器人报表。选型比较项目与事件容量，同时把两类数据与回答级引用分开。

description.en: Track local brand visibility across AI answers and report changes to clients.
description.zh: 跟踪本地品牌在 AI 回答中的曝光，并向客户报告变化。

en: Monitor business mentions across ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Mode, Perplexity, Claude and Grok.
Review visibility trends and reporting for agencies and local brands, alongside separate map and SERP tracking.
zh: 监测商家在 ChatGPT、Gemini、Google AI Mode、Perplexity、Claude 和 Grok 中的提及。
为代理机构和本地品牌查看曝光趋势与报告，地图及传统搜索追踪是独立功能。

audience.en: Local businesses and agencies reporting AI search visibility for their clients.
audience.zh: 需要为自身或客户报告 AI 搜索曝光的本地企业和代理机构。

description.en: When reporting a local business's AI presence, review brand mentions and visibility trends separately from map and traditional-search rankings.
description.zh: 汇报本地商家的 AI 呈现时，查看品牌提及与曝光趋势，并与地图和传统搜索排名分开解读。

summary.en: Review local AI mentions separately from map/SERP rankings.
summary.zh: 单独复盘本地 AI 提及，区别于地图／搜索排名。

label.zh: Local Dominator AI Tracker 功能

label.en: Local Dominator plans including AI Tracker
label.zh: Local Dominator 含 AI Tracker 的方案

description.en: AI Tracker uses paid, credit-based plans with a limited trial. A current fixed amount is not confirmed here; request pricing for the prompt, location and engine configuration required.
description.zh: AI Tracker 使用按积分计量的付费方案，并提供限时试用。暂无已确认的当前固定金额，应按所需提示词、地区和引擎配置获取报价。

summary.en: Paid credit-based plans; configured amount unconfirmed. Limited trial.
summary.zh: 积分制付费方案，配置报价待确认；提供限时试用。

description.en: The rendered pricing page includes AI Tracker in credit-based paid plans with a free trial.
description.zh: 浏览器渲染后的定价页将 AI Tracker 列入按积分计量的付费方案，并提供免费试用。

summary.en: AI Tracker uses paid credits; trial is temporary.
summary.zh: AI Tracker 消耗付费积分，试用有时限。

description.en: Compare AI Tracker's credit usage and report workflow independently from the suite's map and SERP trackers. Inclusion in one suite does not make those outputs interchangeable.
description.zh: 应将 AI Tracker 的积分用量和报告流程，与套件中的地图和 SERP 追踪分别比较。同属一套产品不代表结果指标可互换。

description.en: Compare brand visibility and competitors using persona-based AI answer audits.
description.zh: 通过基于用户画像的 AI 回答审计，比较品牌与竞品曝光。

en: Run questions from different buyer personas and compare brand presence, competitors and sentiment.
Inspect visibility, citation, content and technical audits; the audit types and monitoring frequency depend on the plan.
zh: 从不同购买者画像出发运行问题，比较品牌曝光、竞品和情绪。
查看曝光、引用、内容和技术审计；可用审计类型与监测频率依方案而定。

audience.en: Brand marketers and agencies comparing how AI answers differ across buyer personas.
audience.zh: 需要比较不同购买者画像下 AI 回答差异的品牌营销人员和代理机构。

description.en: When researching different buyer groups, run questions from their personas and compare brand exposure, sentiment and competitor presence.
description.zh: 研究不同购买群体时，从各自的画像出发运行问题，对比品牌曝光、情绪与竞品呈现。

summary.en: Compare AI responses across buyer personas.
summary.zh: 按购买者画像比较 AI 回答。

label.en: Gumshoe project billing and sample audit limits
label.zh: Gumshoe 项目计费与样例审计限制

description.en: Starter is $99/month per project and Pro $299/month per project. A project represents a brand plus a focus area. One free sample audit does not enable ongoing paid monitoring.
description.zh: Starter 每项目 $99/月，Pro 每项目 $299/月；项目按品牌加业务方向划分。一次免费样例诊断不等于开启持续付费监测。

summary.en: Starter $99/project/month; Pro $299. Each brand focus area is a project.
summary.zh: Starter 每项目 $99/月；Pro $299。每个品牌业务方向单独计项目。

description.en: Each brand focus area is a separately billed project; the initial free sample audit is a one-time report.
description.zh: 每个品牌业务方向作为独立项目计费，初始免费样例审计为一次性报告。

summary.en: Projects are separately billed; the free sample audit is one-off.
summary.zh: 项目分别计费；免费样例诊断仅一次。

description.en: Choose Starter for the documented visibility-focused audit scope, or Pro when citation, sentiment and content audits plus daily snapshots are needed. Budget by brand focus-area project, not by seat alone.
description.zh: 按已说明范围，侧重曝光诊断可比较 Starter；需要引用、情绪、内容诊断及每日快照时再比较 Pro。预算按品牌业务方向项目计算，不只按席位计算。

description.en: Research, revise and optimize client content alongside AI search visibility tracking.
description.zh: 结合 AI 搜索曝光追踪，研究、修改并优化客户内容。

en: Import existing pages, review topic coverage and competitor evidence, then edit and review revisions.
Connect research, briefs, drafts and optimization with client workspaces and visibility reports.
zh: 导入已有页面，查看主题覆盖与竞品证据，再编辑并审核修改。
在客户工作区中关联研究、简报、草稿、优化和曝光报告。

audience.en: Agencies managing content delivery and AI visibility for multiple clients.
audience.zh: 为多个客户交付内容并跟踪 AI 曝光的代理机构。

description.en: When updating an existing client page, import it, review topic coverage and competitor evidence, then edit and approve changes within the content workflow.
description.zh: 更新已有客户页面时，导入页面并复查主题覆盖与竞品证据，再在内容工作流中编辑和审核修改。

summary.en: Refresh client pages using topic and competitor evidence.
summary.zh: 依据主题及竞品证据更新客户页面。

label.zh: Rankability 已有页面优化工作流

label.en: Rankability plans, engine coverage and trial terms
label.zh: Rankability 方案、引擎覆盖与试用规则

description.en: Monthly Starter, Agency and Agency Pro plans are USD 97, 297 and 497, with 20, 80 and 160 content projects/month. The seven-day trial requires a card and converts to the selected subscription unless canceled.
description.zh: Starter、Agency、Agency Pro 月付分别为 97、297、497 美元，含每月 20、80、160 个内容项目。七天试用需绑卡，未取消会转为所选订阅。

summary.en: Starter USD 97/month/20 content projects; Agency 297/80; Agency Pro 497/160.
summary.zh: Starter 97 美元/月/20 内容项目；Agency 297/80；Agency Pro 497/160。

description.en: Paid plans list the same AI platform coverage; the card-required trial is limited and renews into a subscription unless canceled.
description.zh: 付费方案列出相同的 AI 平台覆盖；试用需绑卡且有用量限制，未取消会转为订阅。

summary.en: Same AI engines across paid tiers; card-required trial auto-renews unless canceled.
summary.zh: 付费各档引擎相同；试用需绑卡，未取消会转订阅。

description.en: Compare the monthly content-project budget with AI query capacity and client approvals. Higher tiers increase delivery capacity; they should not be assumed to add different AI engine coverage.
description.zh: 应将每月内容项目预算与 AI 查询容量、客户审核流程一起比较。更高档增加交付容量，不应假设一定增加不同的 AI 引擎覆盖。

description.en: Compare AI referral traffic with brand mentions, citations and competitor visibility.
description.zh: 结合品牌提及、引用和竞品曝光，对比 AI 来源流量。

en: Compare AI referral traffic and receiving pages for your site and competitors.
Investigate brand mentions, prompts, sentiment and cited pages within the AI Search Intelligence product.
zh: 比较自身网站与竞品的 AI 来源流量及落地页。
在 AI Search Intelligence 中调查品牌提及、提示词、情绪与被引页面。

audience.en: Marketing and research teams comparing AI discovery and traffic across websites.
audience.zh: 需要跨网站比较 AI 发现表现与流量的营销和研究团队。

description.en: When comparing an acquisition market, review your site's AI referral traffic and landing pages against competitors, alongside brand visibility research.
description.zh: 比较获客市场时，将自有网站的 AI 引荐流量和落地页与竞品对照，并结合品牌曝光研究查看。

summary.en: Benchmark AI referral traffic and landing pages against competitors.
summary.zh: 对比自有与竞品的 AI 引荐和落地页。

label.zh: Similarweb AI Search Intelligence 功能
Similarweb AI Search Intelligence 方案

description.zh: AEO Intelligence 月付 $129，或年付折算 $99/月；含 1 个用户、150 个监测提示词及 3 个月历史。更高组合方案增加 SEO 和竞争情报，不能只按起步金额比较。

summary.en: AEO: $129/month or $99 yearly-rate/month; one user, 150 prompts, three months' history.
summary.zh: AEO 月付 $129／年付折算 $99/月；1 用户、150 提示词、3 个月历史。

description.en: AI Traffic and AI Brand Visibility are included in paid packages; free tools and trials have separate limits.
description.zh: AI Traffic 和 AI Brand Visibility 包含在付费方案内，免费工具与试用另有范围限制。

summary.en: Full AI Traffic/Brand Visibility are paid; free tools/trials have narrower scope.
summary.zh: 完整 AI 流量／品牌曝光需付费；免费工具和试用范围较窄。

description.en: Monitor brand mentions, citations and competitors across AI search platforms.
description.zh: 跨 AI 搜索平台监测品牌提及、引用和竞品表现。

en: Track prompts, original answers, cited sources, sentiment and competitor visibility.
Use citation gaps and page diagnostics to prioritize content briefs and technical work.
zh: 跟踪提示词、回答原文、引用来源、情绪和竞品曝光。
结合引用缺口与页面诊断，为内容简报和技术工作安排优先级。

audience.en: Brands and agencies coordinating AI visibility research and follow-up optimization.
audience.zh: 需要协同进行 AI 曝光研究和后续优化的品牌与代理机构。

description.en: When prioritizing a GEO work backlog, connect prompt answers and citation gaps with page-audit findings to separate content research from technical tasks.
description.zh: 安排 GEO 待办优先级时，将提示词回答和引用缺口与页面诊断结合，区分内容研究与技术任务。

summary.en: Prioritize content and technical tasks from citation gaps.
summary.zh: 依据引用缺口安排内容与技术任务。

label.zh: Qwairy 监测与优化工作流

label.en: Qwairy current plans and model access
label.zh: Qwairy 当前方案与模型访问范围

description.en: The EUR display lists Starter at €79/month or €790/year (shown as about €65/month). Growth is €199/month or €1,990/year. Workspaces, credits and AI actions vary by tier.
description.zh: 欧元显示 Starter 月付 €79，或年付 €790（页面折算约 €65/月）；Growth 月付 €199，或年付 €1,990。工作区、积分与 AI 操作额度随档位变化。

summary.en: Starter €79/month or €790/year; Growth €199/month or €1,990/year.
summary.zh: Starter 月付 €79／年付 €790；Growth 月付 €199／年付 €1,990。

description.en: Monitoring and AI operations consume credits; introductory credits are finite, and API models require Enterprise under the current pricing page.
description.zh: 监测和 AI 操作消耗积分；入门赠送额度有限，当前定价页将 API 模型限定在 Enterprise。

summary.en: Monitoring/actions consume credits; API models currently Enterprise-only.
summary.zh: 监测／操作消耗积分；API 模型当前限 Enterprise。

description.en: Choose by workspaces, monitoring credits and AI-operation capacity. Verify whether API-model access is required, because the current pricing description places it in Enterprise rather than every self-service tier.
description.zh: 按工作区、监测积分与 AI 操作容量选型。若需要 API 模型访问，应先核对权限，当前定价说明将其列在 Enterprise，而非所有自助档。

description.en: Organize prompts by topic and track brand answers, citations and competitors.
description.zh: 按主题组织提示词，跟踪品牌回答、引用和竞品表现。

en: Group prompts into topics, inspect generated answers and follow visibility trends and heatmaps.
Review cited pages and compare competitors for the same target prompts.
zh: 将提示词按主题分组，查看生成的回答，并跟踪曝光趋势和热力图。
查看被引用页面，并在相同目标提示词下比较竞品。

audience.en: Agencies and marketing teams building topic-based AI monitoring reports.
audience.zh: 需要建立按主题划分的 AI 监测报告的代理机构和营销团队。

description.en: When reviewing a topic, group related prompts, examine visibility heatmaps and inspect cited pages while comparing competitors on the same questions.
description.zh: 复盘某个主题时，将相关提示词分组，查看曝光热力图和被引页面，并在相同问题下比较竞品。

summary.en: Compare topic visibility, citations and competitors.
summary.zh: 按主题比较曝光、引用和竞品。

label.en: Cairrot prompt, topic and citation reporting
label.zh: Cairrot 提示词、主题与引用报告
Cairrot 方案与 Grok 附加项

description.en: Starter is $39/month with 15 prompts and two LLMs; Pro is $99/month with 40 prompts and five LLMs; Enterprise is $299/month with 100 prompts. Grok tracking is a separate add-on starting at $25.
description.zh: Starter 为 $39/月，含 15 个提示词和 2 个模型；Pro 为 $99/月，含 40 个提示词和 5 个模型；Enterprise 为 $299/月，含 100 个提示词。Grok 追踪另购，从 $25 起。

summary.en: Starter $39/month/15 prompts/two models; Pro $99/40/five; Grok add-on from $25.
summary.zh: Starter $39/月/15 提示词/2 模型；Pro $99/40/5；Grok 加购 $25 起。

description.en: Entry plans list ChatGPT and Perplexity; higher tiers add Gemini, Claude and DeepSeek, with Grok as a separate add-on.
description.zh: 入门方案列出 ChatGPT 和 Perplexity；较高方案增加 Gemini、Claude 和 DeepSeek，Grok 为单独附加项。

summary.en: Starter: ChatGPT/Perplexity; higher tiers add models. Grok stays an add-on.
summary.zh: Starter 含 ChatGPT／Perplexity；升档增加模型，Grok 仍另购。

description.en: Starter covers ChatGPT and Perplexity; Pro adds the documented five-model set and more prompts. Grok is a separate add-on even when selecting a higher plan.
description.zh: Starter 覆盖 ChatGPT 与 Perplexity，Pro 增加至已说明的五模型集合及更多提示词。即使选择更高档，Grok 仍是独立附加项。

description.en: Trace cited sources and compare brand visibility across recurring AI prompts.
description.zh: 追踪引用来源，并比较持续采样的 AI 提示词下的品牌曝光。

en: Inspect cited sources, brand mentions, competitive visibility and sentiment across supported engines.
Choose prompt frequency and engines, and use crawler analytics and content briefs to investigate gaps.
zh: 跨支持引擎查看引用来源、品牌提及、竞品曝光和情绪。
选择提示词运行频率与引擎，结合爬虫分析和内容简报调查缺口。

audience.en: SEO teams and agencies investigating sources behind AI brand visibility.
audience.zh: 需要调查 AI 品牌曝光背后来源的 SEO 团队与代理机构。

description.en: When investigating a visibility gap, review prompts and citations alongside crawler analysis and content briefs, with sampling frequency suited to the task.
description.zh: 调查曝光缺口时，结合爬虫分析与内容简报复查提示词和引用，并按任务选择采样频率。

summary.en: Investigate gaps with citations, crawler data and content briefs.
summary.zh: 结合引用、爬虫及内容简报调查缺口。

label.en: Rankshift engine costs and tracking frequency
label.zh: Rankshift 引擎消耗与追踪频率

description.en: With EUR and annual billing displayed, Starter is €69/month, Professional €159/month and Business €359/month. Included credits are 9,500, 22,000 and 53,000; these rates require annual billing.
description.zh: 欧元年付显示 Starter 折算 €69/月、Professional €159/月、Business €359/月，分别含 9,500、22,000、53,000 积分；这些金额要求按年结算。

summary.en: Annual rates: Starter €69/month/9,500 credits; Professional €159/22,000; Business €359/53,000.
summary.zh: 年付折算：Starter €69/月/9,500 积分；Professional €159/22,000；Business €359/53,000。

description.en: Credit use depends on engine, frequency and persona count; the trial is limited rather than a recurring free plan.
description.zh: 积分消耗取决于引擎、频率和画像数量；试用有限，不代表持续免费方案。

summary.en: Engine, cadence and personas affect credit use; trial is limited.
summary.zh: 引擎、频率和画像影响积分；试用有时限。

description.en: Compare usable credits for the chosen engines and refresh frequency, then consider content briefs and crawler analysis. Unlimited projects or seats do not remove the shared credit budget.
description.zh: 应先按所选引擎和刷新频率比较可用积分，再考虑内容简报与爬虫分析。无限项目或席位不代表没有共享积分预算。

description.en: Investigate AI crawler access and content gaps alongside brand visibility reporting.
description.zh: 结合品牌曝光报告，调查 AI 爬虫访问与内容缺口。

en: Use AI bot log analysis to identify uncrawled pages, crawl errors and inefficient access patterns.
Combine brand mentions, citations, prompt research and content guidance to prioritize AI search work.
zh: 通过 AI 爬虫日志分析发现未抓取页面、抓取错误与低效访问模式。
结合品牌提及、引用、提示词研究和内容建议，确定 AI 搜索工作的优先级。

audience.en: Enterprise search teams combining AI visibility with technical discovery diagnostics.
audience.zh: 需要将 AI 曝光与技术发现诊断结合的企业搜索团队。

description.en: When troubleshooting AI access to a site, inspect unvisited pages, crawl errors and inefficient bot requests before prioritizing technical fixes.
description.zh: 排查网站的 AI 访问问题时，检查未被抓取页面、抓取错误和低效爬虫请求，再安排技术修复。

summary.en: Troubleshoot uncrawled pages and AI bot errors.
summary.zh: 排查未抓取页面与 AI 爬虫错误。

label.en: Clarity ArcAI AI bot log analysis
label.zh: Clarity ArcAI AI 爬虫日志分析
Clarity ArcAI 方案与附加项

description.en: Pricing is provided through a sales agreement or tailored package. No fixed public amount for this feature was verified; confirm the monitoring scope, required integrations and contract term in the quote.
description.zh: 费用通过销售协议或定制方案确定。本轮未核实到该功能的固定公开金额，需在报价中确认监测范围、必要集成和合同期限。

summary.en: Custom quote; specify visibility, bot and accuracy modules.
summary.zh: 定制询价，确认曝光、爬虫和准确性模块。

description.en: Sales-quoted packages distinguish core visibility from bot activity and accuracy add-ons; crawling does not prove a citation.
description.zh: 报价方案区分核心曝光功能、爬虫活动和准确性附加项；抓取不等于引用。

summary.en: Bot activity and accuracy are add-ons; crawling is not confirmed citation.
summary.zh: 爬虫活动、准确性另作附加项；抓取不等于确认引用。

description.en: Select the package for the task: core visibility, bot-activity discovery and accuracy analysis are separately described capabilities. Request a quote that lists the required add-ons instead of assuming one base package covers all three.
description.zh: 应按任务选择方案：核心曝光、爬虫活动发现和准确性分析是分别说明的能力。报价需列明必要附加项，不能假设一个基础套餐包含三者。

description.en: Inspect the domains and pages cited in AI answers alongside brand mentions and competitors.
description.zh: 结合品牌提及与竞品表现，分析 AI 回答引用的域名和页面。

en: Group cited URLs by domain, host or page and trace them to the underlying AI responses.
Check whether cited pages mention your brand and compare citation coverage across AI models.
zh: 按域名、主机或页面归组引用 URL，并追溯原始 AI 回答。
检查被引页面是否提及品牌，比较不同 AI 模型的引用覆盖。

audience.en: SEO, content and brand teams investigating the sources behind AI answers.
audience.zh: 需要研究 AI 回答背后来源的 SEO、内容与品牌团队。

description.en: When auditing citation coverage, group sources by domain or page, return to the original answer and check whether the cited page actually mentions the brand.
description.zh: 核对引用覆盖时，按域名或页面归组来源，回看原始回答，并检查被引页面是否真正提及品牌。

summary.en: Trace cited pages and verify brand mentions in them.
summary.zh: 追溯被引页面并核对品牌提及。

label.en: LLM Pulse product and supported engines
label.zh: LLM Pulse 产品与支持引擎
LLM Pulse 引用来源文档
LLM Pulse 订阅与附加项

description.en: With EUR, monthly billing and weekly tracking selected, Starter is €49/month for 50 prompts, Growth €99 for 150, and Scale €299 for 450. Daily tracking, extra models and yearly billing are different configurations.
description.zh: 选择欧元、月付和每周追踪时，Starter 为 €49/月、50 个提示词；Growth €99、150 个；Scale €299、450 个。每日追踪、额外模型及年付属于不同配置。

summary.en: Monthly, weekly tracking: Starter €49/50 prompts; Growth €99/150; Scale €299/450. Daily/model add-ons differ.
summary.zh: 月付、每周追踪：Starter €49/50 提示词，Growth €99/150，Scale €299/450。每日及额外模型另选。

description.en: Paid plans include five core engines; additional engines and analytics features have separate plan or add-on limits.
description.zh: 付费方案包含五个核心引擎；其他引擎及分析功能受套餐或附加项限制。

summary.en: Five core engines included; other engines/features depend on plan or add-ons.
summary.zh: 含 5 个核心引擎；其他引擎／功能按套餐或加购。

description.en: Compare tracking cadence as well as prompt count. Starter has 50 prompts but lacks the sentiment and AI Traffic Analytics listed for Growth; extra models are add-ons, and non-EUR prices are approximate displays.
description.zh: 除提示词数量外，还需比较频率。Starter 含 50 个提示词，但不含 Growth 列出的情绪及 AI Traffic Analytics；额外模型另购，非欧元金额为近似显示。

description.en: Compare brand visibility, sentiment and citation share across tracked AI prompts.
description.zh: 围绕监测提示词，对比品牌曝光、情绪和引用份额。

en: Compare your brand with selected competitors on visibility, rank, sentiment and share of mentions.
Inspect cited domains and landing pages, and review the responses behind individual prompts.
zh: 按曝光、位置、情绪和提及份额，对比品牌与选定竞品。
分析被引域名和落地页，并回看单个提示词对应的回答。

audience.en: SEO teams and agencies comparing brands within a consistent AI prompt set.
audience.zh: 需要在一致的 AI 提示词集合下比较品牌的 SEO 团队和代理机构。

description.en: When comparing a brand with selected competitors, inspect mention share and sentiment, then examine cited landing pages and the underlying prompt answers.
description.zh: 比较品牌与选定竞品时，查看提及份额和情绪，再检查被引落地页及其对应的提示词回答。

summary.en: Compare mention share, sentiment and cited landing pages.
summary.zh: 比较提及份额、情绪及被引落地页。

description.en: A paid subscription is required. A verified AccuLLM-specific amount is not available here; general keyword-tracking plan prices should not be treated as the same quote.
description.zh: 需要付费订阅。暂无已核实的 AccuLLM 专属金额，通用关键词追踪套餐价格不应视为相同报价。

summary.en: Paid; AccuLLM-specific amount unconfirmed. General keyword-plan prices do not apply.
summary.zh: 付费；AccuLLM 专属金额待确认，不套用通用关键词套餐价。

description.en: Paid AccuLLM subscriptions provide daily tracking across four listed AI platforms; API access and brand limits vary by plan.
description.zh: AccuLLM 付费订阅提供四个平台的每日监测；API 权限及品牌额度随方案变化。

summary.en: Four engines tracked daily; API and brand capacity depend on plan.
summary.zh: 4 个引擎每日监测；API、品牌额度按档位区分。

description.en: Compare answer-level visibility, sentiment and cited domains for the four documented engines. Confirm the AccuLLM-specific subscription and brand/API limits rather than copying the general keyword-tracking plan price.
description.zh: 应比较已说明四个引擎的回答级曝光、情绪与引用域名。需确认 AccuLLM 专属订阅及品牌／API 限制，不能直接套用通用关键词追踪方案金额。

description.en: Track AI prompt responses and connect brand mentions and citations with search-ranking data.
description.zh: 监测 AI 提示词回答，并结合搜索排名分析品牌提及与引用。

en: Run recurring prompt checks and compare brand visibility, positions, sentiment and competitor mentions.
Inspect cited URLs alongside traditional keyword rankings to investigate changes in AI visibility.
zh: 定期检查提示词，对比品牌曝光、位置、情绪与竞品提及。
结合传统关键词排名分析引用 URL，研究 AI 曝光变化。

audience.en: SEO teams maintaining prompt monitoring alongside keyword-rank tracking.
audience.zh: 需要同时维护提示词监控和关键词排名追踪的 SEO 团队。

description.en: When reviewing search performance, investigate AI prompt visibility and cited URLs alongside traditional keyword rankings as separate measures.
description.zh: 复盘搜索表现时，将 AI 提示词曝光和引用 URL 与传统关键词排名并列调查，分别解读这些指标。

summary.en: Review AI citations alongside traditional keyword rankings.
summary.zh: 并列研究 AI 引用与传统关键词排名。

label.en: Nightwatch current plans and AI coverage
label.zh: Nightwatch 当前方案与 AI 覆盖

description.en: The EUR annual display lists Starter at €79/month (€948/year), Professional at €159/month (€1,908/year) and Agency at €399/month (€4,788/year). Their AI prompt limits are 50, 150 and 500 respectively.
description.zh: 欧元年付显示 Starter 折算 €79/月（€948/年）、Professional €159/月（€1,908/年）、Agency €399/月（€4,788/年），AI 提示词上限分别为 50、150、500。

summary.en: Annual rates: €79/€159/€399 per month; 50/150/500 AI prompts.

description.en: The current pricing page lists six AI platforms in paid plans; prompt and response allowances vary by tier, and the trial is time-limited.
description.zh: 当前计费页在付费方案中列出六个 AI 平台；提示词和回答额度随档位变化，试用有时间限制。

summary.en: Six AI platforms; prompt/answer caps vary. Limited trial.
summary.zh: 覆盖 6 平台，提示词／回答有分档上限；限时试用。

description.en: The paid tiers list the same six AI platforms, while prompt, response and site allowances grow. Choose by required capacity and reporting workflow rather than expecting a higher tier to unlock an entirely different core platform list.
description.zh: 付费档位列出相同六个 AI 平台，变化主要在提示词、回答及网站额度。应按容量与报表流程选型，而非期待高档解锁完全不同的核心平台名单。

description.en: Separate AI-referred human visits from chatbot requests and AI-agent activity.
description.zh: 区分 AI 引荐的真人访问、聊天机器人请求与 AI Agent 活动。

en: Use the AI Assistant acquisition channel to segment recognized referrals and compare engagement and conversions.
Report chatbot requests separately from human visits; bot and agent reporting require supported telemetry or integrations.
zh: 通过 AI Assistant 获客渠道细分已识别的引荐访问，对比互动和转化。
将聊天机器人请求与真人访问分开统计；机器人与 Agent 报表需要相应遥测或集成。

audience.en: Analytics teams measuring AI referral acquisition and separating automated site activity.
audience.zh: 需要衡量 AI 引荐获客并区分自动化访问的网站分析团队。

description.en: When evaluating AI-assisted acquisition, segment recognized referrals to compare engagement and conversions; investigate bot activity separately with the required telemetry.
description.zh: 评估 AI 引荐获客时，细分已识别来源以比较互动和转化；另在具备所需遥测数据时调查机器人活动。

summary.en: Analyze recognized AI acquisition and separate bot traffic.
summary.zh: 分析已识别 AI 获客，并单独查看机器人流量。

label.en: Matomo AI analytics features and deployment limits
label.zh: Matomo AI 分析功能与部署限制
Matomo AI Assistant 获客渠道指南
Matomo Cloud 与自托管定价

description.en: The AI analytics offering is included with paid Matomo Cloud or purchased as an On-Premise add-on. The free self-hosted core does not establish that the full AI reporting package is free; total cost depends on deployment and usage.
description.zh: AI 分析功能包含在付费 Matomo Cloud 中，或作为 On-Premise 附加项购买。免费自托管核心不代表完整 AI 报表免费；总价取决于部署方式与用量。

summary.en: Included with paid Cloud; paid add-on for On-Premise. Free core is not full AI reporting.
summary.zh: 付费 Cloud 包含；On-Premise 需付费附加项。免费核心不含完整 AI 报表。

description.en: The full AI analytics offering is included in paid Cloud plans or provided as a paid On-Premise add-on. The free core and basic referral channel do not establish that all AI reports are free.
description.zh: 完整 AI 分析功能包含在付费 Cloud 方案中，或作为自托管付费附加项提供；免费核心和基础引荐渠道不代表全部 AI 报表免费。

summary.en: Full AI analytics is paid; core/referral basics do not include all reports.
summary.zh: 完整 AI 分析需付费；基础引荐不代表全套报表。

description.en: Compare hosted Cloud with self-hosted On-Premise deployment, including the AI add-on and required telemetry. Free core software and the full AI reporting package are different purchase scopes.
description.zh: 应比较托管 Cloud 与自托管 On-Premise，并计入 AI 附加项及必要遥测。免费核心软件与完整 AI 报表是不同采购范围。

description.en: Classify known AI referral domains and investigate their landing pages and engagement.
description.zh: 识别已知 AI 引荐域名，分析相关落地页和互动表现。

en: Classify visits from recognized AI assistant domains in Marketing Analytics traffic-source reports.
Use AI traffic segments and the AI Traffic Overview dashboard; some sections require SEO Enterprise access and an active crawl.
zh: 在 Marketing Analytics 的流量来源报表中，识别已知 AI 助手域名带来的访问。
使用 AI 流量细分和 AI Traffic Overview 看板；部分模块需要 SEO Enterprise 权限及有效抓取数据。

audience.en: Organizations analyzing AI-referred traffic within an enterprise website-analytics workflow.
audience.zh: 需要在企业网站分析流程中研究 AI 引荐流量的组织。

description.en: Within an enterprise analytics workflow, segment recognized AI referrals to review traffic trends, while accounting for visits that lack referrer information.
description.zh: 在企业网站分析流程中，细分已识别的 AI 引荐访问以复查流量趋势，并考虑缺少来源信息而无法归因的访问。

summary.en: Segment recognized AI referrals in enterprise analytics.
summary.zh: 在企业分析中细分已识别的 AI 引荐。

label.en: Siteimprove AI referral detection and limitations
label.zh: Siteimprove AI 引荐识别及限制

label.en: Siteimprove subscription fees and service orders
label.zh: Siteimprove 订阅费用与服务订单

description.en: Pricing is provided through a sales agreement or tailored package. No fixed public amount for this feature was verified; confirm the monitoring scope, required integrations and contract term in the quote.
description.zh: 费用通过销售协议或定制方案确定。本轮未核实到该功能的固定公开金额，需在报价中确认监测范围、必要集成和合同期限。

summary.en: Contract quote; confirm analytics scope and required integrations.
summary.zh: 合同询价，确认分析范围与必要集成。

description.en: Attribution depends on available referrer information and misses visits without it. Subscription fees and service limits are set in a sales order.
description.zh: 归因依赖可用的引荐信息，无法识别缺少该信息的访问；订阅费用和服务限制由销售订单确定。

summary.en: Missing referrers limit attribution; fees and service limits are contractual.
summary.zh: 缺少引荐信息会限制归因；费用和额度由合同约定。

description.en: Choose it for an existing enterprise analytics workflow that needs recognized AI referral segments. Confirm SEO Enterprise and crawl requirements for the additional dashboard modules before comparing package costs.
description.zh: 它适合在既有企业分析流程中增加已识别 AI 引荐细分。比较套餐成本前，应核对附加看板模块的 SEO Enterprise 及抓取前提。

description.en: Audit whether AI agents can discover, access and read a website from a browser extension.
description.zh: 通过浏览器扩展检查 AI Agent 能否发现、访问和读取网站。

en: Inspect robots.txt, sitemaps, structured data and content that depends on JavaScript.
Check AI crawler access rules and agent-facing discovery signals, with evidence and suggested fixes.
zh: 检查 robots.txt、站点地图、结构化数据及依赖 JavaScript 的内容。
检查 AI 爬虫访问规则与面向 Agent 的发现信号，并提供证据及修复建议。

audience.en: Website owners, developers and technical SEO teams auditing AI access and content readability.
audience.zh: 需要检查 AI 访问和内容可读性的网站所有者、开发者及技术 SEO 团队。

description.en: Before handing technical issues to developers, inspect AI crawler rules and JavaScript-dependent content, then export the evidence and suggested fixes.
description.zh: 向开发者提交技术问题前，检查 AI 爬虫规则与依赖 JavaScript 的内容，再导出证据和修复建议。

summary.en: Audit crawler rules and JavaScript content; export fixes.
summary.zh: 诊断爬虫规则与 JS 内容，导出修复证据。

label.en: Sitebulb Labs official extension and checks
label.zh: Sitebulb Labs 官方扩展与检查项

label.en: Sitebulb Labs local processing and external requests
label.zh: Sitebulb Labs 本地处理与外部请求说明

description.en: The documentation and FAQ describe installation, checks and data handling but publish no pricing model, amount or free-tier statement. Confirm availability and pricing with Sitebulb before treating the extension as a free service.
description.zh: 文档与 FAQ 介绍安装、检查项和数据处理，但未公布计费模式、金额或免费声明；将该扩展视为免费服务前，应向 Sitebulb 确认可用范围与价格。

summary.en: Pricing model and current amount unconfirmed.
summary.zh: 计费模式及当前金额均待确认。

description.en: Export findings as Markdown, CSV or JSON. Checks run in the browser; emerging checks are off by default, return N/A instead of Fail when a standard is not detected, and can send a hostname to Cloudflare when enabled. Public documentation does not clearly state a pricing model.
description.zh: 可导出 Markdown、CSV 或 JSON。检查在浏览器中运行；新兴标准检查默认关闭，未检测到标准时显示 N/A 而非失败，启用后可能向 Cloudflare 发送主机名。公开文档未明确说明计费模式。

summary.en: In-browser checks; emerging checks off by default, may send hostnames to Cloudflare. Pricing unclear.
summary.zh: 浏览器内检查；新兴检查默认关闭，可能向 Cloudflare 发送主机名；计费未明确。

description.en: Choose it for browser-based, page-level technical checks and evidence export. This audit workflow differs from ongoing brand-answer monitoring; review the extension's permissions and emerging-check data transfer before use.
description.zh: 它适合在浏览器内做页面级技术检查与证据导出，与持续品牌回答监测的流程不同。使用前需了解扩展权限及新兴检查的数据传输。

description.en: Monitor repeat prompt samples to compare brand mentions, citations and competitors in AI answers.
description.zh: 通过重复提示词采样，比较 AI 回答中的品牌提及、引用与竞品。

en: Use suggested or custom prompts and run each prompt multiple times to inspect visibility and average positions.
Compare competitor brands and investigate the sources cited in AI responses.
zh: 使用建议或自定义提示词，重复采样并分析曝光和平均位置。
比较竞品品牌，研究 AI 回答引用的来源。

audience.en: Marketers and small SEO teams starting with a limited recurring AI prompt set.
audience.zh: 从少量持续 AI 提示词监测起步的营销人员和小型 SEO 团队。

description.en: When starting a small monitoring set, use suggested or custom questions and repeated answer samples to compare brand positions, competitors and cited sources.
description.zh: 从少量问题开始监测时，使用建议或自定义问题及重复回答样本，比较品牌位置、竞品和引用来源。

summary.en: Start with a small, repeatedly sampled question set.
summary.zh: 用少量问题及重复采样开始监测。

label.en: Mangools AI Search Watcher features and engines
label.zh: Mangools AI Search Watcher 功能与引擎

label.en: AI Search Watcher monitoring guide and free-plan limits
label.zh: AI Search Watcher 监测指南与免费方案限制

description.en: The official guide documents a continuing Free plan with five monitored prompts and one monitor, updated weekly. Higher capacity is available through paid plans; a fixed current paid amount was not verified in the guide.
description.zh: 官方指南列出持续免费方案，含 5 个监测提示词和 1 个 monitor，按周更新。更高容量由付费方案提供；指南未核实到当前固定付费金额。

summary.en: Free: five prompts, one monitor, weekly updates. Paid amount unconfirmed.
summary.zh: 免费 5 提示词、1 个 monitor、每周更新；付费金额待确认。

description.en: The official guide documents an ongoing free plan with limited prompts and weekly updates, plus paid plans with larger monitoring allowances.
description.zh: 官方指南列出持续免费方案，提示词数量有限且按周更新；付费方案提供更高监测额度。

summary.en: Free tier has limited prompts and weekly updates; paid plans raise capacity.
summary.zh: 免费档提示词有限、每周更新；付费提高容量。

description.en: Use the five-prompt Free plan to evaluate a small recurring question set. Compare update cadence and repeated samples before upgrading, rather than assuming a free report offers the same capacity as a paid monitoring setup.
description.zh: 可用五提示词 Free 方案评估少量持续问题。升级前应比较更新频率和重复采样，不假设免费报告与付费监测配置容量相同。

description.en: Research AI brand mentions and cited sources, then compare competitors with custom prompt monitoring.
description.zh: 研究 AI 品牌提及与引用来源，并用自定义提示词监测比较竞品。

en: Explore brand mentions, cited URLs and the entities or competitors appearing in the same answer context.
Track selected prompts over time and organize them by topic, model or campaign.
zh: 研究品牌提及、引用 URL，以及相同回答语境中的实体和竞品。
持续监测选定提示词，按主题、模型或营销活动组织分析。

audience.en: SEO and brand teams comparing AI answer visibility alongside an existing search-analysis workflow.
audience.zh: 需要在现有搜索分析流程中比较 AI 回答曝光的 SEO 与品牌团队。

description.en: When reviewing a campaign or topic, organize recurring prompts and investigate which entities, competitors and cited URLs appear in the same answer context.
description.zh: 复盘营销活动或主题时，组织持续监测的提示词，调查同一回答语境中的实体、竞品和引用 URL。

summary.en: Research entities, competitors and citations by topic.
summary.zh: 按主题研究实体、竞品及引用。

label.en: SISTRIX AI Visibility product and tracked platforms
label.zh: SISTRIX AI Visibility 产品与监测平台
SISTRIX 自定义提示词监测指南

label.en: SISTRIX paid packages and AI beta conditions
label.zh: SISTRIX 付费套餐与 AI 测试条件

description.en: SISTRIX Start is €119/month plus taxes; Plus €239, Professional €419 and Premium €799. AI analysis is included as a beta in paid packages, rather than a separately verified free AI plan.
description.zh: SISTRIX Start 为 €119/月另加税，Plus €239、Professional €419、Premium €799。AI 分析作为测试功能包含在付费套餐中，不是已核实的独立免费 AI 方案。

summary.en: Start €119/month plus tax; AI beta included in paid packages.
summary.zh: Start €119/月另加税；AI 测试功能随付费套餐提供。

description.en: AI analysis is currently a beta inclusion in paid SISTRIX packages; included beta access and the time-limited trial are not a standalone free plan.
description.zh: AI 分析目前作为测试功能包含在 SISTRIX 付费套餐内；测试期包含和限时试用不代表独立免费方案。

summary.en: Beta inclusion and a trial do not establish a standalone free AI plan.
summary.zh: 测试期包含与限时试用不等于独立免费 AI 方案。

description.en: Compare how AI topic and prompt research fits an existing SISTRIX workflow. Beta inclusion in a paid SEO package is different from buying a standalone free AI tracker; review the package and additional-user costs.
description.zh: 应比较 AI 主题／提示词研究如何衔接现有 SISTRIX 流程。付费 SEO 套餐中的测试功能与独立免费 AI 追踪器不同，还需核对套餐及额外用户费用。

description.en: Connect AI visibility and citation insights with content briefs, drafts and refresh workflows.
description.zh: 将 AI 曝光与引用洞察接入内容简报、草稿和更新流程。

en: Use prompt research, source analysis and competitor gaps to plan content for AI search.
Generate and refresh content using company context, with content-agent and publishing capabilities depending on the plan.
zh: 结合提示词研究、来源分析和竞品缺口，规划面向 AI 搜索的内容。
利用企业背景生成并更新内容；内容 Agent 及发布能力取决于方案。

audience.en: Content and growth teams turning AI search research into ongoing editorial work.
audience.zh: 需要将 AI 搜索研究转化为持续内容工作的内容与增长团队。

description.en: When planning content work, combine prompt research, citation sources and competitor gaps, then review generated or refreshed drafts using company context.
description.zh: 规划内容工作时，结合提示词研究、引用来源与竞品缺口，再根据企业背景审核生成或更新的草稿。

summary.en: Turn prompt and citation research into reviewed content.
summary.zh: 将提示词及引用研究转化为经审核内容。

label.en: Cognizo AI search and content workflows
label.zh: Cognizo AI 搜索与内容工作流

label.en: Cognizo plan features and engine coverage
label.zh: Cognizo 方案功能与引擎覆盖

description.en: Growth is $499/month and Pro $999/month; Enterprise is custom-priced. Content output, monitored platforms and agent or publishing access depend on the package.
description.zh: Growth 为 $499/月，Pro 为 $999/月，Enterprise 定制报价。内容产出、监测平台以及 Agent 或发布权限取决于套餐。

summary.en: Growth $499/month; Pro $999; Enterprise quoted. Content and agent access vary.
summary.zh: Growth $499/月，Pro $999，企业版询价；内容及 Agent 权限按档位。

description.en: Growth and Pro list five monitored AI platforms; Enterprise lists additional platforms and custom limits. Public plans are paid subscriptions.
description.zh: Growth 和 Pro 列出五个监测平台；Enterprise 提供更多平台及定制额度。公开方案采用付费订阅。

summary.en: Growth/Pro list five engines; Enterprise adds coverage/custom limits.
summary.zh: Growth／Pro 列出 5 引擎；企业版扩展覆盖及额度。

description.en: Select by the content production and publishing workflow as well as prompt monitoring. Growth and Pro list five monitored platforms, while expanded coverage and custom limits are an Enterprise consideration.
description.zh: 应同时按内容生产／发布流程和提示词监测选型。Growth 与 Pro 列出五个监测平台，扩展覆盖及定制额度则需评估 Enterprise。

description.en: Monitor brand visibility and competitor citations across Chinese and global AI answer engines.
description.zh: 监测品牌在中文及全球 AI 回答引擎中的曝光与竞品引用。

en: Compare brands on buyer-intent prompts and inspect visibility, sentiment, positions and cited sources.
Drill down from summary metrics to original AI answers and use daily updates, weekly reports and data exports.
zh: 围绕买家意图问题比较品牌，查看曝光、情绪、位置和引用来源。
从汇总指标下钻到原始 AI 回答，使用每日更新、周报和数据导出。

audience.en: Cross-border brands comparing AI search visibility in Chinese and international markets.
audience.zh: 需要比较中文与海外市场 AI 搜索曝光的跨境品牌。

description.en: When reviewing buyer-intent questions, compare brands on visibility and sentiment, then drill into original answers and cited sources to explain differences.
description.zh: 复盘买家意图问题时，比较品牌曝光和情绪，再下钻到原始回答与引用来源以了解差异。

summary.en: Investigate buyer-intent answers, sentiment and citations.
summary.zh: 研究买家意图回答、情绪与引用。

label.en: Geolix monitoring dashboard, platforms and plans
label.zh: Geolix 监测看板、平台与方案

label.en: Geolix product identity and market coverage
label.zh: Geolix 产品身份与市场覆盖

description.en: Monthly dashboard plans are US$119, US$239 and US$479, with 5,000, 10,000 and 30,000 credits. Additional engines are US$29 each per month. Managed GEO services are a separate purchase.
description.zh: 看板月付方案分别为 119、239、479 美元，含 5,000、10,000、30,000 积分；额外引擎每个每月加 29 美元。托管 GEO 服务另行购买。

summary.en: Monthly USD 119/239/479 for 5k/10k/30k credits; extra engines USD 29/month each.
summary.zh: 月付 119／239／479 美元，含 5千／1万／3万积分；每加一个引擎另付 29 美元/月。

description.en: The monitoring dashboard has paid self-service plans with different engine limits. Managed services are separate; roadmap agents are not treated as available features.
description.zh: 监测看板提供付费自助方案，引擎额度随档位变化。托管服务另列，路线图中的 Agent 不视为已上线功能。

summary.en: Engines are tier-limited; managed services are separate; roadmap agents unavailable.
summary.zh: 引擎按档位；托管服务另购，路线图 Agent 未上线。

description.en: Compare the self-service dashboard separately from managed GEO services. Budget the required engine mix and credits; roadmap agents are not available features to include in a current comparison.
description.zh: 应将自助看板与托管 GEO 服务分开比较，按所需引擎组合和积分预算选型；路线图中的 Agent 不能计入当前已可用功能。

description.en: Track brand mentions, sentiment and citations alongside technical website crawl data.
description.zh: 结合网站技术抓取数据，追踪品牌提及、情绪与引用。

en: Organize custom prompts by topic and compare brand visibility, sentiment and competitors across selected AI models.
Inspect cited URLs and connect visibility gaps with crawl findings such as rendering, robots rules and structured data.
zh: 按主题组织自定义提示词，对比所选 AI 模型中的品牌曝光、情绪与竞品。
检查被引 URL，并结合渲染、robots 规则和结构化数据等抓取结果调查曝光缺口。

audience.en: Enterprise SEO and web teams linking AI answer monitoring with technical site analysis.
audience.zh: 需要结合 AI 回答监测与网站技术分析的企业 SEO 和网站团队。

description.en: When investigating an AI visibility gap, connect cited URLs and competitor answers with crawl findings such as rendering, robots rules and structured data.
description.zh: 调查 AI 曝光缺口时，将被引 URL 和竞品回答与渲染、robots 规则、结构化数据等抓取发现关联复查。

summary.en: Connect answer gaps with technical crawl findings.
summary.zh: 将回答曝光缺口关联技术抓取问题。

label.en: Lumar AI visibility metrics, platforms and crawl integration
label.zh: Lumar AI 曝光指标、平台与抓取集成

description.en: Pricing is provided through a sales agreement or tailored package. No fixed public amount for this feature was verified; confirm the monitoring scope, required integrations and contract term in the quote.
description.zh: 费用通过销售协议或定制方案确定。本轮未核实到该功能的固定公开金额，需在报价中确认监测范围、必要集成和合同期限。

summary.en: Tailored enterprise quote; cadence and modules must be scoped.
summary.zh: 企业定制询价，需明确频率与模块。

description.en: Monitoring cadence and the feature package are configured for the engagement; pricing is provided through a tailored quote.
description.zh: 监测频率和功能组合按合作配置，价格需获取定制报价。

summary.en: Monitoring cadence and feature bundle are engagement-specific.
summary.zh: 监测频率及功能组合按合作约定。

description.en: Choose by the need to connect answer visibility with technical crawl findings. Ask the tailored quote to specify monitoring cadence and the required technical modules, rather than assuming every Lumar engagement includes them.
description.zh: 应按是否需要将回答曝光与技术抓取发现关联来选型。定制报价需明确监测频率及所需技术模块，不假设每次 Lumar 合作均包含全部能力。

description.en: Find the sources behind AI answers and compare your brand visibility with competitors.
description.zh: 分析 AI 回答的来源，对比品牌与竞品的曝光表现。

en: Track prompts and inspect recorded answers, brand mentions, sentiment and cited sources.
Identify domains that influence answers and turn citation gaps into content and outreach recommendations.
zh: 追踪提示词，检查记录的回答、品牌提及、情绪与被引来源。
识别影响回答的域名，将引用缺口整理成内容与外联建议。

audience.en: Marketing teams and agencies researching citation opportunities across AI search engines.
audience.zh: 需要跨 AI 搜索平台研究引用机会的营销团队与代理机构。

description.en: When researching citation opportunities, inspect recorded answers and influential domains, then review suggested content or outreach actions before acting.
description.zh: 研究引用机会时，检查记录的回答与影响回答的域名，再审核建议的内容或外联行动。

summary.en: Research cited domains and review content/outreach suggestions.
summary.zh: 研究被引域名，审核内容／外联建议。

label.en: AIclicks answer collection, source analysis and engine coverage
label.zh: AIclicks 回答采集、来源分析与平台覆盖

description.en: The pricing page lists self-service monthly offers at $59, $189 and $499, plus custom enterprise pricing. Each plan has a three-day trial; prompt volume and model coverage differ by tier.
description.zh: 定价页列出 $59、$189、$499 的自助月度方案及企业定制报价。各方案提供三天试用，提示词数量与模型覆盖随档位变化。

summary.en: Monthly $59/$189/$499; enterprise quoted. Three-day trial.
summary.zh: 月付 $59／$189／$499；企业版询价，可试用三天。

description.en: Plans include different numbers of prompts and AI platforms; the free offer is a short trial rather than a continuing free monitoring plan.
description.zh: 各套餐的提示词和 AI 平台数量不同；免费入口为短期试用，不是持续免费监测方案。

summary.en: Prompt and engine caps vary; free offer is a short trial.
summary.zh: 提示词和引擎按档位；免费仅限短期试用。

description.en: Compare prompt and model allowances alongside citation-domain research. Treat content or outreach recommendations as suggestions to review, rather than verified implementation or a guaranteed visibility result.
description.zh: 应将提示词、模型额度与引用域名研究一起比较。内容或外联建议只是待审核的建议，不代表已完成执行或保证曝光效果。

description.en: Research competitors, citation sources and market gaps in AI search.
description.zh: 研究 AI 搜索中的竞品、引用来源与市场缺口。

en: Compare brand and competitor presence across market segments, regions and AI platforms.
Review original AI answers and citation URLs to investigate missing coverage and content opportunities.
zh: 跨市场细分、地区与 AI 平台比较品牌和竞品的呈现。
查看原始 AI 回答与引用 URL，调查覆盖缺口与内容机会。

audience.en: Brand strategists and agencies comparing AI search markets and competitive coverage.
audience.zh: 需要比较 AI 搜索市场与竞争覆盖的品牌策略团队和代理机构。

description.en: When comparing markets, review brand and competitor presence by segment, region and engine, then inspect original answers and citation URLs for context.
description.zh: 比较市场时，按细分、地区和引擎复查品牌与竞品呈现，再查看原始回答和引用 URL 了解上下文。

summary.en: Compare markets using original answers and citation URLs.
summary.zh: 用原始回答和引用 URL 比较市场。

label.en: Dageno market and AI visibility product overview
label.zh: Dageno 市场与 AI 曝光产品概述

label.en: Dageno plan capabilities, engine coverage and trial
label.zh: Dageno 套餐能力、平台覆盖与试用

description.en: The public offer lists Starter at $49/month, marked down from $89, Growth at $199/month and Scale at $410/month. The Starter amount is a displayed promotion, not a guaranteed permanent price.
description.zh: 公开显示 Starter $49/月，旁列原价 $89；Growth $199/月，Scale $410/月。Starter 为本次页面显示的促销金额，不代表永久价格。

summary.en: Promotional Starter $49/month (was $89); Growth $199; Scale $410.
summary.zh: Starter 促销 $49/月（原 $89）；Growth $199；Scale $410。

description.en: Starter focuses on single-brand research; recurring reports, MCP, API and multi-brand workflows depend on the paid plan. Standard engine coverage differs from custom Alexa integrations.
description.zh: Starter 侧重单品牌研究；定期报告、MCP、API 和多品牌流程取决于付费方案。标准平台覆盖与 Alexa 定制集成分开。

summary.en: Starter is single-brand; recurring reports/API/multi-brand vary by plan. Alexa is custom.
summary.zh: Starter 侧重单品牌；报表／API／多品牌按档位，Alexa 为定制集成。

description.en: Starter is positioned for one-brand research; recurring reporting and multi-brand or API workflows depend on higher packages. Compare the actual research and operating scope, not a promotional entry amount alone.
description.zh: Starter 面向单品牌研究，定期报表、多品牌及 API 流程取决于更高套餐。应比较实际研究与运营范围，不只比较促销入门金额。

description.en: Track which local businesses AI recommends and compare their appearance rates and positions.
description.zh: 追踪 AI 推荐了哪些本地商家，对比出现比例与位置。

en: Monitor local business recommendations for selected prompts and locations, including appearance rates and answer positions.
Compare recommended businesses and investigate which competitors appear instead of your own location.
zh: 按所选提示词和地区监测本地商家推荐，查看出现比例及回答中的位置。
比较被推荐商家，调查哪些竞品取代了自有门店。

audience.en: Local businesses and agencies comparing AI recommendations for individual markets.
audience.zh: 需要按市场比较 AI 本地推荐的商家与代理机构。

description.en: When assessing one local market, monitor location-specific recommendations and investigate which businesses appear instead of your own store.
description.zh: 评估单个本地市场时，监测特定地区的商家推荐，调查哪些商家取代了自有门店。

summary.en: Compare location-specific business recommendations.
summary.zh: 比较指定地区的商家推荐。

label.en: Radarkit Local Radar recommendation metrics and platforms
label.zh: Radarkit Local Radar 推荐指标与平台

label.en: Radarkit plans, locations and free trial
label.zh: Radarkit 套餐、地区与免费试用

description.en: The suite's monthly Lite, Growth and Pro prices are $29, $79 and $139. Local Radar is part of the broader suite; check its location and prompt allowances rather than assuming the headline price buys unlimited local tracking.
description.zh: 套件 Lite、Growth、Pro 月付分别为 $29、$79、$139。Local Radar 属于更广的套件，应核对其门店和提示词额度，不能把起步价理解为无限本地追踪。

summary.en: Suite Lite $29/month, Growth $79, Pro $139; local-tracking quotas vary.
summary.zh: 套件 Lite $29/月、Growth $79、Pro $139；本地追踪额度按档位。

description.en: Local Radar names ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews; the wider Radarkit suite covers more engines. Tracking limits depend on the subscription, with a limited free trial.
description.zh: Local Radar 明确列出 ChatGPT、Google AI Mode 和 AI Overviews；Radarkit 整体套件覆盖更多平台。追踪额度随订阅变化，免费入口为限时试用。

summary.en: Local Radar lists three engines, not the full suite's coverage. Limited trial.
summary.zh: Local Radar 列出 3 个引擎，不等于套件全部覆盖；限时试用。

description.en: Compare Local Radar's three documented AI platforms and location coverage, not the broader suite's total engine count. Map or traditional ranking features are a separate selection dimension.
description.zh: 应比较 Local Radar 已说明的三个 AI 平台及地区覆盖，而非采用整套产品的引擎总数。地图或传统排名功能属于另一个选型维度。

description.en: Inspect AI answer sources, brand mentions and sentiment alongside competitor visibility.
description.zh: 结合竞品曝光，检查 AI 回答的来源、品牌提及与情绪。

en: Track prompts, brand mentions, cited pages and domains across supported AI search platforms.
Compare citation frequency and competitor presence, and share read-only dashboards or access metrics through the AI Visibility API.
zh: 跨受支持的 AI 搜索平台追踪提示词、品牌提及、被引页面和域名。
对比引用频率与竞品呈现，分享只读看板或通过 AI Visibility API 获取指标。

audience.en: SEO agencies and in-house teams explaining AI citations and brand representation to clients.
audience.zh: 需要向客户解释 AI 引用和品牌呈现的 SEO 代理机构与内部团队。

description.en: When explaining AI citations to a client, compare cited pages and competitor presence and share a read-only dashboard of the findings.
description.zh: 向客户解释 AI 引用情况时，对比被引页面与竞品呈现，并分享只读看板供其查看。

summary.en: Share client dashboards of citations and competitors.
summary.zh: 向客户分享引用及竞品看板。

label.en: Keyword.com AI mentions, citations and reporting
label.zh: Keyword.com AI 提及、引用与报告

label.en: Keyword.com standalone AI Visibility plans and credits
label.zh: Keyword.com 独立 AI Visibility 方案与积分

description.en: Standalone AI Visibility starts at $9.80/month or $94/year (displayed as $7.83/month). The $4/month Search Visibility offer is Google keyword tracking, not the same AI plan.
description.zh: 独立 AI Visibility 从 $9.80/月起，或年付 $94（页面折算 $7.83/月）。$4/月的 Search Visibility 是 Google 关键词追踪，不是同一个 AI 方案。

summary.en: AI Visibility from $9.80/month or $94/year; $4 Google-only plan is separate.
summary.zh: AI Visibility 从 $9.80/月或 $94/年起；$4 Google 专用方案另列。

description.en: AI Visibility is available as a paid standalone plan or within a combined subscription; prompt checks use credits and the free trial has a time limit.
description.zh: AI Visibility 提供独立付费方案，也可随组合订阅使用；提示词检查消耗积分，免费试用有时限。

summary.en: Standalone/combined paid plans; prompt checks consume credits. Limited trial.
summary.zh: 可独购或组合；提示词消耗积分，试用有时限。

description.en: Choose standalone AI Visibility for AI-only research or the combined 360° plan when Google rankings are also needed. Compare prompt credits and the separate white-label add-on rather than the cheapest Google-only offer.
description.zh: 仅做 AI 研究可比较独立 AI Visibility，同时需要 Google 排名时比较 360° 组合。应核对提示词积分和独立白标附加项，不采用最低的 Google 专用报价作比较。

description.en: Analyze server-side AI crawler traffic separately from human website visits.
description.zh: 通过服务器端数据分析 AI 爬虫流量，并与真人访问分开。

en: Filter server-side requests by AI bot category and investigate frequently crawled pages and response status.
Use supported CDN log integrations; Cloudflare Logpush requires an Enterprise plan, while the Worker method works on any Cloudflare plan.
zh: 按 AI 爬虫类别筛选服务器端请求，调查常被抓取的页面与响应状态。
使用受支持的 CDN 日志集成；Cloudflare Logpush 需 Enterprise，Worker 方式可用于任意 Cloudflare 方案。

audience.en: Technical SEO and publishing teams investigating AI bot access to their own content.
audience.zh: 需要调查 AI 爬虫如何访问自有内容的技术 SEO 与出版团队。

description.en: With a supported CDN log integration in place, inspect frequently crawled pages and response codes to troubleshoot AI bot access, separately from answer citations.
description.zh: 接入受支持的 CDN 日志后，检查常被抓取的页面与响应码以排查 AI 爬虫访问，并与回答引用分开判断。

summary.en: Inspect AI bot access, crawled pages and response codes.
summary.zh: 检查 AI 爬虫访问、被抓页面与响应码。

label.en: Ahrefs Bot Analytics scope, beta access and integrations
label.zh: Ahrefs Bot Analytics 范围、测试版使用条件与集成

label.en: Ahrefs bot reports, integration prerequisites and verification limits
label.zh: Ahrefs 爬虫报告、集成前提与验证限制
Ahrefs Web Analytics 选型比较依据

description.en: Ahrefs states that Bot Analytics is included at no extra charge during beta on paid Ahrefs plans. A paid Ahrefs subscription and any external log infrastructure costs remain separate considerations.
description.zh: Ahrefs 说明 Bot Analytics 在测试期内包含于付费 Ahrefs 方案，不额外收费；仍需考虑 Ahrefs 订阅及外部日志基础设施费用。

summary.en: Included during beta with paid Ahrefs plans; external log costs may apply.
summary.zh: 测试期随付费 Ahrefs 套餐提供；外部日志可能另收费。

description.en: Bot verification uses known IP ranges and Cloudflare verification where available. The beta is included with paid Ahrefs plans; bot access alone does not confirm an answer citation.
description.zh: 在资料可用时通过已知 IP 段与 Cloudflare 验证核对爬虫；测试版包含在付费 Ahrefs 套餐内，爬虫访问本身不能证明回答已引用。

summary.en: Known-IP/Cloudflare checks where available; bot visits do not prove answer citations.
summary.zh: 按可用 IP／Cloudflare 核对爬虫；访问不证明回答引用。

description.en: Choose Bot Analytics for server-side bot requests; choose Ahrefs Web Analytics for human referrals and events. Compare log-integration prerequisites and the paid Ahrefs requirement separately from Web Analytics' free event allowance.
description.zh: 研究服务器端爬虫请求时选择 Bot Analytics，真人引荐与事件使用 Ahrefs Web Analytics。日志集成前提及付费 Ahrefs 要求，应与 Web Analytics 的免费事件额度分开比较。

description.en: Monitor selected AI search prompts and turn visibility gaps into content recommendations.
description.zh: 监测所选 AI 搜索提示词，将曝光缺口整理成内容建议。

en: Track brand visibility and competitor share of voice across ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity for selected prompts.
Use suggested prompts and inspect citation pages and domains to prioritize content to create or update.
zh: 按所选提示词追踪品牌在 ChatGPT、Gemini 和 Perplexity 中的曝光与竞品声量份额。
使用建议提示词，检查被引页面和域名，确定需优先新建或更新的内容。

audience.en: Marketing teams building recurring AI prompt monitoring and content review workflows.
audience.zh: 需要建立持续 AI 提示词监测与内容复核流程的营销团队。

description.en: For recurring content reviews, track selected buying questions and use cited pages and competitor voice share to prioritize what to create or update.
description.zh: 定期复盘内容时，追踪选定的购买问题，结合被引页面与竞品声量份额，确定优先新建或更新的内容。

summary.en: Prioritize content with recurring prompts and citation reviews.
summary.zh: 依据持续提示词及引用复查安排内容。

label.en: HubSpot AEO functionality, platforms and purchase options
label.zh: HubSpot AEO 功能、平台与购买方式

label.en: HubSpot comparison of the one-time Grader and ongoing AEO
label.zh: HubSpot 一次性 Grader 与持续 AEO 的区别

description.en: The standalone AEO product is advertised at $50/month with no separate HubSpot subscription required. It is also included in eligible Marketing Hub plans; the free AI Search Grader is a different product.
description.zh: 独立 AEO 标价 $50/月，无需另购 HubSpot 订阅；也包含在符合条件的 Marketing Hub 方案中。免费的 AI Search Grader 是另一项产品。

summary.en: $50/month standalone, or included in eligible Marketing Hub plans.
summary.zh: 独购 $50/月，或随符合条件的 Marketing Hub 套餐提供。

description.en: Available as a standalone paid product or in eligible Marketing Hub subscriptions. It provides continuing monitoring separately from the free, one-time AI Search Grader.
description.zh: 可独立付费使用，也包含在符合条件的 Marketing Hub 订阅中；提供持续监测，与免费的一次性 AI Search Grader 分开。

summary.en: Paid ongoing monitoring; free one-time Grader is separate.
summary.zh: 付费持续监测；免费的一次性 Grader 独立提供。

description.en: Compare its $50/month continuing monitoring with the free, one-time AI Search Grader. Choose by whether you need recurring prompts and citation review or only an initial brand-perception snapshot.
description.zh: 应将 $50/月持续监测与免费的一次性 AI Search Grader 比较。按是否需要持续提示词和引用复查，还是仅需初始品牌认知快照来选择。

description.en: Connect AI bot logs with technical crawl data to investigate content access and referral gaps.
description.zh: 结合 AI 爬虫日志和网站抓取数据，调查内容访问与引荐缺口。

en: Analyze AI search and user-bot requests alongside crawl metrics such as page depth, load time and structured data.
Examine a crawl-to-traffic funnel. Its citation metric counts selected AI user-bot visits with HTTP 200 or 304 responses, so it is a proxy for potential citation rather than a recorded answer link.
zh: 结合页面深度、加载时间和结构化数据等抓取指标，分析 AI 搜索与用户触发的爬虫请求。
检查抓取至流量的漏斗；其引用指标统计部分 AI 用户爬虫返回 HTTP 200 或 304 的访问，是潜在引用的代理指标，不是已记录的回答链接。

audience.en: Enterprise technical SEO teams correlating AI crawler activity with site health.
audience.zh: 需要将 AI 爬虫活动与网站健康数据关联分析的企业技术 SEO 团队。

description.en: When investigating AI crawler access, compare bot requests with page depth, load time and structured data; treat its citation metric as a potential-citation proxy.
description.zh: 调查 AI 爬虫访问时，将机器人请求与页面深度、加载时间和结构化数据对照；其引用指标仅作为潜在引用的代理指标。

summary.en: Relate AI bot requests to technical crawl metrics.
summary.zh: 将 AI 爬虫请求关联技术抓取指标。

label.en: Oncrawl AI Search Lens metrics and citation-proxy definition
label.zh: Oncrawl AI Search Lens 指标与引用代理定义

label.en: Oncrawl AI bot activity and crawl cross-analysis
label.zh: Oncrawl AI 爬虫活动与抓取交叉分析

label.en: Oncrawl subscription plans, premium Lenses and sales orders
label.zh: Oncrawl 订阅方案、高级 Lens 与销售订单

description.en: Pricing is provided through a sales agreement or tailored package. No fixed public amount for this feature was verified; confirm the monitoring scope, required integrations and contract term in the quote.
description.zh: 费用通过销售协议或定制方案确定。本轮未核实到该功能的固定公开金额，需在报价中确认监测范围、必要集成和合同期限。

summary.en: Sales-order quote for the required Lens and capacity.
summary.zh: 按所需 Lens 模块与容量签单询价。

description.en: The product lists ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Mistral and Gemini bot activity. Plans and premium Lens access are defined in the sales order.
description.zh: 产品列明 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Claude、Mistral 和 Gemini 的爬虫活动；方案与高级 Lens 使用权由销售订单确定。

summary.en: Bot activity across listed engines; premium Lens access is contract-defined.
summary.zh: 分析所列引擎爬虫活动；高级 Lens 权限以合同为准。

description.en: Choose it for linking server-side AI bot activity with technical crawl metrics. Its citation proxy based on successful bot requests differs from a prompt tool recording a link in an answer, so compare metric definitions first.
description.zh: 它适合将服务器端 AI 爬虫活动与技术抓取指标关联。基于成功爬虫请求的引用代理值，与提示词工具记录回答链接不同，应先比较指标定义。

description.en: Track daily AI prompt results with separate reporting for brand mentions and citations.
description.zh: 每日追踪 AI 提示词结果，分别报告品牌提及与引用。

en: Track custom prompts daily across six AI platforms, separating text mentions from links to your website.
Research new prompts and compare competitors, with white-label reports and integrations on supported plans.
zh: 跨六个 AI 平台每日追踪自定义提示词，区分文本提及和指向网站的链接。
研究新提示词并比较竞品，部分方案提供白标报告与集成。

audience.en: SEO agencies and internal teams managing recurring AI prompt checks and client reports.
