AI 可见性技能为 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Perplexity、Copilot 与 Google AI Overviews 构建按引擎的公开信号图，接入 Ahrefs Brand Radar 时使用其观测数据。
内含 12 个技能、5 个自主 Agent 与 3 个斜杠命令，在 Claude Code 中用自然语言触发。

audience.en: Developers and technical SEO practitioners who already work in Claude Code and want audits, schema and GEO fixes without leaving the terminal or IDE.
audience.zh: 已在 Claude Code 中工作、希望不离开终端或 IDE 即可完成审计、结构化数据与 GEO 修复的开发者与技术型 SEO 从业者。

description.en: Run a scored SEO + AEO + GEO audit of a site from Claude Code, then work through the flagged issues such as crawlability, Core Web Vitals, broken links and missing schema.
description.zh: 在 Claude Code 中对站点运行带评分的 SEO + AEO + GEO 审计，再逐项处理被标记的可抓取性、Core Web Vitals、死链与缺失结构化数据等问题。

summary.en: Scored 12-layer site audit with a fix list, inside Claude Code.
summary.zh: 在 Claude Code 内做 12 层评分审计并输出修复清单。

description.en: Review per-engine public web signals to estimate how visible a brand is across six AI engines, with disclosed sources and per-engine fixes, optionally enriched with Ahrefs Brand Radar observations.
description.zh: 复盘按引擎的公开网络信号，估算品牌在六个 AI 引擎中的可见性，披露来源并给出各引擎修复建议，可选用 Ahrefs Brand Radar 观测数据增强。

summary.en: Per-engine AI visibility estimates from public signals or Brand Radar.
summary.zh: 基于公开信号或 Brand Radar 的按引擎 AI 可见性估算。

description.en: Apply GEO rewrites to a draft or page, generate JSON-LD schema and llms.txt, and plan content clusters before publishing, all from natural-language requests in the terminal.
description.zh: 在发布前对草稿或页面应用 GEO 改写、生成 JSON-LD 结构化数据与 llms.txt，并规划内容聚类，全部通过终端里的自然语言请求完成。

summary.en: GEO rewrites, JSON-LD, llms.txt and content clusters from the terminal.
summary.zh: 在终端完成 GEO 改写、JSON-LD、llms.txt 与内容聚类。

label.en: Akii SEO & AI Search Optimizer repository README
label.zh: Akii SEO & AI Search Optimizer 仓库 README

description.en: The plugin is free under the MIT license for personal and commercial use, with no login, signup or usage cap. Skills run on the user's own Claude Code session model, so Claude Code access is a separate prerequisite; optional connected services such as Ahrefs or a PageSpeed Insights API key are also separate.
description.zh: 插件以 MIT 许可证免费开放个人与商业使用，无需登录、注册，也无用量上限。技能运行在用户自己的 Claude Code 会话模型上，Claude Code 访问权限是独立前提；Ahrefs、PageSpeed Insights API 密钥等可选接入服务也需另行获取。

summary.en: Free MIT plugin, no usage cap; Claude Code access and optional services separate.
summary.zh: MIT 免费插件，无用量上限；Claude Code 访问与可选服务另计。

description.en: Requires Claude Code CLI 2.0.x or later on macOS or Linux; Windows is untested and the hook uses POSIX bash (WSL suggested). All skills consume the user's Claude Code session model.
description.zh: 需要 macOS 或 Linux 上的 Claude Code CLI 2.0.x 及以上版本；Windows 未经测试，钩子使用 POSIX bash（建议 WSL）。所有技能消耗用户自己的 Claude Code 会话模型。

summary.en: Claude Code 2.0.x+ on macOS/Linux; Windows untested (WSL suggested).
summary.zh: 需 macOS/Linux 上 Claude Code 2.0.x+；Windows 未测试（建议 WSL）。

description.en: The AI visibility skill produces proxy estimates from public web signals or a connected Ahrefs Brand Radar MCP; it does not directly query ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot or Google AI Overviews, and does not provide continuous tracking or drop alerts.
description.zh: AI 可见性技能基于公开网络信号或已接入的 Ahrefs Brand Radar MCP 给出代理估算，不直接查询 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Perplexity、Copilot 或 Google AI Overviews，也不提供持续追踪或下降提醒。

summary.en: AI visibility is proxy estimation, not direct engine queries or 24/7 tracking.
summary.zh: AI 可见性为代理估算，非直接查询引擎或持续追踪。

description.en: Real backlink, keyword, Search Console and Core Web Vitals data depend on optionally connected MCPs (Ahrefs, Apify) or a PageSpeed Insights API key; without them the plugin falls back to Claude's built-in web tools. An anonymized telemetry ping is sent at most once per machine per 24 hours and can be disabled via environment variables.
description.zh: 真实外链、关键词、Search Console 与 Core Web Vitals 数据依赖可选接入的 MCP（Ahrefs、Apify）或 PageSpeed Insights API 密钥；未接入时回退到 Claude 内置网络工具。插件每台机器每 24 小时最多发送一次匿名遥测，可通过环境变量关闭。

summary.en: Real SEO data needs optional MCPs/API keys; anonymized telemetry can be disabled.
summary.zh: 真实 SEO 数据需可选 MCP/API 密钥；匿名遥测可关闭。

description.en: Choose this plugin when the workflow already lives in Claude Code and the goal is free, local audits, schema generation and GEO content fixes; its AI visibility output is a one-shot public-signal estimate. Teams that need directly queried engine answers, scheduled monitoring or client-facing dashboards should note those features are not part of the free plugin.
description.zh: 当工作流已在 Claude Code 中、目标是免费的本地审计、结构化数据生成与 GEO 内容修复时选择此插件；其 AI 可见性输出为一次性公开信号估算。需要直接查询引擎回答、定时监测或面向客户的仪表盘的团队应注意这些功能不在免费插件范围内。

description.en: AEO and GEO platform for B2B SaaS that tracks AI citations and ships prioritized prompt, content and citation fixes, with a cybersecurity prompt library.
description.zh: 面向 B2B SaaS 的 AEO 与 GEO 平台，追踪 AI 引用并给出按优先级排序的提示词、内容与引用修复建议，内置网络安全提示词库。

en: Track brand mentions and citations across up to 10 AI engines, with visibility score, presence rate, share of voice and Trust Score.
Generate LLM-optimized articles and publish them to WordPress, HubSpot, Webflow, Ghost or headless CMS.
Run an AEO audit that scores page AI-readability, plus on-demand Visibility Diagnosis and prompt mining.
Use a cybersecurity-focused prompt library, CVE and news monitoring, and page-level citation monitoring.
zh: 在最多 10 个 AI 引擎上追踪品牌提及与引用，提供可见性得分、出现率、声量份额与信任分。
生成面向 LLM 优化的文章，并发布到 WordPress、HubSpot、Webflow、Ghost 或无头 CMS。
运行 AEO 审计为页面的 AI 可读性打分，并支持按需可见性诊断与提示词挖掘。
提供聚焦网络安全的提示词库、CVE 与新闻监控，以及页面级引用监控。

audience.en: B2B SaaS and cybersecurity marketing teams that want AI citation tracking plus done-for-you content fixes.
audience.zh: 希望同时获得 AI 引用追踪与代做内容修复的 B2B SaaS 与网络安全营销团队。

description.en: Track how AI engines cite a B2B SaaS brand across a monitored prompt set, using visibility score, presence rate, share of voice and per-engine citation drill-down to see where the brand appears.
description.zh: 在受监控的提示词集合上追踪 AI 引擎如何引用 B2B SaaS 品牌，用可见性得分、出现率、声量份额与按引擎的引用下钻查看品牌出现位置。

summary.en: Track AI citations and visibility for a B2B SaaS brand.
summary.zh: 追踪 B2B SaaS 品牌的 AI 引用与可见性。

description.en: Close content gaps by generating LLM-optimized articles each month and publishing them to the CMS, guided by the AEO audit and prioritized remediation roadmap.
description.zh: 在 AEO 审计与按优先级排序的修复路线图指引下，每月生成面向 LLM 优化的文章并发布到 CMS，以补齐内容缺口。

summary.en: Generate and publish LLM-optimized articles to fix content gaps.
summary.zh: 生成并发布 LLM 优化文章以补齐内容缺口。

description.en: Individual is $99/month, or $79/month billed annually as $948/year: 100 prompts tracked weekly (counted per engine), 3 engines (ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, Google AI Overviews), 3 articles/month, a 50-page AEO audit, 1 Visibility Diagnosis/month and 1 seat.
description.zh: Individual 每月 99 美元，按年结算为每月 79 美元（每年 948 美元）：每周追踪 100 个提示词（按引擎计数）、3 个引擎（ChatGPT、Google AI Mode、Google AI Overviews）、每月 3 篇文章、50 页 AEO 审计、每月 1 次可见性诊断、1 个席位。

summary.en: Individual $99/mo ($79 annual): 100 weekly prompts, 3 engines, 3 articles, 50-page audit, 1 seat.
summary.zh: Individual 每月 99 美元（年付 79 美元）：每周 100 提示词、3 引擎、3 篇文章、50 页审计、1 席位。

description.en: Team is $499/month, or $399/month billed annually as $4,788/year: 200 prompts tracked daily, 4 engines (adds Perplexity and Microsoft Copilot), 10 articles/month, a 200-page audit, 5 diagnoses/month, Trust Score, share of voice, CMS publishing and 4 seats.
description.zh: Team 每月 499 美元，按年结算为每月 399 美元（每年 4,788 美元）：每日追踪 200 个提示词、4 个引擎（新增 Perplexity 与 Microsoft Copilot）、每月 10 篇文章、200 页审计、每月 5 次诊断、信任分、声量份额、CMS 发布、4 个席位。

summary.en: Team $499/mo ($399 annual): 200 daily prompts, 4 engines, 10 articles, 200-page audit, 4 seats.
summary.zh: Team 每月 499 美元（年付 399 美元）：每日 200 提示词、4 引擎、10 篇文章、200 页审计、4 席位。

description.en: Enterprise is custom-quoted: 1,000+ prompts monitored hourly, all 10 engines, unlimited articles, page-level monitoring up to 100K pages, and migration support from other tools. Both self-serve plans start with a 7-day free trial that requires a credit card.
description.zh: Enterprise 按需报价：每小时监控 1,000 多个提示词、全部 10 个引擎、无限文章、最多 10 万页的页面级监控，并支持从其他工具迁移。两个自助套餐均提供需绑定信用卡的 7 天免费试用。

summary.en: Enterprise custom: hourly 1,000+ prompts, all 10 engines, unlimited articles; 7-day trial needs a card.
summary.zh: Enterprise 按需报价：每小时 1,000+ 提示词、全 10 引擎、无限文章；7 天试用需绑卡。

description.en: AI engines are tier-gated: Individual covers 3 engines, Team 4, and only Enterprise includes all 10 (adding Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Claude, Brave Leo and Google AI Overviews).
description.zh: AI 引擎按套餐分级：Individual 覆盖 3 个引擎，Team 4 个，只有 Enterprise 含全部 10 个（新增 Gemini、DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Brave Leo 与 Google AI Overviews）。

summary.en: Engines are tier-gated: 3 on Individual, 4 on Team, all 10 only on Enterprise.
summary.zh: 引擎按套餐分级：Individual 3 个、Team 4 个、仅 Enterprise 全 10 个。

description.en: Prompts are counted per engine, so one prompt on three engines uses three of the quota; tracking frequency also rises by tier (weekly, daily, hourly).
description.zh: 提示词按引擎计数，因此一个提示词在三个引擎上会占用三个额度；追踪频率也随套餐提升（每周、每日、每小时）。

summary.en: Prompts count per engine; tracking frequency is weekly/daily/hourly by tier.
summary.zh: 提示词按引擎计数；追踪频率按套餐为每周/每日/每小时。

description.en: The prompt library and monitoring are oriented to B2B SaaS and cybersecurity (CVE and security-news tracking), which may not fit other verticals.
description.zh: 提示词库与监控面向 B2B SaaS 与网络安全（CVE 与安全新闻追踪），可能不适合其他行业。

summary.en: Prompt library and CVE/news monitoring are B2B SaaS and cybersecurity focused.
summary.zh: 提示词库与 CVE/新闻监控聚焦 B2B SaaS 与网络安全。

description.en: Choose Gracker when the buyer is a B2B SaaS or cybersecurity team that wants AI citation tracking bundled with done-for-you LLM-optimized articles and a security prompt library; note that engine coverage and tracking frequency are gated by plan, and the self-serve trial requires a credit card.
description.zh: 当买方是 B2B SaaS 或网络安全团队，希望把 AI 引用追踪与代做的 LLM 优化文章、安全提示词库打包使用时选 Gracker；注意引擎覆盖与追踪频率按套餐分级，且自助试用需绑定信用卡。

description.en: An AI agent that tracks the prompts AI engines answer about your brand, writes a reasoned action plan, and drafts articles you can publish to your CMS.
description.zh: 一个 AI 代理，追踪 AI 引擎就品牌回答的提示词，撰写带理由的行动计划，并起草可发布到 CMS 的文章。

en: Ask tracked prompts to AI engines daily from a chosen country and language, and keep each answer as given.
Generate an action plan where each action comes with its reason, plus draft articles in Content Studio.
Publish articles to WordPress, Webflow, Ghost or HubSpot, and connect via API, CLI or MCP server.
Optionally add Google Search Console, GA4 and AI-crawler tracking through a WordPress plugin or CDN snippet.
zh: 每天从所选国家与语言向 AI 引擎提问受追踪的提示词，并原样保留每条回答。
生成每项行动都附带理由的行动计划，并在 Content Studio 中起草文章。
将文章发布到 WordPress、Webflow、Ghost 或 HubSpot，并通过 API、CLI 或 MCP 服务器连接。
可选接入 Google Search Console、GA4，以及通过 WordPress 插件或 CDN 片段实现的 AI 爬虫追踪。

audience.en: Marketing teams and agencies that want an agent to turn AI visibility gaps into a reasoned action plan and draft content.
audience.zh: 希望由代理把 AI 可见性缺口转化为带理由的行动计划并起草内容的营销团队与代理商。

description.en: See where the brand stands by asking tracked prompts to ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini daily, reviewing the sources and pages the engines cite, and reading the agent's action plan.
description.zh: 通过每天向 ChatGPT、Perplexity 与 Gemini 提问受追踪的提示词、查看引擎引用的来源与页面，并阅读代理的行动计划，了解品牌现状。

summary.en: Track daily prompts and read the agent's reasoned action plan.
summary.zh: 每日追踪提示词并阅读代理带理由的行动计划。

description.en: Act on the plan by letting xSeek draft articles and publish them to a connected CMS, with each drafted article counted once in its billing month.
description.zh: 通过让 xSeek 起草文章并发布到已连接的 CMS 来执行计划，每篇起草的文章在其计费月内计数一次。

summary.en: Draft articles and publish them to a connected CMS.
summary.zh: 起草文章并发布到已连接的 CMS。

description.en: Essential is $49 USD/month: 15 prompts tracked daily on 3 engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini), 1 website, and no actions. A free workspace asks up to 15 questions once as a preview; daily tracking needs a paid plan.
description.zh: Essential 每月 49 美元：每天在 3 个引擎（ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini）上追踪 15 个提示词、1 个网站、不含行动。免费工作区一次性提问最多 15 个问题作为预览；每日追踪需付费套餐。

summary.en: Essential $49/mo: 15 daily prompts, 3 engines, 1 website, no actions; free workspace is a one-time 15-question preview.
summary.zh: Essential 每月 49 美元：每日 15 提示词、3 引擎、1 网站、无行动；免费工作区为一次性 15 问预览。

description.en: Starter is $149 USD/month: 50 prompts, 10 actions/month, article drafting and CMS publishing, plus API and MCP server. Growth is $499.99 USD/month: 150 prompts, 3 websites, 25 actions, 5 engines and 3 optional engines (Claude, Grok, DeepSeek).
description.zh: Starter 每月 149 美元：50 个提示词、每月 10 项行动、文章起草与 CMS 发布，外加 API 与 MCP 服务器。Growth 每月 499.99 美元：150 个提示词、3 个网站、25 项行动、5 个引擎及 3 个可选引擎（Claude、Grok、DeepSeek）。

summary.en: Starter $149/mo: 50 prompts, 10 actions, API+MCP. Growth $499.99/mo: 150 prompts, 3 websites, 25 actions, 5+3 engines.
summary.zh: Starter 每月 149 美元：50 提示词、10 行动、API+MCP。Growth 每月 499.99 美元：150 提示词、3 网站、25 行动、5+3 引擎。

description.en: Enterprise is custom with a monthly 1:1 AI-strategist session. All plans have unlimited seats, are billed monthly in USD or CAD with no minimum term, and Starter offers a 7-day free trial.
description.zh: Enterprise 按需定制，含每月一次与 AI 策略师的 1:1 会议。所有套餐席位不限，按月以美元或加元结算、无最低期限，Starter 提供 7 天免费试用。

summary.en: Enterprise custom; unlimited seats, monthly USD/CAD, no minimum term; Starter 7-day trial.
summary.zh: Enterprise 按需；席位不限、按月美元/加元、无最低期限；Starter 7 天试用。

description.en: Essential includes no actions or article drafting; the action plan, content and API/MCP start at Starter. Google AI Overviews and Copilot are only added from Growth, with Claude, Grok and DeepSeek optional per website.
description.zh: Essential 不含行动或文章起草；行动计划、内容与 API/MCP 从 Starter 起。Google AI Overviews 与 Copilot 仅从 Growth 起加入，Claude、Grok、DeepSeek 按网站可选。

summary.en: No actions on Essential; extra engines and API/MCP start at higher tiers.
summary.zh: Essential 无行动；更多引擎与 API/MCP 从更高套餐起。

description.en: Questions, answers and articles work in French and English, but the app interface is English-only for now.
description.zh: 问题、回答与文章支持法语和英语，但应用界面目前仅英语。

summary.en: Content supports French and English; the app UI is English-only.
summary.zh: 内容支持法语与英语；应用界面仅英语。

description.en: Choose xSeek when you want an agent that not only tracks AI answers but writes a reasoned action plan and drafts publishable articles; note the free workspace is a one-time preview, actions and API/MCP require Starter or above, and the interface is English-only.
description.zh: 当你希望代理不仅追踪 AI 回答，还撰写带理由的行动计划并起草可发布文章时选 xSeek；注意免费工作区为一次性预览，行动与 API/MCP 需 Starter 及以上，界面仅英语。

description.en: AI visibility platform that runs daily real-user checks across 8 AI engines, replays full answers, and turns mention rate, position, sentiment and citations into a ranked optimization to-do list.
description.zh: AI 可见性平台，每天以真实用户方式在 8 个 AI 引擎上检测，回放完整回答，并把提及率、位置、情绪与引用转化为按优先级排序的优化待办。

en: Check 8 AI engines daily as a real user (not via API) and replay the full answer behind each data point.
Measure mention rate, position, sentiment and citations, and compare against competitors.
Use the Optimization Engine (Beta) to get a Monday ranked to-do list and draft articles, then track citations after publishing.
Generate prompts, and connect via API and MCP.
zh: 每天以真实用户方式（而非 API）检测 8 个 AI 引擎，并回放每个数据点背后的完整回答。
衡量提及率、位置、情绪与引用，并与竞品对比。
使用优化引擎（Beta）获得每周一排序的待办清单与文章草稿，并在发布后追踪引用。
生成提示词，并通过 API 与 MCP 连接。

audience.en: Brands and agencies that want daily, replayable AI answer monitoring across many engines plus a prioritized optimization workflow.
audience.zh: 希望在多个引擎上获得每日、可回放的 AI 回答监控及按优先级排序优化流程的品牌与代理商。

description.en: Monitor how a brand appears across 8 AI engines with daily real-user checks, replaying each full answer to verify mention rate, position, sentiment and the cited sources.
description.zh: 通过每日真实用户检测监控品牌在 8 个 AI 引擎上的表现，回放每条完整回答以核实提及率、位置、情绪与被引用来源。

summary.en: Daily real-user checks across 8 engines with full answer replay.
summary.zh: 每日真实用户检测 8 引擎并回放完整回答。

description.en: Act on a Monday ranked to-do list from the Optimization Engine (Beta), draft articles, and track whether competitors' citations shift after publishing.
description.zh: 依据优化引擎（Beta）每周一排序的待办清单行动，起草文章，并追踪发布后竞品引用是否变化。

summary.en: Follow a ranked weekly to-do list and track post-publish citations.
summary.zh: 跟随每周排序待办并追踪发布后引用。

description.en: Starter is $19/month ($180/year): 1 brand, 10 prompts, any 4 of the 8 engines, 5 competitors per brand and 1-year history. Growth is $149/month ($1,428/year): 3 brands, 100 shared prompts, any 6 engines and 8 competitors.
description.zh: Starter 每月 19 美元（每年 180 美元）：1 个品牌、10 个提示词、8 个引擎中任选 4 个、每品牌 5 个竞品、1 年历史。Growth 每月 149 美元（每年 1,428 美元）：3 个品牌、100 个共享提示词、任选 6 个引擎、8 个竞品。

summary.en: Starter $19/mo ($180/yr): 1 brand, 10 prompts, 4 engines. Growth $149/mo ($1,428/yr): 3 brands, 100 prompts, 6 engines.
summary.zh: Starter 每月 19 美元（年 180）：1 品牌、10 提示词、4 引擎。Growth 每月 149 美元（年 1,428）：3 品牌、100 提示词、6 引擎。

description.en: Pro is $399/month ($3,828/year): 10 brands, 400 shared prompts and all 8 engines. Enterprise is custom with unlimited usage and a dedicated manager on quarterly or annual contracts. Annual billing saves about 20%.
description.zh: Pro 每月 399 美元（每年 3,828 美元）：10 个品牌、400 个共享提示词、全部 8 个引擎。Enterprise 按需定制，用量不限并配专属客户经理，按季度或年度签约。年付约省 20%。

summary.en: Pro $399/mo ($3,828/yr): 10 brands, 400 prompts, all 8 engines; Enterprise custom; annual ~20% off.
summary.zh: Pro 每月 399 美元（年 3,828）：10 品牌、400 提示词、全 8 引擎；Enterprise 按需；年付约省 20%。

description.en: A 7-day free trial covers all 8 engines without a credit card; there is no ongoing free plan. When the trial ends the account pauses with data kept, and resumes on subscribing.
description.zh: 7 天免费试用覆盖全部 8 个引擎且无需信用卡；无持续免费套餐。试用结束后账户暂停但保留数据，订阅后恢复。

summary.en: 7-day trial on all 8 engines, no card; no free plan; account pauses after trial, data kept.
summary.zh: 7 天试用全 8 引擎、无需绑卡；无免费套餐；试用后暂停并保留数据。

description.en: Prompts are shared across the account and cannot be purchased separately; Starter and Growth must choose a subset of engines (4 or 6), with all 8 only on Pro and Enterprise.
description.zh: 提示词在账户内共享且不能单独购买；Starter 与 Growth 须选择引擎子集（4 或 6 个），全部 8 个仅在 Pro 与 Enterprise。

summary.en: Prompts are account-shared; engine subsets on lower tiers, all 8 only on Pro/Enterprise.
summary.zh: 提示词账户共享；低套餐选引擎子集，全 8 仅 Pro/Enterprise。

description.en: The Optimization Engine is in Beta. Subscriptions auto-renew and cancellation is handled by emailing support.
description.zh: 优化引擎处于 Beta 阶段。订阅自动续费，取消需通过邮件联系支持。

summary.en: Optimization Engine is Beta; auto-renew with email-based cancellation.
summary.zh: 优化引擎为 Beta；自动续费、邮件取消。

description.en: Choose MaxAEO when you want daily real-user checks (not API sampling) with full answer replay across 8 engines and a ranked weekly optimization list; note there is no free plan, lower tiers pick an engine subset, and the optimization engine is still Beta.
description.zh: 当你希望以每日真实用户检测（而非 API 抽样）在 8 个引擎上回放完整回答，并获得每周排序优化清单时选 MaxAEO；注意无免费套餐、低套餐需选引擎子集，且优化引擎仍为 Beta。

description.en: AI visibility platform that tracks brand mentions across AI engines and automates the fix: drafted articles, an AI-ready hosted blog, and AI traffic analytics, with white-label agency workspaces.
description.zh: AI 可见性平台，追踪品牌在各 AI 引擎的提及并自动执行修复：起草文章、面向 AI 的托管博客与 AI 流量分析，并提供白标代理商工作区。

en: Track brand mentions and citations across up to 11 LLMs, with per-scan recommendations on higher tiers.
Draft articles and publish them to your CMS, LinkedIn and X, reformatted for Medium, Quora and Substack.
Run an AI-CMS hosted blog with JSON-LD, sitemap, llms.txt and RSS, connected via Cloudflare, GoDaddy or Vercel DNS.
Measure AI traffic from CDN logs, and manage clients in white-label agency workspaces on your own domain.
zh: 在最多 11 个 LLM 上追踪品牌提及与引用，更高套餐提供每次扫描的建议。
起草文章并发布到 CMS、LinkedIn 与 X，并为 Medium、Quora、Substack 重新排版。
运行带 JSON-LD、站点地图、llms.txt 与 RSS 的 AI-CMS 托管博客，通过 Cloudflare、GoDaddy 或 Vercel DNS 连接。
从 CDN 日志衡量 AI 流量，并在自有域名的白标代理商工作区中管理客户。

audience.en: Marketing teams and agencies that want AI visibility tracking plus automated content publishing and a hosted AI-ready blog.
audience.zh: 希望获得 AI 可见性追踪、自动化内容发布与托管 AI 就绪博客的营销团队与代理商。

description.en: Track whether AI engines name the brand for a prompt set, then follow per-scan recommendations and publish drafted articles to the CMS and social channels to close the gap.
description.zh: 追踪 AI 引擎是否在一组提示词中提及品牌，随后按每次扫描的建议行动，并把起草的文章发布到 CMS 与社交渠道以补齐缺口。

summary.en: Track mentions, follow scan recommendations, publish drafted articles.
summary.zh: 追踪提及、按扫描建议行动、发布起草文章。

description.en: Stand up an AI-ready hosted blog with JSON-LD, sitemap, llms.txt and RSS via DNS, and measure resulting AI traffic from CDN logs alongside the visibility data.
description.zh: 通过 DNS 搭建带 JSON-LD、站点地图、llms.txt 与 RSS 的 AI 就绪托管博客，并从 CDN 日志衡量由此产生的 AI 流量，与可见性数据并列查看。

summary.en: Launch an AI-CMS hosted blog and measure AI traffic from CDN logs.
summary.zh: 搭建 AI-CMS 托管博客并从 CDN 日志衡量 AI 流量。

description.en: A free plan tracks 9 prompts on ChatGPT, and new accounts start with an 8-day Accelerate trial without a card. Foundation is $87/month (ChatGPT only, 50 prompts, 10 articles/month, site and on-page SEO audit).
description.zh: 免费套餐在 ChatGPT 上追踪 9 个提示词，新账户享 8 天 Accelerate 试用且无需绑卡。Foundation 每月 87 美元（仅 ChatGPT、50 个提示词、每月 10 篇文章、站点与页面 SEO 审计）。

summary.en: Free plan: 9 ChatGPT prompts; 8-day trial no card. Foundation $87/mo: ChatGPT, 50 prompts, 10 articles.
summary.zh: 免费套餐：9 个 ChatGPT 提示词；8 天试用无需绑卡。Foundation 每月 87 美元：ChatGPT、50 提示词、10 文章。

description.en: Accelerate is $169/month (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok; 100 prompts per engine, 20 articles/month, per-scan recommendations, AI Traffic analytics). Authority is $493/month (6 engines adding Claude and Google AI Overviews, 200 prompts per engine, unlimited articles, collaboration). Yearly billing gives 2 months free.
description.zh: Accelerate 每月 169 美元（ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity、Grok；每引擎 100 个提示词、每月 20 篇文章、每次扫描建议、AI 流量分析）。Authority 每月 493 美元（6 引擎，新增 Claude 与 Google AI Overviews、每引擎 200 个提示词、无限文章、协作）。年付赠 2 个月。

summary.en: Accelerate $169/mo: 4 engines, 100 prompts each, 20 articles. Authority $493/mo: 6 engines, 200 each, unlimited articles; yearly 2 months free.
summary.zh: Accelerate 每月 169 美元：4 引擎、各 100 提示词、20 文章。Authority 每月 493 美元：6 引擎、各 200、无限文章；年付赠 2 月。

description.en: Agency is $399/month per client workspace plus a $99/month base; packs of 20/50/100 workspaces reduce the per-workspace price to $349/$299/$249 and waive the base. Enterprise is custom with 11 LLMs, API and SSO.
description.zh: Agency 每个客户工作区每月 399 美元，另加每月 99 美元基础费；20/50/100 个工作区的打包价将单工作区降至 349/299/249 美元并免基础费。Enterprise 按需定制，含 11 个 LLM、API 与 SSO。

summary.en: Agency $399/mo per workspace + $99 base; 20/50/100 packs $349/$299/$249 waive base; Enterprise custom 11 LLMs.
summary.zh: Agency 每工作区每月 399 美元+99 基础费；20/50/100 打包 349/299/249 免基础费；Enterprise 按需 11 LLM。

description.en: Engine coverage is tier-gated: Foundation is ChatGPT-only, Accelerate adds Gemini, Perplexity and Grok, Authority adds Claude and Google AI Overviews, and the remaining engines (AI Mode, Copilot, Meta AI, DeepSeek, Mistral Le Chat) are Enterprise-only.
description.zh: 引擎覆盖按套餐分级：Foundation 仅 ChatGPT，Accelerate 新增 Gemini、Perplexity、Grok，Authority 新增 Claude 与 Google AI Overviews，其余引擎（AI Mode、Copilot、Meta AI、DeepSeek、Mistral Le Chat）仅 Enterprise。

summary.en: Engines tier-gated from ChatGPT-only up to 11 on Enterprise.
summary.zh: 引擎按套餐分级，从仅 ChatGPT 到 Enterprise 的 11 个。

description.en: AI Traffic analytics requires Accelerate or above, and the hosted blog and social publishing depend on connecting DNS and CMS/social accounts.
description.zh: AI 流量分析需 Accelerate 及以上，托管博客与社交发布依赖连接 DNS 及 CMS/社交账户。

summary.en: AI Traffic needs Accelerate+; blog/social publishing need DNS and account connections.
summary.zh: AI 流量需 Accelerate+；博客/社交发布需连接 DNS 与账户。

description.en: Choose RankMonster when you want tracking plus execution — drafted articles, an AI-ready hosted blog and AI traffic analytics — and white-label client workspaces; a genuine free plan (9 ChatGPT prompts) lets you start small, but broader engine coverage and AI Traffic sit on higher tiers.
description.zh: 当你希望追踪加执行——起草文章、AI 就绪托管博客与 AI 流量分析——以及白标客户工作区时选 RankMonster；真正的免费套餐（9 个 ChatGPT 提示词）可小规模起步，但更广引擎覆盖与 AI 流量在更高套餐。

description.en: AI visibility platform that tracks brand mentions across 5 AI engines and then does the work: a ranked weekly fix plan, a content engine, a backlink-building agent, and Reddit/Quora and social distribution.
description.zh: AI 可见性平台，追踪品牌在 5 个 AI 引擎的提及，并代为执行：每周排序修复计划、内容引擎、外链建设代理，以及 Reddit/Quora 与社交分发。

en: Track 200 active prompts shared across brands on 5 engines, checked daily or weekly as set at onboarding.
Get a ranked fix plan every Monday, plus a content engine that ships 15 articles per calendar month to your CMS after approval.
Run a Backlink Building Agent and Reddit/Quora and social distribution, with an AI Video feature in Beta.
See AI traffic next to GSC and GA4, run technical audits and indexing checks, and connect via MCP and CLI.
zh: 在 5 个引擎上追踪跨品牌共享的 200 个活跃提示词，按入驻时设定每日或每周检测。
每周一获得排序修复计划，内容引擎在审批后每自然月向 CMS 交付 15 篇文章。
运行外链建设代理以及 Reddit/Quora 与社交分发，AI 视频功能处于 Beta。
在 GSC 与 GA4 旁查看 AI 流量，运行技术审计与索引检查，并通过 MCP 与 CLI 连接。

audience.en: Teams that want an AI visibility platform to execute fixes — content, backlinks and mentions — not just report them.
audience.zh: 希望 AI 可见性平台代为执行修复（内容、外链与提及）而非仅报告的团队。

description.en: Track where the brand is named across 5 AI engines on a shared pool of 200 active prompts, archiving prompts to free slots, and read the ranked fix plan delivered every Monday.
description.zh: 在 200 个活跃提示词的共享池上追踪品牌在 5 个 AI 引擎中被提及的情况，归档提示词以释放额度，并阅读每周一交付的排序修复计划。

summary.en: Track 200 shared prompts on 5 engines and read a weekly ranked fix plan.
summary.zh: 在 5 引擎追踪 200 共享提示词并阅读每周排序修复计划。

description.en: Let Snezzi execute: approve articles from the content engine (15 per calendar month to the CMS), run the backlink-building agent, and distribute via Reddit/Quora and social channels.
description.zh: 让 Snezzi 代为执行：审批内容引擎的文章（每自然月 15 篇交付 CMS）、运行外链建设代理，并通过 Reddit/Quora 与社交渠道分发。

summary.en: Approve content-engine articles and run backlink and mention distribution.
summary.zh: 审批内容引擎文章并运行外链与提及分发。

description.en: The platform is $500/month or $5,000/year (two months free): 200 active prompts shared across brands, all 5 engines included with no add-ons or credits, daily or weekly checks, 15 articles per calendar month to the CMS after approval, and no seat limit.
description.zh: 平台每月 500 美元或每年 5,000 美元（赠 2 个月）：跨品牌共享 200 个活跃提示词、全部 5 个引擎均含且无附加费或积分、每日或每周检测、审批后每自然月 15 篇文章交付 CMS、席位不限。

summary.en: Platform $500/mo or $5,000/yr: 200 shared prompts, all 5 engines, 15 articles/month, unlimited seats.
summary.zh: 平台每月 500 美元或每年 5,000 美元：200 共享提示词、全 5 引擎、每月 15 文章、席位不限。

description.en: The 7-day trial costs $10 and auto-moves to $500/month unless cancelled; there is no free trial. A done-for-you service starts at $1,999/month with a 3-month pilot minimum, the platform included, a dedicated manager and biweekly strategy calls.
description.zh: 7 天试用收费 10 美元，除非取消否则自动转为每月 500 美元；无免费试用。代运营服务每月 1,999 美元起，最少 3 个月试点，含平台、专属客户经理与双周策略会议。

summary.en: $10 7-day trial auto-converts to $500/mo; no free trial. Done-for-you from $1,999/mo, 3-month minimum.
summary.zh: 10 美元 7 天试用自动转每月 500 美元；无免费试用。代运营每月 1,999 美元起、最少 3 个月。

description.en: The 15-article quota is per calendar month with no rollover, and WordPress/Shopify imports do not count; prompts are a shared pool of 200 active slots that must be archived to free up.
description.zh: 15 篇文章额度按自然月计且不结转，WordPress/Shopify 导入不计入；提示词为 200 个活跃额度的共享池，须归档以释放。

summary.en: 15 articles/calendar month, no rollover; 200 shared active prompt slots.
summary.zh: 每自然月 15 文章、不结转；200 共享活跃提示词额度。

description.en: The trial is paid ($10) and auto-converts to the $500/month platform unless cancelled, so it is not a free evaluation.
description.zh: 试用为付费（10 美元）且除非取消会自动转为每月 500 美元的平台，因此并非免费评估。

summary.en: Paid $10 trial auto-converts to $500/mo unless cancelled.
summary.zh: 10 美元付费试用除非取消自动转每月 500 美元。

description.en: Choose Snezzi when you want the platform to execute fixes — a weekly ranked plan, a content engine, a backlink agent and Reddit/Quora distribution — rather than only report visibility; note the single $500/month platform price, the paid auto-converting trial, and the shared 200-prompt pool.
description.zh: 当你希望平台代为执行修复——每周排序计划、内容引擎、外链代理与 Reddit/Quora 分发——而非仅报告可见性时选 Snezzi；注意单一每月 500 美元的平台价、付费且自动续转的试用，以及 200 提示词共享池。

description.en: AI visibility tracking built for local businesses, checking whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI recommend you, alongside Google Business Profile, reviews and website health.
description.zh: 专为本地商家打造的 AI 可见性追踪，检测 ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude、Perplexity 与 Google AI 是否推荐你，并结合 Google 商家资料、评价与网站健康度。

en: Check every prompt on all 5 AI platforms with a weekly sweep plus daily slots, and read the real answers word for word.
Track competitors, Google Business Profile, reviews and website health, with a ranked action plan.
Run agencies on white-label plans with your own logo, colors and custom domain.
Start with a free 60-second audit of 45+ on-site signals, no account required.
zh: 以每周扫描加每日额度在全部 5 个 AI 平台上检测每个提示词，并逐字阅读真实回答。
追踪竞品、Google 商家资料、评价与网站健康度，并给出排序行动计划。
以白标套餐运营代理商业务，使用自有标志、配色与自定义域名。
从免费的 60 秒审计起步，覆盖 45 多项站内信号，无需账户。

audience.en: Local businesses and the agencies that serve them, wanting plain-language AI recommendation tracking tied to local SEO signals.
audience.zh: 本地商家及服务它们的代理商，希望获得与本地 SEO 信号挂钩、通俗表述的 AI 推荐追踪。

description.en: See whether AI engines recommend a local business when customers ask who to hire, reading the real answers across 5 platforms and tracking which competitors get named instead.
description.zh: 了解当顾客询问该雇谁时 AI 引擎是否推荐某本地商家，阅读 5 个平台上的真实回答，并追踪哪些竞品反而被提及。

summary.en: Check if AI recommends your local business and which competitors win.
summary.zh: 检测 AI 是否推荐你的本地商家及哪些竞品胜出。

description.en: Close the gap with a ranked action plan tied to Google Business Profile, reviews and website health, and monitor progress on a weekly sweep plus daily prompt slots.
description.zh: 通过与 Google 商家资料、评价和网站健康度挂钩的排序行动计划补齐缺口，并以每周扫描加每日提示词额度监控进展。

summary.en: Follow a local-SEO action plan and monitor on weekly plus daily checks.
summary.zh: 跟随本地 SEO 行动计划并以每周加每日检测监控。

description.en: Starter is $79/month (1 site, 50 prompts, 3 daily slots, 3 competitors, 2 seats, 30-day history). Growth is $249/month (3 sites, 150 prompts, 12 daily, 9 competitors, 5 seats, 90-day history). Enterprise is custom from about $599/month. Every plan tracks all 5 platforms.
description.zh: Starter 每月 79 美元（1 站点、50 提示词、3 个每日额度、3 竞品、2 席位、30 天历史）。Growth 每月 249 美元（3 站点、150 提示词、12 每日、9 竞品、5 席位、90 天历史）。Enterprise 按需约每月 599 美元起。所有套餐均追踪全部 5 个平台。

summary.en: Starter $79/mo: 1 site, 50 prompts. Growth $249/mo: 3 sites, 150 prompts. Enterprise from ~$599/mo; all 5 platforms.
summary.zh: Starter 每月 79 美元：1 站点、50 提示词。Growth 每月 249 美元：3 站点、150 提示词。Enterprise 约 599 起；全 5 平台。

description.en: Agency Starter is $349/month (8 client sites, 160 shared prompts, white-label and custom domain) and Agency Growth is $999/month (25 sites, 500 prompts); Agency Enterprise is custom from about $1,999/month. Annual billing is pay-10-get-12.
description.zh: Agency Starter 每月 349 美元（8 客户站点、160 共享提示词、白标与自定义域名），Agency Growth 每月 999 美元（25 站点、500 提示词）；Agency Enterprise 按需约每月 1,999 美元起。年付为付 10 得 12。

summary.en: Agency Starter $349/mo (8 sites), Agency Growth $999/mo (25 sites), Agency Enterprise from ~$1,999/mo; annual pay-10-get-12.
summary.zh: Agency Starter 每月 349（8 站点）、Agency Growth 每月 999（25 站点）、Agency Enterprise 约 1,999 起；年付付 10 得 12。

description.en: All plans start with a 14-day free trial (set up before adding a card) and include GBP/reviews/website health, an action plan and hard-stop limits; data is kept and there is a 7-day payment grace period.
description.zh: 所有套餐均含 14 天免费试用（先设置后绑卡），并包含商家资料/评价/网站健康度、行动计划与硬性上限；数据保留，且有 7 天付款宽限期。

summary.en: 14-day trial (setup before card), GBP/reviews/health and action plan included; hard-stop limits, 7-day payment grace.
summary.zh: 14 天试用（先设置后绑卡），含商家资料/评价/健康度与行动计划；硬性上限、7 天付款宽限。

description.en: Prompt, daily-slot, competitor, seat and history limits are hard stops per plan; extra capacity is bought as add-ons (e.g. a daily slot $12/month, a coverage pack $29/month, an extra site $49/month).
description.zh: 提示词、每日额度、竞品、席位与历史限制按套餐为硬性上限；额外容量需以附加项购买（如每日额度每月 12 美元、覆盖包每月 29 美元、额外站点每月 49 美元）。

summary.en: Hard-stop limits per plan; extra capacity via paid add-ons.
summary.zh: 按套餐硬性上限；额外容量需付费附加项。

description.en: It is focused on local businesses and 5 consumer AI platforms; it does not cover the broader engine set (e.g. Grok, DeepSeek, Copilot) that some general AI-visibility tools track.
description.zh: 它聚焦本地商家与 5 个消费级 AI 平台，不覆盖部分通用 AI 可见性工具追踪的更广引擎集（如 Grok、DeepSeek、Copilot）。

summary.en: Local-business focus on 5 platforms; no Grok/DeepSeek/Copilot coverage.
summary.zh: 聚焦本地商家的 5 平台；不覆盖 Grok/DeepSeek/Copilot。

description.en: Choose Lighthouse Local when the buyer is a local business or local-SEO agency that wants plain-language AI recommendation tracking tied to Google Business Profile, reviews and website health, with white-label client plans; note it covers 5 consumer platforms and uses hard-stop limits with paid add-ons.
description.zh: 当买方是本地商家或本地 SEO 代理商，希望获得与 Google 商家资料、评价和网站健康度挂钩、通俗表述的 AI 推荐追踪及白标客户套餐时选 Lighthouse Local；注意它覆盖 5 个消费级平台，并采用硬性上限加付费附加项。

description.en: A free GEO audit tool that crawls up to 50 pages and scores how citable a site is to AI search, with a weighted 0-100 score, block-level citability, a 14-crawler robots.txt report and per-engine readiness.
description.zh: 一款免费 GEO 审计工具，抓取最多 50 个页面并为网站对 AI 搜索的可引用性打分，提供加权 0-100 分、块级可引用性、14 爬虫 robots.txt 报告与按引擎准备度。

en: Crawl up to 50 pages via sitemap and internal links and compute a weighted 0-100 GEO score across six categories.
Score block-level citability on five dimensions and check robots.txt against 14 AI crawlers in three tiers.
Give five AI platforms their own readiness score, diff missing JSON-LD, and generate schema you can paste.
Export a PDF, share the report URL, or diff it against a later audit; a Quick Scan checks one page in about five seconds.
zh: 通过站点地图与内链抓取最多 50 个页面，按六个类别计算加权 0-100 GEO 分。
按五个维度为块级可引用性打分，并按三个层级对照 14 个 AI 爬虫检查 robots.txt。
为五个 AI 平台分别给出准备度得分，对比缺失的 JSON-LD，并生成可粘贴的结构化数据。
导出 PDF、分享报告链接或与后续审计对比；快速扫描约 5 秒检查单个页面。

audience.en: SEO and content teams that want a free, no-signup snapshot of how citable their site is to AI search before optimizing.
audience.zh: 希望在优化前免费、无需注册地快照网站对 AI 搜索可引用性的 SEO 与内容团队。

description.en: Before optimizing for AI search, run a free audit to see the weighted GEO score, which content blocks are citation-ready, and whether robots.txt blocks any of the 14 AI crawlers.
description.zh: 在针对 AI 搜索优化前，运行免费审计查看加权 GEO 分、哪些内容块已具备可引用性，以及 robots.txt 是否屏蔽了 14 个 AI 爬虫中的任何一个。

summary.en: Free snapshot of GEO score, citability and AI-crawler access.
summary.zh: 免费快照 GEO 分、可引用性与 AI 爬虫访问。

description.en: Fix schema gaps using the generated JSON-LD and per-engine readiness actions, then export a PDF or diff the report against a later run to confirm the change.
description.zh: 用生成的 JSON-LD 与按引擎准备度行动修复结构化数据缺口，再导出 PDF 或将报告与后续运行对比以确认改动。

summary.en: Fix schema gaps and diff audits to confirm improvements.
summary.zh: 修复结构化数据缺口并对比审计确认改进。

description.en: The GEO audit tool is free forever with no signup: up to 50 pages, the full six-category score, block-level citability, the 14-crawler report, per-engine readiness, generated JSON-LD, PDF and a shareable URL.
description.zh: GEO 审计工具永久免费且无需注册：最多 50 页、完整六类别得分、块级可引用性、14 爬虫报告、按引擎准备度、生成的 JSON-LD、PDF 与可分享链接。

summary.en: Free forever, no signup: 50 pages, full score, citability, crawler report, JSON-LD, PDF.
summary.zh: 永久免费、无需注册：50 页、完整得分、可引用性、爬虫报告、JSON-LD、PDF。

description.en: A free SEOmator account adds scheduled re-audits, crawler-rule change alerts and full-site crawls beyond 50 pages. The broader SEOmator platform is a separate paid product (Free plan plus Starter $49, Growth $99 and Scale $249 per month).
description.zh: 免费 SEOmator 账户新增定时复审、爬虫规则变更提醒与超过 50 页的全站抓取。更广义的 SEOmator 平台是独立的付费产品（免费套餐加每月 Starter 49、Growth 99、Scale 249 美元）。

summary.en: Free account adds scheduled re-audits and alerts; the wider SEOmator platform is separately paid ($49/$99/$249).
summary.zh: 免费账户增定时复审与提醒；更广 SEOmator 平台另行付费（49/99/249 美元）。

description.en: The crawler fetches raw HTML and does not execute JavaScript, so client-rendered sites are scored on their shell; the Core Web Vitals figure is estimated from HTML heuristics, not measured in a browser.
description.zh: 爬虫抓取原始 HTML 且不执行 JavaScript，因此客户端渲染网站仅按其外壳打分；Core Web Vitals 数值由 HTML 启发式估算，而非在浏览器中实测。

summary.en: Raw HTML only (no JS); Core Web Vitals is heuristic, not measured.
summary.zh: 仅原始 HTML（无 JS）；CWV 为启发式估算而非实测。

description.en: The five platform readiness scores are SEOmator's own rubric, not the engines' real weighting, and should be treated as a priority order rather than a forecast; the free audit is a 50-page snapshot, not a whole-site crawl.
description.zh: 五个平台准备度得分是 SEOmator 自己的评分标准，而非引擎真实权重，应视为优先级排序而非预测；免费审计是 50 页快照，而非全站抓取。

summary.en: Readiness scores are a vendor rubric, not engine weights; 50-page snapshot only.
summary.zh: 准备度分为厂商标准而非引擎权重；仅 50 页快照。

description.en: Choose SEOmator GEO Audit for a free, no-signup citability and crawler snapshot with a printed scoring formula and generated JSON-LD; note it reads raw HTML without JavaScript, estimates Core Web Vitals, and its per-engine readiness is a vendor rubric rather than a live prompt-visibility test.
description.zh: 需要免费、无需注册的可引用性与爬虫快照，并附公开计分公式与生成的 JSON-LD 时选 SEOmator GEO Audit；注意它读取原始 HTML 而不执行 JavaScript、估算 Core Web Vitals，且按引擎准备度是厂商评分标准而非实时提示词可见性测试。

description.en: An AI search visibility platform with an agent that tracks brand mentions and citations across ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI, then proposes projects, writes and publishes content and runs approved third-party outreach.
description.zh: 一款 AI 搜索可见度平台，内置代理追踪品牌在 ChatGPT、Perplexity 与 Google AI 中的提及与引用，并提出项目、撰写发布内容，以及在审批后开展第三方外联。

en: Monitor prompts every 24 hours on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, with Claude, Gemini and Bing AI Mode on request.
Find citation-level gaps, share of voice, competitor citation benchmarks and sentiment by product feature.
Let the Omnia Agent propose prioritized projects, write or rewrite content and publish it to your CMS after approval.
Draft third-party outreach emails and send them from your own inbox once approved, with API and MCP read/write on all plans.
zh: 每 24 小时在 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Google AI Overviews 与 AI Mode 上监测提示词，Claude、Gemini 与 Bing AI Mode 可按需开通。
发现引用级缺口、声量份额、竞品引用基准，以及按产品功能拆分的情绪。
由 Omnia Agent 提出排序项目、撰写或改写内容，并在审批后发布到 CMS。
起草第三方外联邮件，经批准后从你自己的邮箱发送；所有套餐均含 API 与 MCP 读写。

audience.en: Marketing and growth teams that want AI visibility tracking paired with an agent that carries out content and outreach work, across unlimited brands, languages and regions.
audience.zh: 希望把 AI 可见度追踪与代为执行内容和外联工作的代理结合起来，并覆盖不限数量品牌、语言与地区的营销和增长团队。

description.en: Track how often AI answers mention and cite a brand versus competitors, and see at citation level which sources and pages win the answer instead.
description.zh: 追踪 AI 回答提及和引用某品牌相对竞品的频率，并在引用层面查看哪些来源与页面反而赢得了回答。

summary.en: Track mentions and citations, and find citation-level gaps versus competitors.
summary.zh: 追踪提及与引用，并找出相对竞品的引用级缺口。

description.en: Turn findings into prioritized projects that the agent executes: content written or rewritten and published to the CMS, plus outreach emails to third-party sites, each sent only after approval.
description.zh: 把发现转化为由代理执行的排序项目：撰写或改写内容并发布到 CMS，以及向第三方网站发送外联邮件，每一步都需审批后才执行。

summary.en: Have the agent publish content and send outreach after approval.
summary.zh: 由代理在审批后发布内容并发送外联邮件。

description.en: Growth is €79/month (€63/month billed annually) with 25 prompts. Pro is €279/month (€223/month annually) with 100 prompts and adds Slack support and data exports. Enterprise starts at €499/month (from €399/month annually) with 200+ prompts and a dedicated manager with a 24-hour SLA.
description.zh: Growth 每月 79 欧元（年付每月 63 欧元），含 25 个提示词。Pro 每月 279 欧元（年付每月 223 欧元），含 100 个提示词，并增加 Slack 支持与数据导出。Enterprise 每月 499 欧元起（年付每月 399 欧元起），含 200 个以上提示词及 24 小时 SLA 的专属经理。

summary.en: Growth €79/mo (25 prompts), Pro €279/mo (100 prompts), Enterprise from €499/mo (200+ prompts); lower annual rates.
summary.zh: Growth 每月 79 欧元（25 提示词）、Pro 每月 279 欧元（100 提示词）、Enterprise 每月 499 欧元起（200+ 提示词）；年付更低。

description.en: Annual billing saves 20%, and every plan starts with a 14-day free trial without a credit card. All plans include daily monitoring, unlimited brands, languages and regions, the Omnia Agent, API and MCP access.
description.zh: 年付可省 20%，所有套餐均可先免费试用 14 天，无需信用卡。所有套餐均含每日监测、不限品牌/语言/地区、Omnia Agent、API 与 MCP 访问。

summary.en: 14-day trial without a card; annual saves 20%; agent, API and MCP on all plans.
summary.zh: 14 天试用无需绑卡；年付省 20%；所有套餐均含代理、API 与 MCP。

description.en: Plans are capped by tracked prompts (25, 100 or 200+), and data exports are only included from Pro upward.
description.zh: 各套餐按追踪提示词数量封顶（25、100 或 200 以上），数据导出仅自 Pro 起提供。

summary.en: Prompt caps per plan; data exports from Pro only.
summary.zh: 按套餐限制提示词；数据导出仅 Pro 起。

description.en: The default engine set is ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode; Claude, Gemini and Bing AI Mode are added on request, and engines such as Grok, DeepSeek or Copilot are not listed.
description.zh: 默认引擎为 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Google AI Overviews 与 AI Mode；Claude、Gemini 与 Bing AI Mode 需按需开通，Grok、DeepSeek 或 Copilot 等引擎未列出。

summary.en: Four default engines; three more on request; no Grok, DeepSeek or Copilot listed.
summary.zh: 默认 4 个引擎，另 3 个按需开通；未列出 Grok、DeepSeek 或 Copilot。

description.en: Choose Omnia when you want monitoring and execution in one subscription, with an agent that drafts content, publishes to the CMS and sends approved outreach, priced in euros with a no-card trial; note the prompt caps and that exports start at Pro.
description.zh: 当你希望用一个订阅同时完成监测与执行，并由代理起草内容、发布到 CMS 及发送经批准的外联邮件，且接受欧元计价与免绑卡试用时选 Omnia；注意提示词上限，以及数据导出自 Pro 起提供。

description.en: An AI search content platform that pairs visibility analytics (mention rate, citation rate, share of voice and cited pages) with a content studio and opportunity agents that write, publish and repurpose articles.
description.zh: 一款 AI 搜索内容平台，将可见度分析（提及率、引用率、声量份额与被引页面）与内容工作室及机会代理结合，撰写、发布并改编文章。

en: Track mention rate, citation rate, share of voice, pages cited and a competitor leaderboard.
Set up Deep IQ brand context, then draft articles in Content Studio and publish them to your CMS.
Run opportunity agents that turn visibility and content gaps into articles, with unlimited agent runs on every plan.
Repurpose articles into LinkedIn posts and newsletters, and export data via CSV or API.
zh: 追踪提及率、引用率、声量份额、被引页面与竞品排行榜。
设置 Deep IQ 品牌上下文，在 Content Studio 中起草文章并发布到 CMS。
运行机会代理，把可见度与内容缺口转化为文章，所有套餐均不限代理运行次数。
将文章改编为 LinkedIn 帖子与新闻简报，并通过 CSV 或 API 导出数据。

audience.en: Content and SEO teams that want to produce AI-citable articles at volume and measure the effect on AI search visibility in the same tool.
audience.zh: 希望批量产出可被 AI 引用的文章，并在同一工具中衡量其对 AI 搜索可见度影响的内容与 SEO 团队。

description.en: Find where competitors are cited or out-publish you in AI answers, then let opportunity agents draft articles from your Deep IQ brand context and publish them to the CMS.
description.zh: 找出 AI 回答中竞品被引用或内容量超过你的地方，再由机会代理基于 Deep IQ 品牌上下文起草文章并发布到 CMS。

summary.en: Turn competitor citation gaps into articles published to the CMS.
summary.zh: 把竞品引用缺口转化为发布到 CMS 的文章。

description.en: Measure whether published content raises mention rate, citation rate and share of voice, and repurpose winning articles into LinkedIn posts and newsletters.
description.zh: 衡量已发布内容是否提升提及率、引用率与声量份额，并把表现好的文章改编为 LinkedIn 帖子与新闻简报。

summary.en: Measure content impact on AI visibility and repurpose winners.
summary.zh: 衡量内容对 AI 可见度的影响并改编优质文章。

description.en: Pro is $99/month (ChatGPT tracking, 50 prompts, 20 articles and 1,500 pages analyzed per month). Grow is $199/month (ChatGPT and Perplexity, 100 prompts, 40 articles, 3,000 pages). Scale is $399/month (ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini, 200 prompts, 90 articles, 8,000 pages).
description.zh: Pro 每月 99 美元（追踪 ChatGPT、50 个提示词、每月 20 篇文章与 1,500 个页面分析）。Grow 每月 199 美元（ChatGPT 与 Perplexity、100 个提示词、40 篇文章、3,000 个页面）。Scale 每月 399 美元（ChatGPT、Perplexity 与 Gemini、200 个提示词、90 篇文章、8,000 个页面）。

summary.en: Pro $99/mo, Grow $199/mo, Scale $399/mo, scaling engines, prompts, articles and pages.
summary.zh: Pro 每月 99 美元、Grow 每月 199 美元、Scale 每月 399 美元，引擎、提示词、文章与页面逐级增加。

description.en: Enterprise is custom and covers all nine engines with multi-region tracking. Every plan includes unlimited agent runs and CSV/API export, with no contract and cancel-anytime billing; an annual option is offered, and trial terms are given at sign-up (the homepage advertises a 7-day free trial).
description.zh: Enterprise 按需定价，覆盖全部 9 个引擎并支持多地区追踪。所有套餐均含不限次代理运行与 CSV/API 导出，无合约、可随时取消；提供年付选项，试用条款在注册时说明（首页标示 7 天免费试用）。

summary.en: Enterprise custom with all 9 engines; unlimited agent runs and export on all plans; trial terms at sign-up.
summary.zh: Enterprise 定制含全部 9 引擎；所有套餐不限代理运行并可导出；试用条款注册时说明。

description.en: Self-serve plans track one region and only one to three engines (ChatGPT on Pro, plus Perplexity on Grow and Gemini on Scale); the other engines and multi-region tracking require Enterprise.
description.zh: 自助套餐仅追踪 1 个地区，引擎也只有 1 至 3 个（Pro 为 ChatGPT，Grow 增加 Perplexity，Scale 再加 Gemini）；其余引擎与多地区追踪需 Enterprise。

summary.en: Self-serve: one region and 1-3 engines; full engine set needs Enterprise.
summary.zh: 自助套餐：1 个地区、1-3 个引擎；全部引擎需 Enterprise。

description.en: Page-analysis credits reset monthly without carry-over and each page is charged once; article output is capped at 20, 40 or 90 per month by plan.
description.zh: 页面分析额度每月重置、不结转，每个页面计费一次；文章产出按套餐每月上限为 20、40 或 90 篇。

summary.en: Page credits reset monthly with no carry-over; monthly article caps.
summary.zh: 页面额度每月重置不结转；每月文章有上限。

description.en: Choose DeepSmith when content production is the main job and you want AI visibility metrics in the same place to steer and measure it; note that the lower self-serve plans watch only ChatGPT, or ChatGPT plus Perplexity, in one region.
description.zh: 当内容生产是主要工作，并希望在同一处用 AI 可见度指标来引导和衡量内容时选 DeepSmith；注意较低的自助套餐仅在一个地区监测 ChatGPT，或 ChatGPT 加 Perplexity。

description.en: A Chinese AI brand diagnosis platform that sells per-report GEO analyses of how DeepSeek, Doubao, Qwen, Yuanbao and other AI assistants mention, cite and describe a brand, with competitor and industry reports.
description.zh: 一款中文 AI 品牌诊断平台，按次出具 GEO 分析报告，呈现 DeepSeek、豆包、千问、元宝等 AI 助手如何提及、引用和描述品牌，并提供竞品与行业报告。

en: Diagnose brand visibility, citation share and answer consistency across 11+ AI assistants including DeepSeek, Doubao, Qwen, Yuanbao and Kimi.
Order reports from a 3-6 minute quick check to a 7-day dynamic tracking report with alerts.
Compare 1-3 competitors, or generate an industry GEO report on the competitive landscape.
Use the free 星盾 content fact check and SiteLens SEO/GEO website scan, plus Agent Skill and CLI access.
zh: 诊断品牌在 DeepSeek、豆包、千问、元宝、Kimi 等 11 个以上 AI 助手中的可见度、引用占比与回答一致性。
可选从 3-6 分钟的快速体检到含动态预警的 7 日动态追踪报告。
对比 1-3 个竞品，或生成呈现竞争格局的行业 GEO 报告。
可使用免费的星盾内容验真与 SiteLens SEO/GEO 官网探测，并支持 Agent Skill 与 CLI 接入。

audience.en: Brands and agencies in China that want a one-off or short-term diagnosis of their standing in domestic AI assistants without committing to a monthly subscription.
audience.zh: 希望在不签月度订阅的情况下，一次性或短期诊断自身在国内 AI 助手中表现的中国品牌与代理商。

description.en: Get a quick read on how domestic AI assistants describe and rank a brand, with exposure rate, recommendation rank, mention rate and citation sources, before deciding on a longer GEO programme.
description.zh: 在决定长期 GEO 投入之前，快速了解国内 AI 助手如何描述和排名某品牌，包括曝光率、推荐排名、被提及率与引用来源。

summary.en: Quickly diagnose a brand in Chinese AI assistants before a longer programme.
summary.zh: 在长期投入前快速诊断品牌在国内 AI 助手中的表现。

description.en: Benchmark a brand against one to three competitors, or follow it for seven days with alerts, to see how answers and citations shift across platforms.
description.zh: 将品牌与 1 至 3 个竞品对标，或连续追踪 7 天并接收预警，观察各平台回答与引用的变化。

summary.en: Benchmark competitors or track a brand for seven days with alerts.
summary.zh: 对标竞品或连续 7 天追踪并预警。

label.zh: 搜极星首页与方案对比

description.en: Reports are priced per order in CNY: the quick version is ¥19.9 per report (a promotional price, normally ¥99) with 9 metrics in 3-6 minutes; the professional version is ¥199 with 23 metrics and 1-3 competitors in 4-12 hours.
description.zh: 报告按次以人民币计价：极速版每次 19.9 元（促销价，原价 99 元），3-6 分钟交付 9 项指标；专业版每次 199 元，4-12 小时交付 23 项指标并支持 1-3 个竞品。

summary.en: Quick ¥19.9/report (promo, normally ¥99); professional ¥199/report.
summary.zh: 极速版每次 19.9 元（促销，原价 99 元）；专业版每次 199 元。

description.en: The 7-day dynamic analysis version is ¥399 per report (29 metrics, dynamic alerts and a 7-day dashboard) and the industry analysis version is ¥299 (89 industry metrics in 10-30 minutes); every tier includes an AI analyst.
description.zh: 7 日动态分析版每次 399 元（29 项指标、动态预警与 7 日动态看板），行业分析版每次 299 元（10-30 分钟交付 89 项行业指标）；各档均含 AI 分析师。

summary.en: Dynamic ¥399/report with 7-day tracking; industry ¥299/report; AI analyst in all tiers.
summary.zh: 动态版每次 399 元含 7 日追踪；行业版每次 299 元；各档含 AI 分析师。

description.en: It is sold as one-off reports rather than continuous monitoring; the longest built-in tracking window is the 7-day dynamic report, and ongoing work is offered as a separate managed service.
description.zh: 它以单次报告形式出售而非持续监测；内置最长追踪周期为 7 日动态报告，长期工作需另行采用托管服务。

summary.en: Per-report diagnosis; longest tracking is seven days.
summary.zh: 按次诊断；最长追踪 7 天。

description.en: The linked privacy policy is the shared policy of the operator, Zhuhai Biyou Technology, titled for its ChatPPT product rather than SOUGeo specifically; coverage focuses on Chinese AI assistants.
description.zh: 所链接的隐私政策为运营方珠海必优科技的共用政策，标题为其 ChatPPT 产品而非专门针对搜极星；覆盖重点为国内 AI 助手。

summary.en: Shared operator privacy policy, not SOUGeo-specific; China-focused coverage.
summary.zh: 共用运营方隐私政策，非搜极星专属；覆盖以国内为主。

description.en: Choose SOUGeo when you need a low-cost, one-off diagnosis of a brand in Chinese AI assistants, or an industry snapshot, without a subscription; for continuous daily tracking, pick a monitoring tool instead.
description.zh: 当你需要低成本、无需订阅地一次性诊断品牌在国内 AI 助手中的表现，或获取行业快照时选搜极星；如需每日持续追踪，应改选监测类工具。

description.en: An AIBase platform that monitors brand exposure, rankings and share in Doubao, DeepSeek, Yuanbao, Qwen, ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and other AI platforms, with competitor, topic and citation-source analysis.
description.zh: AIBase 推出的平台，监测品牌在豆包、DeepSeek、元宝、千问、ChatGPT、Google AI Mode 等 AI 平台中的曝光、排名与份额，并提供竞品、主题与引用来源分析。

en: Track brand exposure, ranking and share across up to 14 platform options: 11 desktop AI platforms plus mobile Doubao, Qwen and Yuanbao.
Monitor competitors per brand and compare where each one leads, by platform and by topic.
Map topics in an opportunity matrix of search demand versus brand visibility.
Trace the citation sources behind each mention, and use companion tools for question mining, one-off rank checks, brand scores and promoted-link checks.
zh: 在最多 14 个平台选项（11 个 PC 端 AI 平台加豆包、千问、元宝手机版）上追踪品牌曝光、排名与份额。
按品牌监测竞品，按平台与主题比较各自领先之处。
以搜索热度对比品牌可见度的机会矩阵梳理业务主题。
溯源每次提及背后的引用来源，并可配合问题挖掘、单次排名查询、品牌得分与推广链接检测等工具。

audience.en: Brands and marketing teams in China that need recurring monitoring of domestic and international AI platforms, with competitor and citation-source tracking.
audience.zh: 需要定期监测国内外 AI 平台，并追踪竞品与引用来源的中国品牌与营销团队。

description.en: Watch how a brand and its competitors appear in Doubao, DeepSeek, Qwen and other AI answers on a recurring schedule, and find platforms or topics where competitors lead.
description.zh: 定期观察品牌及其竞品在豆包、DeepSeek、千问等 AI 回答中的表现，找出竞品领先的平台或主题。

summary.en: Monitor a brand and competitors in Chinese AI answers on a schedule.
summary.zh: 定期监测品牌与竞品在国内 AI 回答中的表现。

description.en: Check which media channels and promoted links AI platforms actually cite, so content distribution budget goes to sources that shape AI answers.
description.zh: 检查 AI 平台实际引用了哪些媒体渠道与推广链接，让内容分发预算投向能影响 AI 回答的来源。

summary.en: Find which channels and promoted links AI platforms cite.
summary.zh: 找出 AI 平台引用的渠道与推广链接。

description.en: Plans are billed per 30 days in CNY: Starter ¥299 (1 brand, 5 platforms, data every 3 days, 30 monitored questions, 10 competitors) and Growth ¥699 (1 brand, 7 platforms, every 2 days, 15 competitors).
description.zh: 套餐以人民币按 30 天计费：入门版 299 元（1 个品牌、5 个平台、每 3 天更新、30 个监测问题、10 个竞品），成长版 699 元（1 个品牌、7 个平台、每 2 天更新、15 个竞品）。

summary.en: Starter ¥299/30 days (5 platforms); Growth ¥699/30 days (7 platforms).
summary.zh: 入门版每 30 天 299 元（5 平台）；成长版每 30 天 699 元（7 平台）。

description.en: Professional is ¥1,499 per 30 days (2 brands, 8 platforms, 20 competitors) and Flagship is ¥4,999 (3 brands, 14 platforms, 60 monitored questions per brand, 25 competitors). Each plan includes a one-off grant of credits (100 to 2,000), unlimited detail export and one-to-one consulting.
description.zh: 专业版每 30 天 1,499 元（2 个品牌、8 个平台、20 个竞品），旗舰版 4,999 元（3 个品牌、14 个平台、每品牌 60 个监测问题、25 个竞品）。各套餐均一次性赠送智能币（100 至 2,000），明细导出不限量，并含一对一顾问咨询。

summary.en: Professional ¥1,499 and Flagship ¥4,999 per 30 days; one-off credit grant and consulting included.
summary.zh: 专业版每 30 天 1,499 元、旗舰版 4,999 元；一次性赠智能币并含顾问咨询。

description.en: Data refreshes every two or three days rather than daily, and platform coverage depends on the plan (5, 7, 8 or 14 options), so lower plans see only part of the engine list.
description.zh: 数据每 2 至 3 天更新而非每日更新，平台覆盖按套餐分为 5、7、8 或 14 个选项，较低套餐只能看到部分引擎。

summary.en: Updates every 2-3 days; platform coverage depends on plan.
summary.zh: 每 2-3 天更新；平台覆盖按套餐而定。

description.en: Monitored questions are capped at 30 per brand (60 on Flagship), and platform changes, question status changes, AI question discovery and content generation each have monthly limits.
description.zh: 每品牌监测问题上限为 30 个（旗舰版 60 个），平台调整、问题状态调整、AI 问题发现与内容生成均有每月次数限制。

summary.en: Question caps per brand and monthly limits on adjustments and generation.
summary.zh: 每品牌问题有上限，调整与生成有月度限制。

description.en: Choose GEOBase when you need recurring monitoring that spans major Chinese AI assistants (including their mobile apps) and international engines, with competitor and citation-source views; note the 2-3 day refresh and per-brand question caps.
description.zh: 当你需要覆盖国内主要 AI 助手（含手机版）与海外引擎的定期监测，并查看竞品与引用来源时选 GEOBase；注意数据每 2-3 天更新，且每品牌问题数有上限。

description.en: An AI search visibility platform that tracks daily prompts across up to eight engines, breaks cited sources down by domain, and includes a Content Agent that researches and publishes articles to your CMS.
description.zh: 一款 AI 搜索可见度平台，每天在最多 8 个引擎上追踪提示词，按域名拆分被引来源，并内置内容代理，研究并撰写文章后发布到 CMS。

en: Run tracked prompts daily on ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, AI Overviews, DeepSeek, Perplexity, Gemini, Grok and Claude, depending on plan.
Track competitors, sentiment and source citations with a domain-level breakdown, plus Honeyb Recommendations.
Group tracking into workspaces per brand, product line, market or language, each with its own competitors and citations.
Let the Content Agent research articles from visibility gaps and publish them to WordPress, Ghost, Shopify, Webflow, Wix or a custom endpoint.
zh: 按套餐每天在 ChatGPT、Google AI Mode、AI Overviews、DeepSeek、Perplexity、Gemini、Grok 与 Claude 上运行追踪提示词。
追踪竞品、情绪与按域名拆分的来源引用，并提供 Honeyb Recommendations 建议。
按品牌、产品线、市场或语言划分工作区，每个工作区有各自的竞品与引用数据。
由内容代理根据可见度缺口研究选题，并发布到 WordPress、Ghost、Shopify、Webflow、Wix 或自定义接口。

audience.en: SEO and content teams that want low-cost AI visibility tracking with citation domains and built-in article publishing, from one engine up to all eight.
audience.zh: 希望以较低成本追踪 AI 可见度、查看引用域名并内置文章发布能力的 SEO 与内容团队，可从 1 个引擎起步，扩展到全部 8 个。

description.en: Track how a brand and its competitors appear in daily AI answers, and see which domains the engines cite for each workspace.
description.zh: 追踪品牌及竞品在每日 AI 回答中的表现，并按工作区查看引擎引用了哪些域名。

summary.en: Track daily mentions versus competitors and cited domains per workspace.
summary.zh: 按工作区追踪每日提及、竞品对比与被引域名。

description.en: Turn visibility gaps into researched articles that the Content Agent publishes to the CMS on a calendar or autopilot.
description.zh: 把可见度缺口转化为研究型文章，由内容代理按日历或自动驾驶模式发布到 CMS。

summary.en: Publish gap-driven articles to the CMS via the Content Agent.
summary.zh: 通过内容代理把基于缺口的文章发布到 CMS。

description.en: Monthly billing: The Minimum is $29/month (10 daily prompts, 1 engine, 1 workspace, 1 seat, 5 articles), Multi-Model $79/month (50 prompts, 3 engines, up to 5 workspaces, 15 articles) and Full Spectrum $199/month (100 prompts, all 8 engines, up to 10 workspaces, 30 articles). Annual billing saves 20%: $276, $756 and $1,908 per year ($23, $63 and $159 a month).
description.zh: 月付：The Minimum 每月 29 美元（每日 10 个提示词、1 个引擎、1 个工作区、1 个席位、5 篇文章），Multi-Model 每月 79 美元（50 个提示词、3 个引擎、最多 5 个工作区、15 篇文章），Full Spectrum 每月 199 美元（100 个提示词、全部 8 个引擎、最多 10 个工作区、30 篇文章）。年付省 20%，分别为每年 276、756、1,908 美元（折合每月 23、63、159 美元）。

summary.en: Monthly $29 / $79 / $199 (1, 3 or 8 engines; 10–100 daily prompts); annual $276 / $756 / $1,908 per year.

description.en: Multi-Model and Full Spectrum include a 3-day free trial; The Minimum has no trial. Enterprise is custom, with custom prompt volume, white-label reporting, API access, SSO and a dedicated Slack channel. The separate Honeyb API is priced per answer from $1.05 per 1,000 on prepaid credits.
description.zh: Multi-Model 与 Full Spectrum 提供 3 天免费试用，The Minimum 无试用。Enterprise 为定制价，含自定义提示词量、白标报告、API、SSO 与专属 Slack 频道。单独的 Honeyb API 按回答计费，预付积分每 1,000 条 1.05 美元起。

summary.en: 3-day trial on two plans, none on The Minimum; Enterprise custom; API from $1.05 per 1,000 answers prepaid.
summary.zh: 两档有 3 天试用，The Minimum 无；Enterprise 定制；API 预付每 1,000 条回答 1.05 美元起。

description.en: Engine coverage depends on plan: The Minimum tracks 1 engine of your choice and Multi-Model 3; all 8 engines require Full Spectrum. White-label reporting, API access and SSO are described as part of the custom Enterprise tier.
description.zh: 引擎覆盖取决于套餐：The Minimum 只追踪自选的 1 个引擎，Multi-Model 为 3 个，全部 8 个引擎需 Full Spectrum。白标报告、API 与 SSO 在定制的 Enterprise 档中说明。

summary.en: 1, 3 or 8 engines by plan; white-label, API and SSO described under Enterprise.
summary.zh: 按套餐覆盖 1、3 或 8 个引擎；白标、API 与 SSO 在 Enterprise 档说明。

description.en: Visibility reports are sent weekly by email on every plan, and article output is capped at 5, 15 or 30 per month below Enterprise. Connecting Google Search Console or Analytics uses read-only OAuth access.
description.zh: 所有套餐的可见度报告均为每周邮件发送，Enterprise 以下每月文章上限为 5、15 或 30 篇。连接 Google Search Console 或 Analytics 时使用只读 OAuth 授权。

summary.en: Weekly email reports; 5–30 articles a month; read-only Google OAuth.
summary.zh: 每周邮件报告；每月 5–30 篇文章；Google 授权为只读。

description.en: Choose Honeyb when you want to start cheaply on a single engine and scale to eight engines including DeepSeek and Grok, with citation domains and CMS publishing in the same plan; note that The Minimum has no trial and programmatic access is described under Enterprise or the separately priced API.
description.zh: 当你希望先以较低价格追踪单个引擎，再扩展到含 DeepSeek 与 Grok 在内的 8 个引擎，并在同一套餐内获得引用域名与 CMS 发布时选 Honeyb；注意 The Minimum 无试用，程序化访问在 Enterprise 档或单独计费的 API 产品中说明。

description.en: An AI search visibility platform built as a closed loop: it tracks mentions and citations across four AI engines, diagnoses source, technical and fact gaps with a GEO audit, and prepares content, schema and PR outreach for approval.
description.zh: 一款以闭环方式构建的 AI 搜索可见度平台：在 4 个 AI 引擎上追踪提及与引用，用 GEO 审计诊断来源、技术与事实缺口，并准备内容、结构化数据和 PR 外联供审批。

en: Track visibility score, share of voice, average rank, mentions versus citations and prompt-level evidence on ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and Gemini, with Claude as an add-on.
Diagnose gaps with a GEO audit (metadata, schema, crawlability, llms.txt, robots.txt), source intelligence, sentiment by model, brand-fact review and query fanout.
Prepare articles, page and schema updates, and personalized PR pitches sent through connected Gmail or Outlook, each reviewed before publishing.
Connect GA4, Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, WordPress, GitHub, Webflow, Shopify, Notion and MCP; Scale adds pooled multi-project limits and white-label reports.
zh: 在 ChatGPT、Google AI Overviews、Perplexity 与 Gemini 上追踪可见度得分、声量份额、平均排名、提及与引用之分及提示词级证据，Claude 可作为加购。
用 GEO 审计（元数据、结构化数据、可抓取性、llms.txt、robots.txt）、来源情报、按模型情绪、品牌事实核查与查询扇出诊断缺口。
准备文章、页面与结构化数据更新，以及经关联 Gmail 或 Outlook 发送的个性化 PR 推介，每项都需审核后发布。
可连接 GA4、Search Console、Bing Webmaster Tools、WordPress、GitHub、Webflow、Shopify、Notion 与 MCP；Scale 增加多项目共享额度与白标报告。

audience.en: In-house marketing teams and agencies that want one platform to measure AI visibility, diagnose why answers look the way they do, and ship the approved fixes, with a higher entry price than tracking-only tools.
audience.zh: 希望用一个平台完成 AI 可见度衡量、诊断回答成因并交付经审批修复的企业营销团队与代理机构；起步价高于纯追踪工具。

description.en: Connect a visibility drop to its causes, such as missing citations, technical blockers, wrong facts or competitor sources, using per-model, prompt-level history and a GEO audit.
description.zh: 借助按模型、按提示词的历史记录与 GEO 审计，把可见度下滑与其成因关联起来，例如缺失引用、技术障碍、错误事实或竞品来源。

summary.en: Diagnose visibility changes with prompt-level evidence and a GEO audit.
summary.zh: 用提示词级证据与 GEO 审计诊断可见度变化。

description.en: Have the platform prepare content, schema changes and PR outreach from the same evidence, with the team approving what gets published or sent.
description.zh: 由平台基于同一证据准备内容、结构化数据修改与 PR 外联，团队审批后再发布或发送。

summary.en: Prepare content, schema and outreach for team approval.
summary.zh: 准备内容、结构化数据与外联，供团队审批。

description.en: Pro is $399/month for 1 project, 100 prompts on 4 models daily, 100 GEO audit pages and 4,000 execution credits. Scale is $999/month for up to 10 projects with 500 pooled prompts, 1,000 audit pages, 20,000 credits and white-label reports. Both include a 3-day free trial, and yearly billing is advertised as two months free.
description.zh: Pro 每月 399 美元，含 1 个项目、每天在 4 个模型上运行 100 个提示词、100 个 GEO 审计页面与 4,000 执行积分。Scale 每月 999 美元，最多 10 个项目，共享 500 个提示词、1,000 个审计页面、20,000 积分并含白标报告。两档均有 3 天免费试用，年付宣传为免两个月。

summary.en: Pro $399/mo (1 project, 100 prompts); Scale $999/mo (10 projects, 500 pooled prompts); 3-day trial; yearly two months free.
summary.zh: Pro 每月 399 美元（1 项目、100 提示词）；Scale 每月 999 美元（10 项目、共享 500 提示词）；3 天试用；年付免两个月。

description.en: Growth is a managed service from $3,500/month with a three-month minimum and a dedicated GEO expert; Enterprise is custom and can include larger limits, SSO, API/export access and SLAs.
description.zh: Growth 为托管服务，每月 3,500 美元起，最短三个月，配专属 GEO 专家；Enterprise 为定制价，可含更大额度、SSO、API／导出与 SLA。

summary.en: Managed Growth from $3,500/mo (3-month minimum); Enterprise custom.
summary.zh: 托管 Growth 每月 3,500 美元起（至少 3 个月）；Enterprise 定制。

description.en: Four models are included on Pro and Scale; Claude is a paid add-on, and other engines such as Grok, DeepSeek or Copilot are not listed.
description.zh: Pro 与 Scale 含 4 个模型；Claude 需付费加购，Grok、DeepSeek 或 Copilot 等引擎未列出。

summary.en: Four included models; Claude is an add-on; no Grok, DeepSeek or Copilot listed.
summary.zh: 含 4 个模型；Claude 需加购；未列出 Grok、DeepSeek 或 Copilot。

description.en: Subscriptions renew automatically and the terms state that fees are non-refundable. The platform says it is not a fit for teams that only need Google rank tracking or for very early sites without content to cite.
description.zh: 订阅自动续费，条款写明费用不予退还。平台表示不适合只需要 Google 排名追踪的团队，也不适合尚无可引用内容的早期网站。

summary.en: Auto-renewing, non-refundable fees; not aimed at rank-tracking-only teams.
summary.zh: 自动续费且费用不退；不面向只做排名追踪的团队。

description.en: Choose ReachLLM when you want diagnosis and approved execution, including GEO audits, schema work and PR outreach, in the same workspace as tracking; weigh the $399 entry price, the four-model default and the non-refundable terms.
description.zh: 当你希望在追踪所在的同一工作区内完成诊断与经审批的执行（含 GEO 审计、结构化数据和 PR 外联）时选 ReachLLM；需权衡 399 美元的起步价、默认 4 个模型以及费用不退的条款。

description.en: A daily AI visibility tracker for ChatGPT and Google AI Mode that writes topics and queries for you, stores every answer and citation grouped by website, and offers a free PDF report without an account.
description.zh: 一款每日 AI 可见度追踪工具，覆盖 ChatGPT 与 Google AI Mode：自动编写主题与查询，保存每条回答及按网站归类的引用，并提供无需账户的免费 PDF 报告。

en: Ask ChatGPT and Google AI Mode your queries every day, in any language and in the countries you choose.
Generate topics and queries automatically from your brand, industry and competitors, and edit the list at any time.
Record every answer and citation, group citations by website and track your own site's share of citations over time.
Use Qvery Assistant to compare against competitors, manage topics and queries, start a data run or export a report.
zh: 每天用任意语言、在你选择的国家向 ChatGPT 与 Google AI Mode 提出查询。
根据品牌、行业与竞品自动生成主题和查询，列表可随时修改。
记录每条回答与引用，按网站归类引用，并追踪自有网站引用占比的变化。
通过 Qvery Assistant 对比竞品、管理主题与查询、启动数据运行或导出报告。

audience.en: Businesses such as hotels, travel operators and software firms that want to see which sites AI answers cite in specific countries and languages, and are fine with tracking only ChatGPT and Google AI Mode.
audience.zh: 希望了解 AI 回答在特定国家与语言中引用哪些网站的企业，例如酒店、旅游运营商和软件公司，并接受只追踪 ChatGPT 与 Google AI Mode。

description.en: See which websites, such as review, booking, directory or news sites, AI answers lean on for your queries, and where competitors are named instead of you.
description.zh: 查看 AI 回答在你的查询中依赖哪些网站（如点评、预订、目录或新闻网站），以及哪些场景点名的是竞品而不是你。

summary.en: Find which sites answers cite and where competitors are named instead.
summary.zh: 找出回答引用的网站，以及竞品取代你被点名的场景。

description.en: Compare what buyers in different countries are told by running the same query in several countries and languages.
description.zh: 在多个国家和语言中运行同一查询，比较不同国家买家得到的回答。

summary.en: Compare answers across countries and languages.
summary.zh: 跨国家与语言比较回答。

description.en: Get a free, roughly seven-page PDF built on 25 questions across both engines before committing to an account.
description.zh: 在注册账户前，先获取一份基于 25 个问题、覆盖两个引擎、约 7 页的免费 PDF 报告。

summary.en: Start with a free 25-question PDF report.
summary.zh: 先获取 25 个问题的免费 PDF 报告。

description.en: Plans are priced by the number of brands and daily questions: the entry tier covers 1 brand and 25 questions, and larger tiers go into the hundreds. Prices are only shown inside the account after signup, billed monthly or yearly, and the largest plan is arranged with the team; no amounts are published.
description.zh: 套餐按品牌数与每日问题数定价：入门档覆盖 1 个品牌、25 个问题，更高档位可达数百个问题。价格只在注册后于账户内显示，可月付或年付，最大套餐需与团队商定；官网未公布金额。

summary.en: Entry tier 1 brand, 25 daily questions; amounts shown only after signup; monthly or yearly.
summary.zh: 入门档 1 品牌、每日 25 问题；金额注册后才显示；可月付或年付。

description.en: The AI visibility report is free and needs no account; requesting it again for the same website within a week sends the existing report.
description.zh: AI 可见度报告免费且无需账户；一周内为同一网站再次申请会发送已有报告。

summary.en: Free report, no account; one per website per week.
summary.zh: 免费报告，无需账户；同一网站每周一份。

description.en: Only ChatGPT and Google AI Mode are tracked; the FAQ states Gemini, Perplexity and Copilot are not tracked today.
description.zh: 只追踪 ChatGPT 与 Google AI Mode；常见问题写明目前不追踪 Gemini、Perplexity 与 Copilot。

summary.en: ChatGPT and Google AI Mode only; no Gemini, Perplexity or Copilot.
summary.zh: 仅 ChatGPT 与 Google AI Mode；不含 Gemini、Perplexity、Copilot。

description.en: GEO Agent measures and explains but never publishes, pitches or places mentions itself, so your team carries out fixes. Qvery is primarily an AI transformation consultancy, and the free-report data is kept for 90 days.
description.zh: GEO Agent 只负责衡量和解释，不会自行发布内容、推介或投放提及，修复需由团队执行。Qvery 主业为 AI 转型咨询，免费报告数据保存 90 天。

summary.en: Measures only, no publishing or outreach; free-report data kept 90 days.
summary.zh: 只做衡量，不发布不外联；免费报告数据保存 90 天。

description.en: Choose Qvery GEO Agent when citation sources and country-by-country answers on ChatGPT and Google AI Mode are what you need, and you can confirm pricing after signup; look elsewhere if you need Gemini, Perplexity or Copilot coverage or built-in publishing.
description.zh: 当你需要的是 ChatGPT 与 Google AI Mode 上的引用来源及分国家回答，并能接受注册后再确认价格时选 Qvery GEO Agent；若需要 Gemini、Perplexity、Copilot 覆盖或内置发布功能，应考虑其他工具。

description.en: An AI visibility platform that shows why AI answers pick competitors, diagnosing content coverage, quality, agent readiness, authority and outreach, then turns the findings into playbooks and brand-voice drafts.
description.zh: 一款 AI 可见度平台，揭示 AI 回答为何选择竞品，从内容覆盖、内容质量、代理就绪度、权威性与外联五个驱动因素诊断，再把结论转为行动手册和品牌语气草稿。

en: Track visibility, position, sentiment, citations and ads in daily AI responses on ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude and Copilot.
Diagnose why AI picks a competitor across five drivers, reading 100 to 5,000 pages of your site a month depending on plan.
Count usage per market, where a market is one country in one language, and split daily responses across brands, markets and models.
Work through playbooks with the 3RD Agent and a Content Agent that drafts, rewrites and translates in your brand voice for CMS approval.
zh: 在 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity、Google AI Overviews、Claude 与 Copilot 的每日 AI 回答中追踪可见度、位置、情绪、引用与广告。
从五个驱动因素诊断 AI 为何选择竞品，按套餐每月读取网站 100 至 5,000 个页面。
按市场计量用量（一个市场即一个国家加一种语言），并可在品牌、市场与模型间分配每日回答额度。
借助 3RD Agent 推进行动手册，并由内容代理以品牌语气起草、改写和翻译内容，提交 CMS 审批。

audience.en: Marketing teams in Europe and elsewhere that track AI visibility across several countries, languages or brands and want to know why competitors win specific answers.
audience.zh: 在多个国家、语言或品牌间追踪 AI 可见度，并想弄清竞品为何赢得特定回答的营销团队，欧洲团队尤为适用。

description.en: Find out why AI answers choose a competitor by looking at the sources, pages and facts behind each answer, ranked across five drivers.
description.zh: 通过每条回答背后的来源、页面与事实，并按五个驱动因素排序，找出 AI 回答选择竞品的原因。

summary.en: Diagnose why answers pick competitors across five ranked drivers.
summary.zh: 按五个驱动因素诊断回答为何选择竞品。

description.en: Compare AI answers market by market, for example Denmark in Danish versus Denmark in English, across up to 10 brands on Growth.
description.zh: 逐市场比较 AI 回答，例如丹麦语与英语的丹麦市场，Growth 档最多覆盖 10 个品牌。

summary.en: Compare answers per country-language market across brands.
summary.zh: 跨品牌按国家加语言的市场比较回答。

description.en: Starter is €99/month (€84/month billed annually) with 40 daily AI responses on up to 2 models, 1 brand in 1 market and 2 users. Pro is €299/month (€254 annually) with 100 responses, up to 3 models, 4 brands and any markets. Growth is €499/month (€424 annually) with 300 responses, up to 4 models and 10 brands. Enterprise starts at €2,500/month on an annual contract with up to 14 models.
description.zh: Starter 每月 99 欧元（年付每月 84 欧元），每日 40 条 AI 回答、最多 2 个模型、1 个品牌 1 个市场、2 名用户。Pro 每月 299 欧元（年付 254 欧元），100 条回答、最多 3 个模型、4 个品牌、市场不限。Growth 每月 499 欧元（年付 424 欧元），300 条回答、最多 4 个模型、10 个品牌。Enterprise 按年签约，每月 2,500 欧元起，最多 14 个模型。

summary.en: Starter €99, Pro €299, Growth €499 per month (40/100/300 daily responses); annual saves 15%; Enterprise from €2,500/mo.
summary.zh: Starter 99、Pro 299、Growth 499 欧元／月（每日 40／100／300 条回答）；年付省 15%；Enterprise 每月 2,500 欧元起。

description.en: Every plan starts with a 7-day trial of the full Growth plan without a credit card. Add-ons are €65/month per extra AI model, €100/month for 50 more daily responses and €1,500/month for the Lift-off setup workshop.
description.zh: 所有套餐均可先免费试用 7 天完整 Growth 套餐，无需信用卡。加购项：每增加 1 个 AI 模型每月 65 欧元，每日增加 50 条回答每月 100 欧元，Lift-off 配置工作坊每月 1,500 欧元。

summary.en: 7-day Growth trial without a card; add-ons €65 per model, €100 per 50 responses.
summary.zh: 7 天 Growth 试用免绑卡；加购每模型 65 欧元、每 50 条回答 100 欧元。

description.en: One daily AI response is one question on one model in one market, so adding models or markets divides the quota. Starter covers only 1 brand in 1 market, has no playbooks, and AI-referred GA4 traffic starts at Growth.
description.zh: 每日 1 条 AI 回答等于 1 个问题在 1 个模型、1 个市场上的回答，增加模型或市场会分摊额度。Starter 只覆盖 1 个品牌 1 个市场，没有行动手册；GA4 中的 AI 引荐流量自 Growth 起提供。

summary.en: Quota is split across models and markets; Starter 1 market, no playbooks; GA4 AI traffic from Growth.
summary.zh: 额度按模型与市场分摊；Starter 仅 1 市场、无手册；GA4 AI 流量自 Growth 起。

description.en: The service is offered only to business customers under Danish law, and the Google Ads connection uses Google's single Ads scope, which 3RD says it uses read-only.
description.zh: 该服务仅向企业客户提供，适用丹麦法律；连接 Google Ads 时只能使用 Google 唯一的 Ads 授权范围，3RD 称仅作只读使用。

summary.en: Business customers only; Google Ads access stated as read-only.
summary.zh: 仅限企业客户；Google Ads 授权声明为只读。

description.en: Choose 3RD when explaining why competitors win specific answers matters more than raw prompt volume, especially across several country-language markets, and euro pricing with EU data storage suits you; check how the per-model, per-market quota divides before picking a plan.
description.zh: 当解释竞品为何赢得特定回答比单纯的提示词数量更重要，尤其需要覆盖多个国家加语言市场，并接受欧元计价与欧盟数据存储时选 3RD；选套餐前先算清额度如何按模型和市场分摊。

description.en: An AI search analytics platform that connects at the CDN layer to monitor how AI bots crawl each page and attributes on-site conversions to AI-driven visits, from prompt to recommendation to action.
description.zh: 一款 AI 搜索分析平台，在 CDN 层接入，监测 AI 爬虫如何抓取每个页面，并把站内转化归因到 AI 带来的访问，覆盖从提示词、推荐到行动的路径。

en: Monitor AI bot visit frequency, returning bots and behavior shifts across the site, with page-level distribution and geo-origin.
Map which pages get AI attention, spot overlooked content and detect blocked regions or crawl failures.
Attribute purchases, demo requests and signups on your own site to AI-driven visits, broken out by engine.
Start with a lightweight tag that refreshes every 24 hours, then add deeper CDN-level attribution.
zh: 监测全站 AI 爬虫的访问频率、回访爬虫与行为变化，并查看页面级分布与地理来源。
绘制哪些页面受到 AI 关注，发现被忽视的内容，检测被封锁的地区或抓取失败。
把自有网站上的购买、演示申请与注册归因到 AI 带来的访问，并按引擎拆分。
先用每 24 小时刷新的轻量标签起步，再接入更深的 CDN 级归因。

audience.en: B2B companies with demo requests and e-commerce or retail brands with on-site purchases that can integrate at the CDN layer and want AI crawl and conversion data rather than prompt tracking alone.
audience.zh: 有演示申请流程的 B2B 公司，以及有站内购买的电商或零售品牌；能在 CDN 层接入，并且想要 AI 抓取与转化数据，而不只是提示词追踪。

description.en: See which pages AI bots visit most, which get little attention and where regional blocks or technical issues limit AI access.
description.zh: 查看 AI 爬虫最常访问哪些页面、哪些页面很少被关注，以及哪些地区封锁或技术问题限制了 AI 访问。

summary.en: Find where AI bots crawl and where access is blocked.
summary.zh: 找出 AI 爬虫抓取的位置及访问受阻之处。

description.en: Measure the revenue impact of AI search by tying AI-driven visits to actions on your own site, such as a purchase, demo request or signup.
description.zh: 把 AI 带来的访问与站内行动（如购买、演示申请或注册）关联起来，衡量 AI 搜索对收入的影响。

summary.en: Tie AI-driven visits to on-site conversions.
summary.zh: 把 AI 带来的访问关联到站内转化。

description.en: No plans or prices are published; the bot-traffic and attribution pages only offer a demo booking.
description.zh: 官网未公布套餐或价格；爬虫流量与归因页面只提供预约演示。

summary.en: No public pricing; demo booking only.
summary.zh: 未公开价格；仅可预约演示。

description.en: Precise bot data requires connecting Limy at your CDN or edge provider. Attribution is measured at the action on your own site, because, as the FAQ notes, no tool can see a purchase inside the AI engine.
description.zh: 精确的爬虫数据需要在 CDN 或边缘服务商处接入 Limy。归因以自有网站上的行动为衡量点，因为常见问题写明，任何工具都看不到 AI 引擎内部的购买。

summary.en: Needs CDN integration; attribution stops at on-site actions.
summary.zh: 需 CDN 接入；归因止于站内行动。

description.en: Early data comes from a lightweight tag within the first weeks, and deeper CDN-level attribution follows over later weeks. The terms name Limy AI in New York, while the privacy policy names Limy Analytics Ltd. in Tel Aviv as data controller.
description.zh: 最初几周的数据来自轻量标签，更深的 CDN 级归因在之后数周才到位。条款中的主体为纽约的 Limy AI，隐私政策中的数据控制者为特拉维夫的 Limy Analytics Ltd.。

summary.en: Full attribution takes weeks; legal entities differ between terms and privacy.
summary.zh: 完整归因需数周；条款与隐私政策的主体名称不同。

description.en: Choose Limy when you need to see AI crawler behavior and conversions on your own site and can integrate at the CDN layer; it is a demo-led purchase without public prices, so it suits teams already prepared for a sales process.
description.zh: 当你需要看到自有网站上的 AI 爬虫行为与转化，且能在 CDN 层接入时选 Limy；它以演示为主、没有公开价格，适合已准备好走销售流程的团队。

description.en: An open-source, MIT-licensed AI visibility platform that tracks how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI features and other models mention and cite your brand; self-host it for free or use the paid Elmo Cloud.
description.zh: 一款以 MIT 许可开源的 AI 可见度平台，追踪 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Perplexity、Google AI 功能及其他模型如何提及和引用品牌；可免费自托管，也可使用付费的 Elmo Cloud。

en: Track visibility, share of voice, sentiment, position and the sources AI cites, with opportunities ranked by impact.
Scrape what users see in ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, AI Overviews, Bing AI Mode and Gemini, and query Claude, DeepSeek, Mistral, Qwen, Kimi and OpenRouter models by API.
Self-host the full product on Docker Compose with a CLI, storing brands, prompts and answers in your own PostgreSQL database.
Use the REST API, TypeScript and Python SDKs and an MCP server on every Cloud plan and in every self-hosted instance.
zh: 追踪可见度、声量份额、情绪、位置及 AI 引用的来源，并按影响排序机会。
抓取用户在 ChatGPT、Google AI Mode、AI Overviews、Bing AI Mode 与 Gemini 中看到的内容，并通过 API 查询 Claude、DeepSeek、Mistral、Qwen、Kimi 及 OpenRouter 模型。
用 CLI 在 Docker Compose 上自托管完整产品，品牌、提示词与回答存放在你自己的 PostgreSQL 数据库中。
每个 Cloud 套餐与每个自托管实例都提供 REST API、TypeScript 与 Python SDK 以及 MCP 服务器。

audience.en: Technical marketing teams, developers and agencies that want an open-source AI visibility tracker they can self-host and extend, or a low-cost self-serve hosted plan.
audience.zh: 希望使用可自托管、可扩展的开源 AI 可见度追踪工具，或低价自助托管套餐的技术型营销团队、开发者与代理机构。

description.en: Run AI visibility tracking on your own servers with unlimited prompts and any model, keeping brands, prompts and AI responses in your own database.
description.zh: 在自己的服务器上运行 AI 可见度追踪，提示词不限、模型任选，品牌、提示词与 AI 回答都保存在自己的数据库中。

summary.en: Self-host tracking with your own database and models.
summary.zh: 自托管追踪，使用自己的数据库与模型。

description.en: Feed visibility, citation and sentiment data into internal tools or AI coding assistants through the REST API and MCP server, with read-only or read-write keys scoped to brands.
description.zh: 通过 REST API 与 MCP 服务器，把可见度、引用与情绪数据接入内部工具或 AI 编程助手，密钥可设为只读或读写并限定品牌。

summary.en: Pipe visibility data into tools and agents via API and MCP.
summary.zh: 通过 API 与 MCP 把可见度数据接入工具和代理。

description.en: Self-hosting is free and open source with no license or per-seat fee; you pay only for your own infrastructure and the AI provider API keys you use.
description.zh: 自托管免费且开源，无许可费或按席位收费；只需支付自有基础设施与所用 AI 服务商 API 密钥的费用。

summary.en: Self-hosted: free; you pay infrastructure and provider API keys.
summary.zh: 自托管免费；自付基础设施与服务商 API 费用。

description.en: Elmo Cloud: Starter $29/month ($290/year) for 1 brand, 50 prompts, ChatGPT only once a day; Basic $99/month ($990/year) for 1 brand, 50 prompts on any 4 platforms 4 times a day; Pro $299/month ($2,990/year) for 2 brands, 150 prompts and 20 premium prompt-model pairings; Business $649/month ($6,490/year) for 5 brands, 350 prompts and 30 premium pairings. Extra premium pairings are $5/month each; custom and white-label plans are by contact.
description.zh: Elmo Cloud：Starter 每月 29 美元（每年 290 美元），1 个品牌、50 个提示词，仅 ChatGPT、每天 1 次；Basic 每月 99 美元（每年 990 美元），1 个品牌、50 个提示词，任选 4 个平台、每天 4 次；Pro 每月 299 美元（每年 2,990 美元），2 个品牌、150 个提示词及 20 组高级提示词-模型组合；Business 每月 649 美元（每年 6,490 美元），5 个品牌、350 个提示词及 30 组高级组合。额外高级组合每组每月 5 美元；定制与白标套餐需联系。

summary.en: Cloud $29 / $99 / $299 / $649 per month (50–350 prompts); annual equals two months free; premium pairings $5/mo extra.
