summary.zh: Cloud 每月 29／99／299／649 美元（50–350 提示词）；年付相当于免两个月；高级组合每组每月 5 美元。

description.en: Cloud Starter tracks only ChatGPT, and the other Cloud plans let you choose 4 platforms; premium grounded models such as Claude web, Grok web, Meta and Perplexity Sonar run once a day and only on Pro and Business.
description.zh: Cloud Starter 只追踪 ChatGPT，其余 Cloud 套餐可任选 4 个平台；Claude 网页版、Grok 网页版、Meta 与 Perplexity Sonar 等高级引用型模型每天运行 1 次，且仅限 Pro 与 Business。

summary.en: Starter ChatGPT only; other plans pick 4 platforms; premium models from Pro.
summary.zh: Starter 仅 ChatGPT；其他套餐任选 4 个平台；高级模型自 Pro 起。

description.en: Self-hosting needs Docker Compose, a PostgreSQL database and your own provider API keys, and self-hosted instances send usage telemetry unless you set DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1. Self-serve Cloud plans have no service-level agreement.
description.zh: 自托管需要 Docker Compose、PostgreSQL 数据库及自备服务商 API 密钥；除非设置 DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1，自托管实例会发送使用遥测。自助 Cloud 套餐没有服务等级协议。

summary.en: Self-hosting needs Docker and own API keys; telemetry on by default; no SLA on self-serve.
summary.zh: 自托管需 Docker 与自备 API 密钥；遥测默认开启；自助套餐无 SLA。

description.en: Choose Elmo when open source, self-hosting and API/MCP access matter, or when you want a low-cost hosted tracker; remember that self-hosting shifts infrastructure, provider costs and maintenance to you, and Cloud plans cap you at four platforms.
description.zh: 当你看重开源、自托管与 API/MCP 接入，或想要低价托管追踪工具时选 Elmo；注意自托管会把基础设施、服务商费用与维护工作转给你自己，Cloud 套餐最多选 4 个平台。

description.en: An SEO and GEO platform that bundles weekly AI prompt tracking across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews with Search Console and GA4 data, a GA4 AI traffic dashboard, technical SEO tools and an MCP server.
description.zh: 一款 SEO 与 GEO 平台，把 ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude、Perplexity 与 Google AI Overviews 上的每周 AI 提示词追踪，与 Search Console 和 GA4 数据、GA4 AI 流量看板、技术 SEO 工具及 MCP 服务器整合在一起。

en: Track weekly AI prompts, where one prompt is one answer from one AI, across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.
See Search Console clicks and GA4 sessions in the same projects, with an AI Tracker that compares AI traffic with organic traffic by model, landing page, country and language.
Run technical SEO modules such as crawler, sitemap, monitor, links and alerts on monthly credits.
Connect AI assistants through an MCP server included on all plans, with white-label reports and a custom CNAME from Pro.
zh: 每周追踪 AI 提示词（1 个提示词等于 1 个 AI 的 1 条回答），覆盖 ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude、Perplexity 与 Google AI Overviews。
在同一项目中查看 Search Console 点击与 GA4 会话，AI Tracker 按模型、落地页、国家和语言比较 AI 流量与自然流量。
按月度积分运行爬虫、站点地图、监控、链接与提醒等技术 SEO 模块。
所有套餐都含 MCP 服务器以接入 AI 助手；自 Pro 起提供白标报告与自定义 CNAME。

audience.en: SEO freelancers, in-house teams and agencies that want AI prompt tracking inside an existing SEO workflow with Search Console and GA4, rather than a separate GEO-only tool.
audience.zh: 希望在现有 SEO 工作流中结合 Search Console 与 GA4 做 AI 提示词追踪，而不是另用单独 GEO 工具的 SEO 自由职业者、企业团队与代理机构。

description.en: Monitor how ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews mention a brand across many projects, alongside the same projects' Search Console and GA4 data.
description.zh: 在多个项目中监测 ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude、Perplexity 与 Google AI Overviews 如何提及品牌，并与这些项目的 Search Console 和 GA4 数据放在一起查看。

summary.en: Track AI prompts per project next to Search Console and GA4.
summary.zh: 按项目追踪 AI 提示词，并与 Search Console、GA4 并列查看。

description.en: Measure the sessions, users and key events that ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and other assistants send, and which landing pages they reach, straight from GA4.
description.zh: 直接从 GA4 衡量 ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity 等助手带来的会话、用户与关键事件，以及它们到达的落地页。

summary.en: Measure AI-referred GA4 traffic by model and landing page.
summary.zh: 按模型与落地页衡量 GA4 中的 AI 引荐流量。

label.en: SEOcrawl legal notice and privacy policy
label.zh: SEOcrawl 法律声明与隐私政策

description.en: Monthly prices are €49 (Starter: 250 AI prompts/week, 5 projects, 1 user), €99 (Growth: 1,250 prompts, 25 projects, 5 users), €199 (Pro: 2,500 prompts, 100 projects, 10 users) and €399 (Agency: 6,000 prompts, 200 projects, 25 users). Yearly billing is €396, €792, €1,592 and €3,192 per year. Enterprise starts at 15,000+ prompts a week on a custom annual contract.
description.zh: 月付价格为 49 欧元（Starter：每周 250 个 AI 提示词、5 个项目、1 名用户）、99 欧元（Growth：1,250 个提示词、25 个项目、5 名用户）、199 欧元（Pro：2,500 个提示词、100 个项目、10 名用户）与 399 欧元（Agency：6,000 个提示词、200 个项目、25 名用户）。年付分别为每年 396、792、1,592 与 3,192 欧元。Enterprise 每周 15,000 个以上提示词，按定制年度合同。

summary.en: Monthly €49 / €99 / €199 / €399 (250–6,000 weekly prompts); yearly €396–€3,192; Enterprise custom.
summary.zh: 月付 49／99／199／399 欧元（每周 250–6,000 提示词）；年付每年 396–3,192 欧元；Enterprise 定制。

description.en: Each paid plan lists a 30-day free trial, and the pricing page lets you switch the displayed currency between EUR, USD, GBP and JPY.
description.zh: 每个付费套餐均标注 30 天免费试用，定价页可在欧元、美元、英镑和日元之间切换显示币种。

summary.en: 30-day free trial; prices shown in EUR with other currencies selectable.
summary.zh: 30 天免费试用；默认欧元显示，可切换其他币种。

description.en: AI prompts are counted per week, not per day, and each prompt is one answer from one AI, so covering five engines uses five prompts. Copilot tracking is marked as coming soon, and API access starts at the Agency plan.
description.zh: AI 提示词按周而非按天计算，每个提示词等于 1 个 AI 的 1 条回答，覆盖 5 个引擎就要消耗 5 个提示词。Copilot 追踪标注为即将推出，API 访问自 Agency 套餐起提供。

summary.en: Weekly prompt budget, one per engine answer; Copilot coming soon; API from Agency.
summary.zh: 提示词按周计且每引擎每回答计 1 次；Copilot 待上线；API 自 Agency 起。

description.en: The plan cards list the GA4 AI Dashboard on every plan, but the comparison table marks it only from Pro upward; confirm before buying Starter or Growth for AI traffic reporting. The AI Tracker measures GA4 traffic, while brand mentions in answers come from separate prompt tracking.
description.zh: 套餐卡片在每档都列出 GA4 AI 看板，但对比表只在 Pro 及以上标为可用；若购买 Starter 或 Growth 用于 AI 流量报告，需先确认。AI Tracker 衡量的是 GA4 流量，回答中的品牌提及需通过单独的提示词追踪查看。

summary.en: GA4 AI Dashboard availability conflicts between cards and table; AI Tracker measures traffic, not mentions.
summary.zh: GA4 AI 看板在卡片与对比表中说法不一；AI Tracker 衡量流量而非提及。

description.en: Choose SEOcrawl AI when you want AI prompt tracking and AI traffic reporting inside a broader SEO toolkit with Search Console, GA4 and many projects at a low euro price; it is less suited if you need daily sampling or a GEO-only product.
description.zh: 当你希望以较低的欧元价格，在含 Search Console、GA4 与多项目管理的更广 SEO 工具集中完成 AI 提示词追踪和 AI 流量报告时选 SEOcrawl AI；若需要每日采样或纯 GEO 产品，则不太适合。

description.en: A developer-first SEO and AI-visibility data API that returns compact JSON for SERP analysis, rank tracking, Google AI Overview checks, prompt-set planning, local visibility and LLM mention monitoring through REST, SDKs and a hosted MCP server.
description.zh: 面向开发者的 SEO 与 AI 曝光数据 API，通过 REST、SDK 与托管 MCP 服务器返回精简 JSON，用于 SERP 分析、排名追踪、Google AI Overview 检查、提示词集合规划、本地曝光与 LLM 提及监测。

en: Run search, page extraction and SERP analysis endpoints that return compact JSON plus markdown summaries for agent workflows.
Track keyword and URL rank history, local pack visibility by location, and check whether a query triggers a Google AI Overview with a sampled candidate audit.
Build a stable AI visibility prompt set mapped to platforms, competitors, owned assets and citations, and track brand mentions across sampled Reddit and X results.
Connect through REST, JavaScript and Python SDKs, n8n or Make, Claude Code and Claude Desktop, or a hosted MCP server.
zh: 运行搜索、页面提取与 SERP 分析接口，为 Agent 工作流返回精简 JSON 和 Markdown 摘要。
追踪关键词与 URL 的排名历史、按地点的本地结果曝光，并检查查询是否触发 Google AI Overview 及其抽样候选来源。
构建映射到平台、竞品、自有资产与引用的稳定 AI 曝光提示词集合，并在抽样的 Reddit 与 X 结果中追踪品牌提及。
通过 REST、JavaScript 与 Python SDK、n8n 或 Make、Claude Code 与 Claude Desktop，以及托管 MCP 服务器接入。

audience.en: Developers, SEO engineers and agencies that need SEO and AI-visibility evidence as structured API responses inside agents, apps or automation workflows.
audience.zh: 需要在 Agent、应用或自动化工作流中以结构化 API 响应获取 SEO 与 AI 曝光证据的开发者、SEO 工程师和代理机构。

description.en: Run a weekly AI visibility review: create a stable prompt set for a brand and category, check high-value queries for Google AI Overviews, track sampled LLM mentions, and route missing citations or weak owned assets into the next content plan.
description.zh: 执行每周 AI 曝光复盘：为品牌与品类建立稳定提示词集合，检查高价值查询是否出现 Google AI Overview，追踪抽样的 LLM 提及，并把缺失引用或薄弱自有资产转为下一轮内容计划。

summary.en: Weekly prompt-set, AI Overview, mention and action-plan review.
summary.zh: 每周复盘提示词集合、AI Overview、提及与行动计划。

description.en: Queue rank and local visibility checks from an agent: submit a keyword and URL, or a domain with up to five keywords and three locations, then poll the asynchronous job for a completed or failed result.
description.zh: 从 Agent 发起排名与本地曝光检查：提交关键词与 URL，或提交域名及最多 5 个关键词和 3 个地点，再轮询异步任务以获取完成或失败结果。

summary.en: Async rank and local pack checks from agent workflows.
summary.zh: 在 Agent 工作流中异步检查排名与本地结果。

description.en: Assemble an SEO workflow from endpoints: use content gap, SERP outline, technical QA, internal links and backlink analysis responses to decide what to publish, refresh or fix next.
description.zh: 用多个接口组装 SEO 工作流：借助内容缺口、SERP 大纲、技术 QA、内链与反向链接分析结果，判断下一步应发布、更新还是修复什么。

summary.en: Compose content, QA and backlink endpoints into one workflow.
summary.zh: 把内容、QA 与反向链接接口组合成工作流。

label.en: Rank and AI visibility API reference
label.zh: 排名与 AI 曝光 API 参考

label.en: Workflow bundles including weekly AI visibility review
label.zh: 工作流包，含每周 AI 曝光复盘

description.en: Hobby is free with 100 one-time live credits and no card. Starter costs $9/month for 2,000 credits, Pro $49/month for 10,000 credits and Agency $149/month for 35,000 credits, billed monthly in USD with a credit cap and no automatic overage charges.
description.zh: Hobby 免费，提供 100 个一次性实时积分且无需绑卡。Starter 为 $9/月含 2,000 积分，Pro 为 $49/月含 10,000 积分，Agency 为 $149/月含 35,000 积分，均按美元月付，设有积分上限且不自动收取超额费用。

summary.en: Hobby free 100 one-time credits; Starter $9, Pro $49, Agency $149 per month (USD) with credit caps.
summary.zh: Hobby 送 100 一次性积分；Starter $9、Pro $49、Agency $149 每月（美元），均设积分上限。

description.en: Credits vary by endpoint: a search of up to 10 results costs 1 credit, an Agent QA workflow 2 credits, a SERP outline 4 credits and a content gap 10 credits; an AI visibility prompt set costs 2 credits and does not run live LLM queries.
description.zh: 积分按接口消耗：最多 10 条结果的搜索为 1 积分，Agent QA 工作流 2 积分，SERP 大纲 4 积分，内容缺口 10 积分；AI 曝光提示词集合为 2 积分，且不运行实时 LLM 查询。

summary.en: Search 1 credit, Agent QA 2, SERP outline 4, content gap 10; prompt-set 2 credits.
summary.zh: 搜索 1 积分、Agent QA 2、SERP 大纲 4、内容缺口 10；提示词集合 2 积分。

description.en: The AI visibility prompt-set endpoint plans prompts and measurement fields but does not run live LLM queries or call a paid search API. LLM mention tracking samples Reddit and X, and AI Overview checks return a sampled candidate audit rather than a full answer snapshot.
description.zh: AI 曝光提示词集合接口只规划提示词与衡量字段，不运行实时 LLM 查询，也不调用付费搜索 API。LLM 提及追踪抽样 Reddit 与 X，AI Overview 检查返回抽样候选审计，而非完整回答快照。

summary.en: Prompt-set is planning only; mentions sample Reddit/X; AI Overviews use sampled candidates.
summary.zh: 提示词集合仅作规划；提及抽样 Reddit/X；AI Overview 采用抽样候选。

description.en: Plans have a credit cap and no automatic overage: when the monthly allowance is used up, work must wait for replenishment or move to a higher plan. The Hobby allowance is one-time, and the Agency plan's contact button opens an email enquiry rather than online checkout.
description.zh: 套餐设有积分上限且不自动超额：月度额度用完后需等待补充或升级套餐。Hobby 额度为一次性，Agency 套餐的联系按钮打开邮件咨询而非在线结账。

summary.en: Hard credit cap, no auto overage; Hobby credits one-time.
summary.zh: 积分硬上限、不自动超额；Hobby 积分为一次性。

description.en: Most analysis calls run as asynchronous jobs: a queued response only confirms acceptance, and the caller must poll until the job completes or fails. Local visibility requests accept up to five keywords and three locations each.
description.zh: 多数分析调用以异步任务运行：排队响应只表示已受理，调用方需轮询直至任务完成或失败。每次本地曝光请求最多接受 5 个关键词和 3 个地点。

summary.en: Async submit-and-poll jobs; local visibility max 5 keywords and 3 locations.
summary.zh: 异步提交并轮询；本地曝光每次最多 5 关键词、3 地点。

description.en: Choose AgentSEO when you need API-first SEO and AI-visibility evidence inside code or agent workflows, with token-conscious JSON and MCP access. It is a data and evidence layer rather than a dashboard-first monitoring suite, so check sampled AI signals, credit costs and async polling against your reporting cadence.
description.zh: 当你需要在代码或 Agent 工作流中以 API 优先的方式获取 SEO 与 AI 曝光证据，并重视精简 JSON 与 MCP 接入时选 AgentSEO。它更像数据与证据层，而非以看板为主的监测套件；应结合抽样 AI 信号、积分成本与异步轮询评估是否匹配报告节奏。

description.en: Free AI visibility check for one site: buyer-style questions on OpenAI show whether your brand is mentioned, who is recommended instead and which pages are cited, plus on-site AI readiness checks. The full report is a one-time $9 with 90 answers from OpenAI, Claude and Gemini.
description.zh: 对单个网站免费检查 AI 可见性：以购买类问题询问 OpenAI，查看品牌是否被提及、推荐了哪些竞品、引用了哪些页面，并检查站内 AI 就绪度；完整报告为一次性 $9，覆盖 OpenAI、Claude 与 Gemini 共 90 个回答。

en: Run a free check of five buyer-style questions on OpenAI with web search and see mention rate, list position and a 0–100 score.
List recommended competitors with share of voice and every cited page, each labelled with one suggested next action.
Check on-site AI readiness: robots.txt rules for AI crawlers, llms.txt, JSON-LD, title and meta description, server HTML text and sitemap.xml.
Upgrade to a 90-answer full report across OpenAI, Claude and Gemini with per-engine scores and one re-check after 30 days.
zh: 免费检查 5 个购买类问题，经 OpenAI 联网回答，查看提及率、列表位置与 0–100 分。
列出被推荐的竞品及声量占比，并给出每个被引页面及对应的一条行动建议。
检查站内 AI 就绪度：AI 爬虫的 robots.txt 规则、llms.txt、JSON-LD、标题与 meta 描述、服务端 HTML 正文及 sitemap.xml。
升级为覆盖 OpenAI、Claude 与 Gemini 共 90 个回答的完整报告，含分引擎得分，30 天后可复查一次。

audience.en: Founders, indie developers, marketers and agencies who want a one-time check of whether AI assistants recommend their product, without an ongoing subscription.
audience.zh: 想一次性确认 AI 助手是否推荐自己的产品、又不需要订阅持续监控的创始人、独立开发者、营销人员与代理机构。

description.en: Before publishing or a campaign, run the free check to see whether OpenAI mentions your site for buyer-style questions, which competitors it recommends instead and where you place in lists.
description.zh: 发布产品或开展推广前，先运行免费检查，查看 OpenAI 在购买类问题中是否提及你的网站、推荐了哪些竞品以及你在列表中的位置。

summary.en: Pre-launch brand mention and competitor check.
summary.zh: 上线前的品牌提及与竞品检查。

description.en: Turn the cited-pages list into a work plan: each cited URL is typed as a listicle, Reddit or forum thread, review site, directory, vendor page or news with one next action, then re-run the full report after 30 days to compare what changed.
description.zh: 把被引页面清单变成工作计划：每个被引 URL 按榜单文章、Reddit 或论坛帖、评测站、目录、厂商页或新闻分类，并给出一条行动建议；30 天后重跑完整报告对比变化。

summary.en: Work the cited-source list, re-check after 30 days.
summary.zh: 处理被引来源清单，30 天后复查。

description.en: Check AI readiness before outreach: confirm robots.txt rules for AI crawlers such as GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot and ClaudeBot, plus llms.txt, JSON-LD and sitemap.xml.
description.zh: 对外推广前检查 AI 就绪度：确认 GPTBot、OAI-SearchBot、ChatGPT-User、Google-Extended、PerplexityBot、ClaudeBot 等 AI 爬虫的 robots.txt 规则，以及 llms.txt、JSON-LD 与 sitemap.xml。

summary.en: Audit robots.txt, llms.txt, JSON-LD and sitemap for AI crawlers.
summary.zh: 审计 AI 爬虫的 robots.txt、llms.txt、JSON-LD 与 sitemap。

label.zh: Peec AI 官方产品功能

description.en: The free check costs $0 and includes five buyer-style questions on OpenAI with web search, one run each, mention rate and list position, competitors and cited pages, on-site AI readiness checks and a shareable report link kept for 90 days. It is limited to 3 checks per day per network and does not include a re-check.
description.zh: 免费检查价格为 $0，包含 5 个购买类问题（OpenAI 联网回答、每题 1 次）、提及率与列表位置、竞品与被引页面、站内 AI 就绪检查，以及保留 90 天的可分享报告链接；限制为每网络每天 3 次检查，不含复查。

summary.en: Free: 5 OpenAI answers, 3 checks/day per network, link kept 90 days.
summary.zh: 免费 5 个 OpenAI 回答，每网络每天 3 次，链接保留 90 天。

description.en: The full report is a one-time $9 payment through Stripe with no account and no subscription. It runs 15 buyer-style questions, 2 runs each, on OpenAI and Claude with web search and on Gemini from model knowledge — 90 answers total — with per-engine scores, one re-check after 30 days and a shareable report link kept for 90 days. The upgrade runs for the same site and keywords confirmed in the free check.
description.zh: 完整报告通过 Stripe 一次性支付 $9，无需账户、无订阅。运行 15 个购买类问题、每题 2 次，OpenAI 与 Claude 联网回答、Gemini 依据模型知识回答，共 90 个回答，含分引擎得分、30 天后一次复查，以及保留 90 天的可分享报告链接；升级针对免费检查中确认的同一网站与关键词。

summary.en: $9 one-time (Stripe): 90 answers, 3 engines, 30-day re-check, no subscription.
summary.zh: 一次性 $9（Stripe）：90 个回答、3 个引擎、30 天后复查，无订阅。

description.en: The free check is limited to 3 checks per day per network.
description.zh: 免费检查限制为每网络每天 3 次。

summary.en: Free check capped at 3 per day per network.
summary.zh: 免费检查每网络每天 3 次。

description.en: OpenAI and Claude models answer through their official APIs with web search on, and a Gemini model answers through the Gemini API without web search from model knowledge. The tool does not test Perplexity, Google AI Overviews or the consumer ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini apps, and API answers can differ from what those apps show.
description.zh: OpenAI 与 Claude 模型经官方 API 联网回答，Gemini 模型经 Gemini API 依据模型知识回答、不联网。该工具不测试 Perplexity、Google AI Overviews 及消费端 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 应用，API 回答可能与应用内呈现不同。

summary.en: API answers only; Gemini without web search; no Perplexity, AI Overviews or consumer apps.
summary.zh: 仅 API 回答；Gemini 不联网；不含 Perplexity、AI Overviews 与消费端应用。

description.en: It is a one-time audit, not continuous monitoring: the full report asks a fixed set of questions with one re-check after 30 days on the same questions, and the shareable report link is kept for 90 days.
description.zh: 它是一次性审计而非持续监控：完整报告对固定问题集合作答，30 天后在同一问题上复查一次；可分享的报告链接保留 90 天。

summary.en: One-time audit; single 30-day re-check; report link kept 90 days.
summary.zh: 一次性审计；30 天后复查一次；链接保留 90 天。

description.en: Mentions and competitor names are detected by text matching and cited sources are classified into types by rules, which can be wrong at the edges; AI answers also vary from run to run, so the full report repeats each question twice and shows rates rather than single results.
description.zh: 品牌提及与竞品名称靠文本匹配识别，被引来源按规则分类，边界情况可能出错；AI 回答每次运行都可能不同，完整报告将每题重复 2 次并以比率呈现结果。

summary.en: Text matching and rule-based typing; answers vary, rates over single results.
summary.zh: 文本匹配与规则分类；答案有波动，以比率呈现。

description.en: Pick CheckAIVisibility for a one-time, low-cost audit of whether AI models recommend a site and which pages they cite; for daily tracking of many prompts, its own FAQ points to subscription tracking tools instead, which keep a continuous prompt set and dashboards. Within this tool, treat the free check as a quick look from a single engine and the $9 full report as the measurement: each question runs twice across three engines, so one unusual answer carries less weight.
description.zh: 需要一次性、低成本审计 AI 模型是否推荐某网站及引用哪些页面时，选择 CheckAIVisibility；若需每日追踪大量提示词，其官方 FAQ 建议改用订阅制追踪工具，后者维持持续提示词集合与看板。在本工具内部，把免费检查当作单引擎的快速查看，把 $9 完整报告当作正式测量：每题在三个引擎各运行 2 次，单个异常回答影响更小。

description.en: Monitor brand mentions, visibility, share of voice, citation rate and AI sentiment across major AI engines, and turn customer-service conversations into GEO articles AI can cite.
description.zh: 监测品牌在各主流 AI 引擎中的提及、可见性、声量份额、引用率与 AI 情绪，并把客服对话转化为可被 AI 引用的 GEO 文章。

en: Track brand mentions, visibility, share of voice, citation rate and AI sentiment on custom prompt sets, with daily monitoring of metric trends and competitor movements across markets and brands.
Mine real customer-service conversations for the questions buyers actually ask, produce citable GEO articles at scale, and break down which pages AI cites instead of yours.
zh: 在自定义提示词集合上追踪品牌提及、可见性、声量份额、引用率与 AI 情绪，按天监测指标趋势与竞品动向，覆盖多市场与多品牌。
从真实客服对话中挖掘买家实际问题，批量产出可被引用的 GEO 文章，并拆解 AI 回答引用了哪些页面。

audience.en: Brands and agencies that want AI recommendation metrics with daily tracking, especially teams already running Raccoon AI customer service whose conversations feed the content workflow.
audience.zh: 需要 AI 推荐指标与每日追踪的品牌和代理机构；已在运营 Raccoon AI 客服的团队可直接把对话沉淀为内容。

description.en: See where the brand stands in AI answers today: core metrics (brand mentions, visibility, share of voice, citation rate, AI sentiment) plus product-level recommendation results show which product AI recommends, which sources it cites and when it switches to a competitor.
description.zh: 查看品牌当前在 AI 回答中的位置：核心指标（品牌提及、可见性、声量份额、引用率、AI 情绪）加上商品级推荐结果，可以看到 AI 推荐哪款商品、引用哪些来源、何时转向竞品。

summary.en: Turn 'is AI recommending us' into per-product tracked metrics.
summary.zh: 把「AI 是否推荐我」变成可追踪的商品级指标。

description.en: Turn conversation insights into citable content and keep tracking: analyze real customer-service conversations for repeated questions and purchase concerns, generate GEO articles, then monitor daily whether visibility and citation share change after content goes live.
description.zh: 把对话洞察变成可引用的内容并持续追踪：分析客服对话中的高频问题与购买顾虑，生成 GEO 文章，再按天监测内容上线后可见性与引用份额的变化。

summary.en: Conversation-to-article workflow with daily post-publish tracking.
summary.zh: 对话转文章，并在发布后按天追踪效果。

description.en: Plans are billed per project per month on yearly billing, with no public amounts: Growth covers up to 50 active queries, 3 of 4 listed models (ChatGPT, Google AIO, AI Mode, Gemini), 5 tracking entities, unlimited seats, 3 articles per month and GA integration; Pro covers up to 100 active queries, 5 models (adding Perplexity and DeepSeek), 20 tracking entities, 6 articles per month, GA and Looker integration and multiple regions; Enterprise is custom with white-label support and API access. Yearly discounts are up to 5% on Growth and up to 10% on Pro.
description.zh: 套餐按项目按月计费、按年结账，未公开具体金额：Growth 支持最多 50 个活跃查询、4 个指定模型中选 3 个（ChatGPT、Google AIO、AI Mode、Gemini）、5 个追踪实体、不限席位、每月 3 篇文章与 GA 集成；Pro 支持最多 100 个活跃查询、5 个模型（增加 Perplexity 与 DeepSeek）、20 个追踪实体、每月 6 篇文章、GA 与 Looker 集成及多地区；Enterprise 按需定制，含白标与 API。年付折扣 Growth 最高 5%、Pro 最高 10%。

summary.en: Yearly-billed per project: Growth ≤50 queries / Pro ≤100 queries; amounts by contact only.
summary.zh: 按项目按年计费：Growth ≤50 题、Pro ≤100 题；金额需联系销售。

description.en: No plan amounts are published; every plan CTA goes to Contact Sales, so pricing cannot be compared self-serve.
description.zh: 官网不公布套餐金额，各套餐按钮均为联系销售，无法自助比价。

summary.en: No public plan amounts; contact sales only.
summary.zh: 无公开金额，只能联系销售。

description.en: The legal links in the footer are the Raccoon AI group-level documents (privacy policy, information security policy, customer terms of service); no GEO-product-specific terms were found on the product site.
description.zh: 页脚法律链接为 Raccoon AI 集团级文件（隐私政策、信息安全政策、客户服务条款），产品站内未见 GEO 产品专属条款。

summary.en: Legal pages are group-level; no GEO-specific terms.
summary.zh: 法律文件为集团级，无 GEO 专属条款。

description.en: The GEO article workflow is fed by conversations accumulated through Raccoon AI customer service; teams not using that service do not get the same conversation-sourced topic pipeline.
description.zh: GEO 文章工作流依赖 Raccoon AI 客服积累的对话；未使用该客服产品的团队无法获得同样的对话选题管线。

summary.en: Article topics come from Raccoon AI Service conversations.
summary.zh: 文章选题来自 Raccoon AI 客服对话。

description.en: Compare monitoring coverage with content production. Raccoon AI GEO pairs AI-visibility metrics with articles generated from its own customer-service conversations and bills per project on yearly contracts without public amounts; Peec AI focuses on visibility trends and competitor comparison dashboards and publishes self-serve prices, leaving content work to the team.
description.zh: 比较监测覆盖与内容生产。Raccoon AI GEO 把 AI 曝光指标与基于自有客服对话生成的文章绑定，按项目按年计费且不公开金额；Peec AI 聚焦可见性趋势与竞品对比看板，价格公开自助，内容工作留给团队。

description.en: AI search visibility platform that tracks what eight AI engines say about a brand, explains the competitive gaps behind missed mentions and carries fixes into approval-gated content and site workflows.
description.zh: AI 搜索可见性平台：追踪八个 AI 引擎如何回答品牌相关问题，解释错过提及背后的竞争差距，并把修复推进到带审批的内容与网站工作流。

en: Track visibility, share of voice, citations and sentiment per engine across ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Perplexity, Claude, Microsoft Copilot and Grok, with daily, weekly or on-demand refresh.

Turn gaps into a prioritized work queue with business research audits, weekly Autopilot checks, review-and-approval content drafts and WordPress or Vercel publishing, connected to GA, GSC, Bing Webmaster Tools and Microsoft Clarity.
zh: 按引擎追踪 ChatGPT、Gemini、Google AI Overviews、Google AI Mode、Perplexity、Claude、Microsoft Copilot 与 Grok 中的可见性、声量份额、引用与情绪，支持每日、每周或按需刷新。
把差距排成优先级工作队列：业务研究审计、每周 Autopilot 检查、带审核的内容草稿与 WordPress/Vercel 发布，可接入 GA、GSC、Bing 站长工具与 Microsoft Clarity。

audience.en: B2B marketing teams and agencies that want AI search intelligence plus an execution workflow; platform licenses are demo-gated and an expert-led growth program is offered alongside.
audience.zh: 需要 AI 搜索情报加执行工作流的 B2B 营销团队与代理机构；平台许可需预约演示，另有专家代运营增长计划。

description.en: See which buyer questions name the brand and which competitors win instead: every tracked question shows who the AI picked, why, and the sources it trusts, scored as visibility and share of voice per engine rather than one blended number.
description.zh: 查看哪些买家问题提到品牌、哪些竞品胜出：每个追踪问题都记录 AI 选了谁、为什么以及信任哪些来源，并按引擎分别给出可见性与声量份额，不合并成单一分数。

summary.en: Per-engine answers with who-won-why and trusted sources.
summary.zh: 按引擎查看答案、胜出原因与信任来源。

description.en: Run the intelligence-to-execution loop: organize buyer prompts by intent, connect competitive gaps to offers and existing content, ship reviewable drafts and site fixes through approval workflows, then re-run the same questions to measure what changed.
description.zh: 跑通情报到执行的闭环：按意图整理买家提示词，把竞争差距关联到自身业务与已有内容，经审批流程发布可审阅的草稿与网站修复，再重跑同一批问题衡量变化。

summary.en: Gap-to-fix loop with approval gates and re-measurement.
summary.zh: 差距到修复的闭环，带审批与复测。

description.en: Platform plans and the expert-led growth program are custom: the pricing page quotes no amounts and lists every quota (visibility prompt responses, content creation pieces, business research audits, deep content audits and site readiness checks per month) as Custom across brands and domains. Platform licenses and programs are invoiced on the commercial terms in the agreement.
description.zh: 平台套餐与专家代运营计划均为定制：定价页不报金额，可见性提示词响应、内容创作篇数、业务研究审计、深度内容审计与站点就绪检查等各项月度额度对所有品牌与域名均标注 Custom。平台许可与计划按协议约定开票结算。

summary.en: All quotas and prices are custom; invoiced per agreement.
summary.zh: 全部额度与价格定制，按协议开票。

description.en: The Expert-Led Growth program starts with a 3-month pilot with success criteria in writing, then continues on a minimum six-month or annual commitment; scope and pricing are agreed before kickoff.
description.zh: 专家代运营增长计划以 3 个月试点开始（书面成功标准），之后至少延续 6 个月或按年签约；范围与价格在启动前商定。

summary.en: Expert-led program: 3-month pilot, then 6-month or annual minimum.
summary.zh: 专家计划：3 个月试点，至少 6 个月或年约。

description.en: There is no self-serve pricing or trial for the platform; access starts with a demo on the brand, and a 30-minute paid-growth session is the entry point for the expert-led program.
description.zh: 平台没有自助价格或试用，需以品牌为对象预约演示；专家计划入口为 30 分钟增长会谈。

summary.en: Demo-gated access; no self-serve pricing or trial.
summary.zh: 需预约演示，无自助价格与试用。

description.en: The vendor also runs an expert-led, agency-style growth program (website, positioning, SEO, content and AI search delivered by its team); it is a separate engagement from the platform and does not make the product a pure monitoring tool.
description.zh: 厂商同时经营专家代运营式增长计划（由其团队交付网站、定位、SEO、内容与 AI 搜索），与平台属不同合作形态，产品并非纯监测工具。

summary.en: Vendor also sells a done-with-you growth program.
summary.zh: 厂商另有代运营增长计划。

description.en: Compare monitoring depth against execution scope. Genmark AI prices custom, covers eight engines per answer and pushes fixes through approval-gated content workflows; Profound targets enterprise AI search analytics with its own published product structure, leaving delivery to the customer.
description.zh: 比较监测深度与执行范围。Genmark AI 定制计价、按八引擎出答案，并把修复推进到带审批的内容工作流；Profound 面向企业级 AI 搜索分析，交付由客户自己完成。

description.en: Audit-first AI visibility tool: a free headless-browser scan scores a site across seven dimensions, checks AI crawler access and citability, and paid plans add weekly engine checks plus an Auto-Fix Agent that writes pull requests.
description.zh: 审计优先的 AI 可见性工具：免费无头浏览器扫描按七个维度为网站打分、核验 AI 爬虫访问与可引用性；付费套餐增加每周引擎检查，并由 Auto-Fix Agent 生成修复 PR。

en: Score SEO, AEO and GEO lenses across seven dimensions — technical infrastructure, AI crawler access, schema markup, citability, platform optimization, content quality and brand mentions — with every finding tied to a URL, file and fix.

Weekly Monday checks ask 10 buyer questions on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude, track up to 2 fixes per site per month with day-7/14/28 re-asks, and the Auto-Fix Agent writes fix PRs; daily crawler alerts and rescans included.
zh: 按 SEO、AEO、GEO 三个视角为七个维度打分——技术基础设施、AI 爬虫访问、结构化数据、可引用性、平台优化、内容质量与品牌提及——每条发现都附带 URL、文件与修复方式。
每周一在 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini 与 Claude 上提出 10 个买家问题，按站点每月追踪最多 2 个修复并在第 7/14/28 天复测，Auto-Fix Agent 生成修复 PR；含每日爬虫告警与重扫。

audience.en: Developers, marketing teams and SEO agencies that want audit findings shipped as pull requests through their own code workflow.
audience.zh: 希望把审计发现以 PR 形式接入自己代码工作流的开发者、营销团队与 SEO 代理。

description.en: Run a free scan on any public URL: a real headless-browser crawl scores seven AI visibility dimensions in under 30 seconds, reports which of the audited crawlers are let in or blocked with exact locations, and returns a 0-100 score with prioritized issues.
description.zh: 对任意公开 URL 免费扫描：真实无头浏览器抓取在 30 秒内为七个 AI 可见性维度打分，报告 12 个受审爬虫各自的放行或拦截位置，并给出 0-100 分与按优先级排序的问题清单。

summary.en: Free 30-second scan with per-crawler access report.
summary.zh: 免费 30 秒扫描，逐爬虫报告访问权限。

description.en: Subscribe to keep measuring and shipping: weekly engine checks with a ranked next-move list, tracked fixes re-checked on days 7, 14 and 28, Auto-Fix Agent runs that draft PRs, daily crawler alerts and up to 15 rescans a day on Standard.
description.zh: 订阅后持续测量与交付：每周引擎检查给出按优先级排序的下一步清单，被追踪的修复在第 7、14、28 天复测，Auto-Fix Agent 起草修复 PR，含每日爬虫告警与 Standard 每天 15 次重扫。

summary.en: Weekly engine checks plus Auto-Fix PRs on paid plans.
summary.zh: 付费套餐含每周引擎检查与 Auto-Fix PR。

description.en: The free plan covers 1 total URL slot with no rescans or reports. Standard is $49/month or $399/year (an effective $33/month, a 32% saving): one website, weekly 10-question checks on four engines, up to 2 tracked fixes per site per month, 2 Auto-Fix Agent runs per month, 15 rescans per day, 3 visibility executive reports per month and daily crawler alerts; extra site slots cost $9.99 each. Pro is $149/month or $1,240/year (effective $103/month) for five websites with 10 runs, 10 reports and 50 rescans per day. Agency is $299/month. Monthly is the default view; annual pays 12 months up front while monthly quotas still refill.
description.zh: 免费版含 1 个 URL 名额，无重扫与报告。Standard 为每月 49 美元或每年 399 美元（折合每月 33 美元，省 32%）：1 个网站、每周在 4 个引擎上提出 10 个问题、每站点每月追踪最多 2 个修复、每月 2 次 Auto-Fix Agent、每天 15 次重扫、每月 3 份可见性报告与每日爬虫告警；额外站点名额每个 9.99 美元。Pro 为每月 149 美元或每年 1,240 美元（折合每月 103 美元），覆盖 5 个网站、每月 10 次执行、10 份报告与每天 50 次重扫。Agency 为每月 299 美元。页面默认月付；年付一次付 12 个月，月度额度照常刷新。

summary.en: Free 1 slot; Standard $49/mo ($399/yr); Pro $149/mo; Agency $299/mo.
summary.zh: 免费 1 名额；Standard 每月 49 美元（年 399）；Pro 每月 149；Agency 每月 299。

description.en: Visibility checks run on four engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude) with 10 questions per week per site; the crawler audit covers a fixed list of 12 crawlers such as GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended.
description.zh: 可见性检查覆盖 4 个引擎（ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Claude），每站点每周 10 个问题；爬虫审计覆盖 GPTBot、ClaudeBot、PerplexityBot、Google-Extended 等 12 个固定爬虫名单。

summary.en: 4 engines for checks; fixed 12-crawler audit list.
summary.zh: 检查覆盖 4 引擎；爬虫审计为固定 12 个名单。

description.en: The about page says Standard includes up to 3 website URL slots, while the pricing page FAQ states one website with extra slots at $9.99; the pricing page is treated as the operative source and the discrepancy should be confirmed before purchase.
description.zh: 关于页称 Standard 含最多 3 个站点名额，定价页 FAQ 则写明 1 个网站、额外名额每个 9.99 美元；本记录以定价页为准，购买前应确认口径。

summary.en: About page and pricing page disagree on Standard slot count.
summary.zh: 关于页与定价页对 Standard 名额数说法不一。

description.en: The operator is named as AgentAxis Corp in the terms and about page; the governing-law clause points to the jurisdiction where AgentAxis Corp is established without naming it, and no registered address is published.
description.zh: 条款与关于页将运营主体写为 AgentAxis Corp；管辖法条指向其注册地司法辖区但未写明具体法域，官网亦未公布注册地址。

summary.en: Operator AgentAxis Corp; governing jurisdiction unnamed.
summary.zh: 运营主体 AgentAxis Corp，未公布注册地与具体法域。

description.en: Compare audit depth against delivery format. CiteFlow scores seven site dimensions, reports per-crawler access and ships fixes as Auto-Fix Agent pull requests on a four-engine weekly check; Seomator's GEO audit is a report-style site audit without an in-product fix-delivery loop.
description.zh: 比较审计深度与交付形式。CiteFlow 为七个站点维度打分、逐爬虫报告访问权限，并通过 Auto-Fix Agent 以 PR 形式交付修复，配合四引擎每周检查；Seomator 的 GEO 审计以报告形式交付，产品内没有修复交付闭环。

description.en: Weekly buyer-question tracking on ChatGPT, Claude and Google engines that records who each answer names, keeps the cited pages as evidence and turns gaps into site fixes; an 18-tool free suite needs no signup.
description.zh: 每周在 ChatGPT、Claude 与 Google 引擎上追踪买家提问，记录每个回答点名了谁、把被引页面留作证据，并把差距转化为网站修复建议；另附 18 个免注册免费工具。

en: Ask a fixed set of buyer questions weekly and record whether each answer names your brand or a competitor, with share-of-AI-voice reporting across the question set.
Keep the pages each answer cites as evidence, generate site fixes with that evidence attached, and keep checking whether the engines start naming you; free check and tools work without signup.
zh: 每周提出固定的一组买家问题，记录每个回答点名了你的品牌还是竞品，并按问题集合报告 AI 声量份额。
把每个回答引用的页面留作证据，生成附带证据的网站修复建议，并持续检查引擎是否开始点名你；免费检查与工具无需注册。

audience.en: Small businesses and solo marketers that want to know whether AI names their business, run as a solo-founder product with no demo wall.
audience.zh: 想知道 AI 是否点名自己业务的小企业与独立营销人；产品由独立开发者运营，无演示墙。

description.en: Track a weekly question set: CueScout asks your buyer questions on the covered engines, reports how often AI names each brand across the set with share of AI voice, and keeps the last check's explanations per question.
description.zh: 追踪每周问题集：CueScout 在覆盖引擎上提出买家问题，按问题集报告各品牌被 AI 点名的频率与 AI 声量份额，并保留上次检查的分题解释。

summary.en: Weekly question set with share-of-AI-voice report.
summary.zh: 每周问题集，报告 AI 声量份额。

description.en: Start free without signup: the homepage check asks three buyer questions on ChatGPT, Claude and Google, and the 18 tools on /tools (citation source radar, visibility checker, query fan-out and more) run with per-network daily limits, email required only for the citation radar.
description.zh: 免注册免费起步：首页检查在 ChatGPT、Claude 与 Google 上提出 3 个买家问题；/tools 下 18 个工具（引用来源雷达、可见性检查器、查询扇出等）按网络设每日次数限制，仅引用雷达需要邮箱。

summary.en: Free 3-question check plus 18 no-signup tools.
summary.zh: 免费 3 题检查＋18 个免注册工具。

description.en: Starter is $49/month for 20 buyer questions asked every week on ChatGPT, Claude and Google AI Overviews with 150 chat credits a month; Growth is $189/month for 100 questions and adds Gemini and Google AI Mode with 600 credits. A year costs ten months ($490 Starter, $1,890 Growth). Monthly credits roll over up to one month's worth and pack credits last 12 months. Prices last changed on October 7, 2026; checkout, renewals, cancellations and refunds are handled by Polar as merchant of record.
description.zh: Starter 每月 49 美元：每周在 ChatGPT、Claude 与 Google AI Overviews 上提出 20 个买家问题，每月 150 个对话积分；Growth 每月 189 美元：100 个问题并增加 Gemini 与 Google AI Mode，每月 600 积分。年付按 10 个月计（Starter 490 美元、Growth 1,890 美元）。月度积分最多滚存一个月用量，积分包有效期 12 个月。价格最近于 2026 年 10 月 7 日调整；结账、续费、取消与退款由 Polar 作为记录商户处理。

summary.en: Starter $49/mo (20 questions); Growth $189/mo (100 questions); yearly = 10 months.
summary.zh: Starter 每月 49 美元（20 题）；Growth 每月 189 美元（100 题）；年付按 10 个月计。

description.en: CueScout is built and run by a named solo founder; no registered company is disclosed, with billing, refunds and compliance routed through Polar as merchant of record.
description.zh: CueScout 由实名独立开发者构建运营，未披露注册公司；结账、退款与合规由 Polar 作为记录商户处理。

summary.en: Solo-founder product; billing via Polar as merchant of record.
summary.zh: 独立开发者产品，Polar 代收结算。

description.en: Starter tracks ChatGPT, Claude and Google AI Overviews only; Gemini and Google AI Mode require the Growth plan, and weekly recurring tracking is paid — the free tier is a one-off 3-question check plus rate-limited tools.
description.zh: Starter 仅追踪 ChatGPT、Claude 与 Google AI Overviews；Gemini 与 Google AI Mode 需 Growth 套餐。每周持续追踪为付费功能——免费档只是 3 题一次性检查加限量工具。

summary.en: Growth plan required for Gemini and Google AI Mode.
summary.zh: Gemini 与 Google AI Mode 需 Growth 套餐。

description.en: Compare recurring tracking against one-off checking. CueScout re-asks a fixed buyer-question set every week with share-of-voice reports and evidence-backed site fixes on a subscription; CheckAIVisibility runs a one-off free multi-engine check whose full paid report is a single $9 deep-dive, so it suits spot checks rather than weekly monitoring.
description.zh: 比较持续追踪与一次性检查。CueScout 按订阅每周重问固定买家问题集，产出声量份额报告与带证据的修复建议；CheckAIVisibility 提供一次性免费多引擎检查，9 美元完整报告为单次深度分析，适合临时抽查而非每周监测。

description.en: Chinese-language GEO monitoring platform by TIMUS.AI that tracks brand rankings, sentiment and citation sources on five Chinese AI engines with real-account collection, plus an e-commerce edition that monitors AI product cards in Doubao and Qwen apps.
description.zh: TIMUS.AI 旗下的中文 GEO 监测平台：以真实账号采集方式追踪品牌在五个中文 AI 引擎中的排名、舆情与引用来源，并提供监测豆包与千问 APP 内 AI 商品卡的电商版。

en: Daily monitoring of brand rankings, sentiment, search snapshots and citation sources on five Chinese AI engines (Doubao, DeepSeek, ERNIE, Qwen, Tencent Yuanbao), with web and app endpoints and one-off brand diagnosis without a subscription.

E-commerce edition tracks AI product cards in Doubao and Qwen apps — brand-card share, top-3 rate and first-card rate per question — with archived card evidence covering titles, prices, stores and sales copy.
zh: 按天监测五个中文 AI 引擎（豆包、DeepSeek、文心一言、通义千问、元宝）中的品牌排名、舆情、搜索快照与引用来源，支持网页端与 APP 端，并可不经订阅先做单次品牌诊断。
电商版追踪豆包与千问 APP 内的 AI 商品卡——按问题统计品牌卡展现率、Top3 卡率与首卡率，并归档标题、价格、店铺与销量文案等卡面证据。

audience.en: Teams monitoring how Chinese AI engines rank and describe their brand, and e-commerce brands that want AI product-card exposure in Doubao and Qwen apps; the flagship tier targets multi-brand groups.
audience.zh: 需要监测中文 AI 引擎如何排名与描述自身品牌的团队，以及关心豆包、千问 APP 内 AI 商品卡曝光的电商品牌；旗舰版面向集团与多品牌企业。

description.en: Monitor a brand on Chinese AI engines before committing to a programme: the free tier covers 3 questions on 3 web engines with real-account collection, ranking analysis and sentiment analysis, and a one-off diagnosis runs without a subscription.
description.zh: 在长期投入前先在中文 AI 引擎上监测品牌：免费版覆盖 3 个监控问题、3 个网页端引擎，具备真实账号采集、品牌排名分析与品牌舆情分析；单次品牌诊断无需订阅。

summary.en: Free 3-question start plus one-off diagnosis without subscription.
summary.zh: 免费 3 题起步，单次诊断无需订阅。

description.en: Track AI shopping exposure with the e-commerce edition: users asking 'which brand is good' in Doubao or Qwen apps get clickable product cards, and the platform monitors which questions show your card versus competitor cards, with card-face evidence archived including titles, prices, stores and sales copy.
description.zh: 用电商版追踪 AI 购物曝光：用户在豆包或千问 APP 问「什么牌子好」会得到可点击商品卡，平台监测哪些问题出你的卡、哪些只出竞品卡，并归档标题、价格、店铺与销量文案等卡面证据。

summary.en: Product-card monitoring with archived card evidence.
summary.zh: 商品卡监测，卡面证据归档。

description.en: Monitoring is priced per brand subscription in CNY: the free tier is ¥0 with 3 monitored questions on 3 web engines; Starter is ¥79/month with 8 questions and all five engines selectable on web or app; Basic is ¥199/month with 30 questions and a dedicated account manager; Professional is ¥499/month with 100 questions and 7x24 support. The e-commerce edition is quote-fixed by selection: 30 questions app-only ¥439/month, app plus web ¥638/month, 100 questions app-only ¥799/month, app plus web ¥1,298/month. All paid tiers take 20% off for 3 months and 30% off for 12 months, and credits (¥1 = 10 credits) can offset payment. Copywriting and media placement are billed separately by credits.
description.zh: 监测按品牌订阅以人民币计价：免费版 ¥0，含 3 个监控问题、3 个网页端引擎；入门版 ¥79/月，8 题，五大引擎按网页端或 APP 端选择；基础版 ¥199/月，30 题并配专属客户经理；专业版 ¥499/月，100 题加 7×24 小时技术支持。电商版按选配一口价：30 题 APP 端 ¥439/月、APP+网页端 ¥638/月，100 题 APP 端 ¥799/月、APP+网页端 ¥1,298/月。付费档 3 个月 8 折、12 个月 7 折，积分（¥1=10 积分）可抵现。撰稿与发稿按积分另行计费。

summary.en: Free tier ¥0; ¥79/¥199/¥499 per month by question volume; e-commerce edition from ¥439/month.

description.en: The site publishes no standalone privacy policy or terms-of-service page; operator information (company name, address, phone and the ICP filing number) is disclosed in the page footer.
description.zh: 官网未提供独立的隐私政策或服务条款页面；运营主体信息（公司名、地址、电话与 ICP 备案号）在页脚披露。

summary.en: No standalone legal pages; operator disclosed in footer.
summary.zh: 无独立法律页；主体信息在页脚。

description.en: The platform also sells copywriting, media placement and managed-operation services (billed by credits or custom quotes); monitoring and content services are billed separately, so it is not a pure monitoring tool.
description.zh: 平台同时提供撰稿、发稿与专属代运营服务（按积分或定制报价）；监测与内容服务分开计费，并非纯监测工具。

summary.en: Also sells content publishing and managed services, billed separately.
summary.zh: 另有撰稿发稿与代运营业务，分开计费。

description.en: The pricing page notes that supported AI models may adjust dynamically with each platform's situation and actual service prevails; the e-commerce product-card coverage currently lists Doubao and Qwen apps with Tencent Yuanbao marked as upcoming.
description.zh: 定价页注明当前支持的 AI 模型覆盖范围可能随各平台情况动态调整，以实际服务为准；电商商品卡目前列出豆包与千问 APP，元宝 APP 标注即将上线。

summary.en: Engine coverage may change; Yuanbao cards marked upcoming.
summary.zh: 引擎覆盖可能调整；元宝商品卡标注即将上线。

description.en: Compare Chinese-engine monitoring styles. Lens GEO publishes self-serve CNY pricing with app-end real-account collection and e-commerce product-card tracking; MicoSeek emphasizes brand knowledge-base consistency checks with credit-metered detection and no confirmed public unit price.
description.zh: 比较中文引擎监测路线。透镜GEO 公开自助人民币定价，支持 APP 端真实账号采集与电商商品卡追踪；觅恒侧重品牌知识库一致性检查，按积分计费且当前单价未确认。

description.en: AI visibility monitoring for businesses that tracks recommendations, competitors and citations across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI, with site audits, optional Search Console query import and article drafts. Founding paid plans start at €23/month; the seven-day trial requires a card and converts automatically unless canceled.
description.zh: 面向企业与小型营销团队的 AI 曝光监测工具，追踪 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity 与 Google AI 回答中的品牌推荐、竞品和引用，并提供网站审计、可选的 Search Console 查询导入与文章草稿。创始付费方案 €23/月起；7 天试用需绑定信用卡，到期未取消会自动续费。

en: Monitor ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode, with saved answers, mentions, position, tone, alternatives, citations, mention rates and competitor share of voice.
Run technical SEO, speed, schema, crawler-access, llms.txt and AI-readiness audits; the user implements the suggested fixes.
Optionally import up to 100 read-only Search Console queries from the past 28 days, and schedule separate keyword rank checks.
Generate article outlines and drafts with claim checks, then edit and approve content before publication.
zh: 监测 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity、Google AI Overviews 与 Google AI Mode，保存回答并统计提及、位置、语气、替代品牌、引用、提及率和竞品声量占比。
检查技术 SEO、速度、Schema、爬虫访问、llms.txt 与 AI 就绪度；修复建议由用户自行实施。
可选只读导入过去 28 天最多 100 条 Search Console 查询，并另行安排关键词排名检查。
生成文章大纲与草稿、检查声明，经人工编辑和确认后再发布。

audience.en: Businesses and small marketing teams that want AI-answer monitoring alongside site audits, competitor comparisons and a guided editorial workflow.
audience.zh: 希望把 AI 回答监测与网站审计、竞品比较及文章编辑流程放在同一工作流中的企业和小型营销团队。

description.en: Compare brand and competitor visibility on a saved set of customer questions, then inspect the archived answers and cited pages to identify where another brand is recommended and which sources are being referenced.
description.zh: 在保存的客户问题集合上比较品牌与竞品曝光，再查看归档回答和被引页面，识别哪些问题推荐了其他品牌以及回答引用了哪些来源。

summary.en: Compare brand and competitor visibility, then inspect answers and citations.
summary.zh: 比较品牌与竞品曝光，并检查回答和引用来源。

description.en: Turn audit findings and real Search Console queries into an editorial queue: identify site or AI-readiness issues, import relevant queries, draft articles and check claims before a person approves publication.
description.zh: 把审计发现和真实 Search Console 查询转为编辑队列：找出网站或 AI 就绪度问题，导入相关查询，生成文章草稿并检查声明，最后由人工确认发布。

summary.en: Move audit findings and Search Console queries into reviewed article drafts.
summary.zh: 将审计发现与 Search Console 查询转为经人工审核的文章草稿。

label.zh: Florank AI 曝光监测文档
Florank 竞品声量占比文档
Florank Google Search Console 文档
Peec AI 官方产品功能

description.en: The observed founding monthly prices are €23 for Starter, €49 for Growth and €99 for Agency, with regular monthly prices of €29, €79 and €199. Founding yearly billing totals €232, €474 and €995 (displayed as €19, €40 and €83 per month); regular yearly totals are €290, €790 and €1,990. The documentation says the displayed founding prices already include the discount and require no promo code. There is no ongoing free monitoring plan; VAT is not charged at the time of verification.
description.zh: 观察到的创始月价为 Starter 23 欧元、Growth 49 欧元、Agency 99 欧元，常规月价为 29、79、199 欧元。创始年付总额为 232、474、995 欧元（页面折合每月 19、40、83 欧元），常规年付总额为 290、790、1,990 欧元。文档称创始价已含折扣，无需优惠码。没有持续免费的监测套餐；核验时暂不收取 VAT。

summary.en: Founding €23/€49/€99 monthly or €232/€474/€995 yearly; regular €29/€79/€199 monthly; no ongoing free plan.
summary.zh: 创始价 23／49／99 欧元每月或 232／474／995 欧元每年；常规价 29／79／199 欧元每月；无持续免费套餐。

description.en: The seven-day trial is available once per account, requires a payment card, starts at €0 and automatically converts to the selected paid plan unless canceled. Growth is the default, with Starter and Agency selectable. The first charge after a trial or a new subscription can be refunded on request by email within 14 days; later billing periods are not refunded.
description.zh: 7 天试用每个账户限一次，需绑定支付信用卡，初始为 0 欧元，到期未取消会自动转为所选付费方案。默认 Growth，也可选择 Starter 或 Agency。试用或新订阅后的首笔扣款可在 14 天内发邮件申请退款；后续账期不退款。

summary.en: 7-day card-required trial auto-converts; first charge refundable by email within 14 days.
summary.zh: 7 天试用需绑卡并自动续费；首笔扣款可在 14 天内邮件申请退款。

description.en: Optional add-ons include up to ten packs of 50 extra prompts at €15 per pack per month. Article packs cost €19 for 10 articles or €49 for 30 articles and remain valid for 90 days.
description.zh: 可选加购包括最多十包、每包 50 个额外提示词，每包每月 15 欧元。文章包 10 篇 19 欧元或 30 篇 49 欧元，有效期 90 天。

summary.en: Add-ons: 50 extra prompts €15/month (up to 10 packs); 10/30 articles €19/€49 for 90 days.
summary.zh: 加购：50 个额外提示词 15 欧元/月（最多十包）；10／30 篇文章 19／49 欧元，有效期 90 天。

description.en: Plan tables list Starter/Growth/Agency allowances of 1/3/10 sites and users, 20/50/120 account-wide prompts, 5/15/50 competitors per site, 20/50/150 keywords per site, 50/200/1,000 audit pages and 10/30/100 articles per month account-wide. Starter samples ChatGPT weekly, Gemini and Perplexity twice weekly, and Google AI weekly; higher tiers increase cadence. Cost controls can temporarily reduce AI checks to weekly, and branded queries are excluded from overall visibility.
description.zh: 套餐表列出 Starter／Growth／Agency 分别有 1／3／10 个站点和用户、20／50／120 个账户级提示词、每站 5／15／50 个竞品、每站 20／50／150 个关键词、50／200／1,000 个审计页面，以及账户级每月 10／30／100 篇文章。Starter 对 ChatGPT 每周采样，Gemini 与 Perplexity 每周两次，Google AI 每周一次；更高档提高频率。成本控制可能临时把 AI 检查降为每周一次，品牌词查询不计入整体曝光。

summary.en: Starter: 1 site/user, 20 prompts, 20 keywords/site, 50 audit pages, 10 articles/month; cadence varies and may slow to weekly.
summary.zh: Starter：1 站点／用户、20 提示词、每站 20 关键词、50 审计页、每月 10 篇文章；采样频率因档位而异，也可能降至每周。

description.en: Search Console integration is optional and read-only, importing up to 100 queries from the past 28 days; scheduled keyword checks are a separate feature. The interface and generated content currently support English and Ukrainian.
description.zh: Search Console 集成为可选且只读，最多导入过去 28 天的 100 条查询；定时关键词检查是另一项功能。界面与生成内容目前支持英语和乌克兰语。

summary.en: Optional read-only Search Console import; separate keyword checks; English/Ukrainian only.
summary.zh: 可选只读 Search Console 导入；关键词检查另计；目前仅支持英语和乌克兰语。

description.en: Prompts, public page content and article data may be sent to AI processors including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Perplexity and DataForSEO when needed for the task. Some processing occurs in the US under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses. The privacy policy also describes server-side Meta conversion events without cookie consent under legitimate interest, plus a 90-day attribution cookie; users can object to those uses.
description.zh: 完成任务确有需要时，提示词、公开页面内容和文章数据可能发送给 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Perplexity 与 DataForSEO 等 AI 处理方。部分处理在美国进行，依据欧盟—美国数据隐私框架或标准合同条款。隐私政策还说明，在未取得 Cookie 同意的情况下，基于合法权益发送服务端 Meta 转化事件，并使用 90 天归因 Cookie；用户可提出反对。

summary.en: Task data may reach US AI processors; Meta server-side events use legitimate interest without cookie consent.
summary.zh: 任务数据可能交由美国 AI 处理方；Meta 服务端事件无需 Cookie 同意、以合法权益为依据。

description.en: AI-generated articles can be inaccurate and require human editing and approval before publication. Rankings, AI mentions and other outcomes are not guaranteed, and the site audit reports findings rather than implementing fixes automatically.
description.zh: AI 生成的文章可能不准确，发布前需要人工编辑和确认。排名、AI 提及等结果不作保证，网站审计只报告发现，不会自动实施修复。

summary.en: AI drafts need human review; no ranking or mention guarantees; audits do not auto-fix.
summary.zh: AI 草稿需人工审核；不保证排名或提及；审计不自动修复。

description.en: Compare entry scope and billing currency. Florank's founding Starter plan is €23/month with 20 prompts, one site and one user, plus audits, article drafts and optional Search Console import. Peec AI Starter is $95/month with 50 prompts, one project, three selectable models and daily tracking. Florank's seven-day trial requires a card and converts automatically; compare quotas, engine selection and editorial features rather than price alone.
description.zh: 比较入门范围与计费币种。Florank 创始 Starter 为 23 欧元/月，含 20 个提示词、1 个站点和 1 个用户，并提供审计、文章草稿与可选 Search Console 导入。Peec AI Starter 为 95 美元/月，含 50 个提示词、1 个项目、3 个可选模型和每日追踪。Florank 的 7 天试用需绑卡并自动续费；应综合比较配额、引擎选择与编辑功能，而非只看价格。

description.en: Free GEO readiness audits with paid AI-answer measurement and human-approved content workflows.
description.zh: 提供免费 GEO 就绪度审计，以及付费 AI 回答监测和人工确认的内容工作流。

en: Run a no-account 0–100 readiness audit covering technical setup, editorial quality, structured data, Answer-First content and prioritized fixes.
Use Autopilot or a bring-your-own-key plan for measured AI answers and content drafts that require human approval before publication.
zh: 无需账户即可运行 0–100 分就绪度审计，检查技术配置、编辑质量、结构化数据、Answer-First 内容并给出优先修复项。
通过 Autopilot 或自带 API Key 方案监测 AI 回答并生成内容草稿，发布前必须人工确认。

audience.en: Site owners that want a free technical and editorial GEO baseline before choosing ongoing AI measurement or content production.
audience.zh: 希望先获得免费技术与编辑 GEO 基线，再决定是否采用持续 AI 监测或内容生产的网站所有者。

description.en: Before buying ongoing monitoring, run the free readiness audit to identify technical, editorial and structured-data gaps and turn the findings into a prioritized fix list. The free score assesses readiness; it is not a live measurement of brand mentions in AI answers.
description.zh: 在购买持续监测前运行免费就绪度审计，找出技术、编辑和结构化数据缺口，并将结果整理为优先修复清单。免费分数评估的是就绪度，不是品牌在 AI 回答中的实时提及测量。

summary.en: Free no-account 0–100 readiness score with prioritized fixes, not live mention tracking.
summary.zh: 免费免账户 0–100 就绪度评分与优先修复项，不是实时提及追踪。

description.en: For an ongoing content workflow, use Autopilot or BYOK to prepare buyer questions, competitor-informed content plans and page drafts. An author model, an independent reviewer and a finalizer form the editing chain, with factual and competitor checks; outputs are delivered as WordPress drafts, GitHub PRs in beta or exports for human approval.
description.zh: 需要持续内容工作流时，用 Autopilot 或 BYOK 准备买家问题、结合竞品的内容计划和页面草稿。编辑链由作者模型、独立审核模型和最终整理模型组成，并设置事实与竞品检查；成果以 WordPress 草稿、GitHub PR 测试版或导出文件交付，须人工确认。

summary.en: Autopilot/BYOK produce reviewable drafts and exports; nothing publishes automatically.
summary.zh: Autopilot／BYOK 生成可审核草稿与导出文件，不自动发布。

label.en: GEO Tool official product and free audit
label.zh: GEO Tool 官方产品与免费审计

label.en: GEO Tool pricing, Autopilot and BYOK
label.zh: GEO Tool 定价、Autopilot 与 BYOK

description.en: The readiness audit is free and requires no account. A one-time seven-day trial costs $9 plus tax and includes 7 buyer questions, 5 AI systems and 7 content plans; if it is not canceled, it converts to Autopilot at $229/month plus tax.
description.zh: 就绪度审计免费且无需账户。一次性 7 天试用为 9 美元加税，含 7 个买家问题、5 个 AI 系统和 7 个内容计划；到期未取消将转为每月 229 美元加税的 Autopilot。

summary.en: Free audit; one-time $9 plus-tax 7-day trial auto-converts to Autopilot at $229/month plus tax.
summary.zh: 审计免费；一次性 9 美元加税试用 7 天，未取消自动转为 229 美元/月加税的 Autopilot。

description.en: Autopilot costs $229/month plus tax and can be canceled monthly. Its scope includes up to 100 buyer questions, 5 AI systems, 10 competitors, 50 content plans and 50 target pages. The included AI budget is described as normally covering about 10–20 fully reviewed articles or page updates per month, subject to a fair-use cap.
description.zh: Autopilot 每月 229 美元加税，可按月取消。范围包括最多 100 个买家问题、5 个 AI 系统、10 个竞品、50 个内容计划和 50 个目标页面。官方称所含 AI 预算通常每月可覆盖约 10–20 篇完整审核文章或页面更新，并受合理使用上限约束。

summary.en: Autopilot $229/month plus tax; 100 questions, 5 AI systems, 10 competitors, 50 plans/pages; fair-use AI budget.
summary.zh: Autopilot 229 美元/月加税；100 问题、5 AI 系统、10 个竞品、50 计划／页面；AI 预算有合理使用上限。

description.en: BYOK gives each company a seven-day free introduction, then costs $44.90/month plus tax. Customers supply their own OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI or Mistral key and pay model charges directly to the provider; the documented Autopilot scope and three-model editing chain are retained.
description.zh: BYOK 为每家公司提供 7 天免费体验，之后每月 44.90 美元加税。客户使用自有 OpenRouter、Anthropic、OpenAI 或 Mistral Key，模型费用直接支付给供应商；保留文档所列 Autopilot 范围和三模型编辑链。

summary.en: BYOK $44.90/month plus tax after 7 free days per company; provider API charges are separate.
summary.zh: BYOK 每家公司免费 7 天后 44.90 美元/月加税；供应商 API 费用另计。

description.en: ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews are measured daily in the paid workflow, while the other three systems are checked every two days. The readiness score alone does not measure live AI mentions, and generated content is never published automatically.
description.zh: 付费工作流每日测量 ChatGPT 与 Google AI Overviews，其余三个系统每两天检查一次。就绪度分数本身不测量实时 AI 提及，生成内容也绝不自动发布。

summary.en: Daily checks for ChatGPT/AI Overviews, every two days for three other systems; human approval required.
summary.zh: ChatGPT／AI Overviews 每日检查，另三个系统每两天一次；须人工确认。

description.en: The BYOK progress guarantee covers platform fees only and requires a Search Console connection plus at least five recommended updates published within 45 days. After 60 paid days without improvement in AI mentions or Search Console clicks, a request must be emailed within 14 days for 30 days of free platform fees; third-party API charges are excluded.
description.zh: BYOK 进展保障仅覆盖平台费，且要求连接 Search Console，并在 45 天内发布至少五项推荐更新。使用 60 个付费日后，若 AI 提及或 Search Console 点击没有改善，须在 14 天内发邮件申请 30 天免费平台费；第三方 API 费用不在保障内。

summary.en: BYOK guarantee has connection, publishing and timing conditions; only platform fees qualify.
summary.zh: BYOK 保障有连接、发布与时限条件，且仅覆盖平台费。

description.en: The privacy notice describes German EU hosting and several model/data processors, but its subprocessor table also contains instructions to verify the production stack and DPA/SCC/DPF status. Treat those compliance statements as vendor disclosures rather than independent assurance. The terms are B2B-only, the German version controls, and AI results and business outcomes are not guaranteed.
description.zh: 隐私声明描述了德国欧盟托管和多个模型／数据处理方，但其处理方清单也含有核对生产环境及 DPA／SCC／DPF 状态的提示。应将这些合规说明视为厂商披露，而非独立认证。条款仅面向 B2B，德文版优先，且不保证 AI 结果或业务成效。

summary.en: Subprocessor compliance details need vendor verification; B2B terms, German text controls, no outcome guarantees.
summary.zh: 处理方合规细节需厂商核验；仅面向 B2B、德文版优先，不保证结果。

description.en: GEO Tool starts with a persistent free readiness audit and adds optional content-production Autopilot or BYOK. Florank centers on paid AI-answer monitoring with site audits and article drafts and has no ongoing free monitoring plan. Compare an audit-first workflow with an answer-monitoring workflow, including approval controls and quotas, rather than headline price alone.
description.zh: GEO Tool 以持续免费的就绪度审计为入口，另提供内容生产型 Autopilot 或 BYOK；Florank 以付费 AI 回答监测为主，同时提供网站审计和文章草稿，没有持续免费监测套餐。应比较审计优先与回答监测优先的工作流、确认控制与配额，而非只看标价。

description.en: Sitemap-based website GEO audits with page-level scores, prioritized fixes and downloadable reports.
description.zh: 基于 Sitemap 的整站 GEO 审计，提供页级分数、优先修复建议和可下载报告。

en: Crawl a sitemap and score each page against 22 metrics across Content Quality, AI Readiness, Technical Basis, and Authority & Trust.
Review page-level weaknesses, a prioritized remediation plan, PDF reports, LLM-ready files and copywriter briefs.
zh: 抓取 Sitemap，并按内容质量、AI 就绪度、技术基础和权威与信任四个支柱下的 22 项指标为每页评分。
查看页级弱项、优先修复计划、PDF 报告、LLM-ready 文件和文案简报。

audience.en: Content and SEO teams that need a repeatable full-site readiness review and page-level editorial priorities.
audience.zh: 需要可重复的整站就绪度检查和页级编辑优先级的内容与 SEO 团队。

description.en: Audit an entire public website from its sitemap to find weak pages across content structure, readability, factual density, citation-ready passages, schema, AI bot access, speed, E-E-A-T, entities and topical authority. Paid website audits cover up to 5,000 pages and include a prioritized fix plan.
description.zh: 从 Sitemap 审计整个公开网站，找出内容结构、可读性、事实密度、可引用段落、Schema、AI 爬虫访问、速度、E-E-A-T、实体和主题权威方面的弱页。付费网站审计最多覆盖 5,000 页，并给出优先修复计划。

summary.en: Sitemap-wide audit, 22 metrics/page and up to 5,000 pages on Website Audit.
summary.zh: Sitemap 整站审计，每页 22 项指标；Website Audit 最多 5,000 页。

description.en: Use the free allowance for a lighter recurring check: five page checks per site every 30 days, the score and top findings, plus URL comparison, robots.txt generation, sitemap analysis, the ROI calculator and learning resources.
description.zh: 用免费额度做较轻量的定期检查：每站点每 30 天五次页面检查、分数和主要发现，并提供 URL 对比、robots.txt 生成、Sitemap 分析、ROI 计算器和学习资源。

summary.en: Free: 5 page checks/site/30 days plus limited comparison and SEO helper tools.
summary.zh: 免费：每站点每 30 天 5 次页面检查，附有限的对比与 SEO 辅助工具。

label.zh: SEOmator GEO Audit 对比依据

description.en: Free includes five page checks per site every 30 days, the score and top findings, plus the listed helper tools. A one-time Full Page Report costs €1.99 per report without an account. A one-time Website Audit costs €4.99 per audit for up to 5,000 pages. Unlimited is €29.99/month for unlimited page analysis and website audits, full reports, downloads and historical dashboard access, with cancellation at any time.
description.zh: 免费版包括每站点每 30 天五次页面检查、分数和主要发现，以及所列辅助工具。Full Page Report 一次性每份 1.99 欧元，无需账户；Website Audit 一次性每次 4.99 欧元，最多 5,000 页。Unlimited 每月 29.99 欧元，提供不限次页面分析和网站审计、完整报告、下载与历史仪表盘，可随时取消。

summary.en: Free 5 checks/site/30 days; one-time €1.99 full-page report; one-time €4.99 audit up to 5,000 pages; €29.99/month Unlimited.
summary.zh: 免费每站点每 30 天 5 次；完整页报告一次性 1.99 欧元；5,000 页审计一次性 4.99 欧元；Unlimited 29.99 欧元/月。

description.en: Public pages conflict on the refund window: the pricing page advertises 30 days, while embedded product copy also contains 14-day and 7-day statements; the terms provide a satisfaction guarantee but leave eligibility and conditions to each plan rather than fixing a window. Billing is monthly prepaid in EUR through Stripe, with possible VAT, automatic renewal and account cancellation that leaves access active through the current billing period.
description.zh: 公开页面的退款期限口径冲突：定价页宣称 30 天，内嵌产品文案同时出现 14 天和 7 天说法；条款提供满意度保障，但将资格与条件留给各套餐，未固定统一期限。计费为通过 Stripe 按月预付欧元，可能加收 VAT、自动续费；可在账户设置取消，当前账期结束前仍可访问。

summary.en: EUR prepaid monthly via Stripe; possible VAT and auto-renewal; refund window conflicts at 30/14/7 days, with terms deferring to each plan.
summary.zh: 欧元通过 Stripe 按月预付；可能加 VAT、自动续费；退款期存在 30／14／7 天冲突，条款称按套餐确定。

description.en: GEOScoreBot must be able to fetch the sitemap and pages; a robots.txt block or security challenge can prevent scoring. The score is a proprietary readiness metric and does not guarantee that an AI engine will cite the site.
description.zh: GEOScoreBot 必须能抓取 Sitemap 和页面；robots.txt 屏蔽或安全验证会导致无法评分。该分数是专有就绪度指标，不保证 AI 引擎会引用网站。

summary.en: Bot access is required; proprietary readiness scores do not guarantee citations.
summary.zh: 需要爬虫访问；专有就绪度评分不保证引用。

description.en: Current pricing and product copy state 22 metrics and a 5,000-page maximum, but older interface text still says 25+ checks and an old FAQ says 200 pages. Use the current direct product/pricing figures and expect inconsistent marketing copy elsewhere.
description.zh: 当前定价和产品正文写 22 项指标、最多 5,000 页，但旧界面文案仍写 25+ 项检查，旧 FAQ 仍写最多 200 页。应以当前直接产品／定价说明为准，并注意其他营销文案可能不一致。

summary.en: Current 22 metrics/5,000 pages conflict with older 25+/200-page copy.
summary.zh: 当前 22 项／5,000 页与旧 25+ 项／200 页文案冲突。

description.en: Lenjo BV currently operates and invoices the service under the GEO-Score trade name within the Be-Found brand family. Some footer and structured-data references still identify Be-Found Online B.V. i.o.; the About page describes that entity as a holding company being incorporated to replace Lenjo BV after registration.
description.zh: 目前由 Lenjo BV 以 GEO-Score 商号在 Be-Found 品牌体系内运营并开票。部分页脚和结构化数据仍指向 Be-Found Online B.V. i.o.；About 页称该公司为正在设立的控股公司，注册后将取代 Lenjo BV。

summary.en: Current operator is Lenjo BV; some site metadata still names the future holding company.
summary.zh: 当前运营方为 Lenjo BV；部分网站元数据仍写未来控股公司。

description.en: The privacy policy says public leaderboards display domain, URL, score and date. Account data is kept until account deletion plus 30 days for backups; analysis results are retained indefinitely; payment records are kept for seven years.
description.zh: 隐私政策称公开榜单会展示域名、URL、分数和日期。账户数据保留至账户删除，另有 30 天备份期；分析结果无限期保留；支付记录保存七年。

summary.en: Public score listings; account data kept until deletion plus 30 backup days, analysis indefinitely, payments 7 years.
summary.zh: 公开分数榜单；账户数据保留至删除后 30 天备份期，分析结果无限期，支付记录 7 年。

description.en: GEO-Score combines a recurring free page-check allowance with paid sitemap-wide audits of up to 5,000 pages. SEOmator GEO Audit is free without registration for up to 50 pages per audit and returns six weighted category scores, crawler/platform checks and a PDF. Compare recurring full-site coverage with a capped free audit rather than treating their free tiers as equivalent.
description.zh: GEO-Score 将定期免费页面检查额度与最多 5,000 页的付费 Sitemap 整站审计结合；SEOmator GEO Audit 免注册免费，每次最多 50 页，返回六类加权分数、爬虫／平台检查和 PDF。应比较持续整站覆盖与有上限的免费审计，不把两者免费档视为等价。

description.en: Technical SEO and AI-readiness audits with engine-specific checks and entity/citation diagnostics.
description.zh: 技术 SEO 与 AI 就绪度审计，提供分引擎检查和实体／引用诊断。

en: Score AI readiness from 0–100 across seven dimensions and 200+ checkpoints, including crawlability, JavaScript rendering, llms.txt, schema, E-E-A-T and entity clarity.
Add paid engine-specific audits and prompt analysis for Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity, alongside competitor and keyword tools.
zh: 按七个维度、200+ 检查点给出 0–100 AI 就绪度分数，覆盖爬取能力、JavaScript 渲染、llms.txt、Schema、E-E-A-T 和实体清晰度。
付费增加 Google AI Overviews、ChatGPT、Claude 与 Perplexity 的分引擎审计和提示词分析，并提供竞品和关键词工具。

audience.en: Technical SEO and growth teams diagnosing whether public pages are accessible, structured and citable by AI systems.
audience.zh: 需要判断公开页面能否被 AI 系统访问、理解并引用的技术 SEO 与增长团队。

description.en: Audit a public WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Framer, Next.js or custom site to identify AI access and rendering problems, weak entity signals, citation-readiness gaps and missing structured data. Login-only, paywalled and noindex content is outside the crawler scope.
description.zh: 审计公开的 WordPress、Shopify、Webflow、Framer、Next.js 或自定义网站，找出 AI 访问和渲染问题、实体信号薄弱、引用就绪度缺口和缺失的结构化数据。仅登录可见、付费墙后和 noindex 内容不在爬取范围内。

summary.en: Public-site audit across 7 readiness dimensions and 200+ checkpoints; private/noindex pages excluded.
summary.zh: 公开网站按 7 个维度、200+ 检查点审计；不抓私有或 noindex 页面。

description.en: After fixing technical blockers, use paid engine-specific audits, competitor audits and prompt-oriented tools to investigate how Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity may read and cite the site. Engine checks have explicit monthly caps rather than unlimited use.
description.zh: 修复技术阻断后，用付费分引擎审计、竞品审计和提示词工具，调查 Google AI Overviews、ChatGPT、Claude 与 Perplexity 如何读取和引用网站。分引擎检查有明确的每月上限，并非无限使用。

summary.en: Paid engine and competitor checks supplement the readiness audit, with monthly caps.
summary.zh: 付费分引擎与竞品检查补充就绪度审计，有每月上限。

description.en: Free is ₹0 with one registered site and one audit each time the user logs in. It unlocks Machine Readability, Entities & Identity, five On-Page SEO features and four Technical SEO features; other results remain locked.
description.zh: Free 为 0 印度卢比，可注册一个站点，每次登录运行一次审计。开放 Machine Readability、Entities & Identity、五项 On-Page SEO 和四项 Technical SEO 功能；其他结果仍锁定。

summary.en: Free ₹0: 1 registered site and 1 audit/login, with limited SEO/readiness results.
summary.zh: 免费 0 印度卢比：1 个注册站点、每次登录 1 次审计，部分结果开放。

description.en: Standard is ₹999/month with two active and four registered sites, unlimited audits of the connected site and ten competitor audits per month; it adds Google AI Overview, Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, competitor comparison, AI Crawler Audit and AI Search Readiness. The pricing page does not state a separate monthly AI Overview quota for Standard. Pro is ₹2,999/month with three active and six registered sites, twenty competitor audits and seven monthly checks each for ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, plus the listed AI/AEO and content tools. Premium is ₹5,999/month with five active and ten registered sites, thirty competitor audits, fifteen monthly checks each for ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity, brand intelligence, GEO visibility, citation tracking and white-label PDF.
description.zh: Standard 每月 999 印度卢比，含 2 个活跃、4 个注册站点，本站审计不限次、每月 10 次竞品审计；增加 Google AI Overview、技术 SEO、页面 SEO、竞品比较、AI 爬虫审计和 AI 搜索就绪度。定价页未单独公布 Standard 的 AI Overview 月度次数。Pro 每月 2,999 印度卢比，含 3 个活跃、6 个注册站点、20 次竞品审计，ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity 与 Google AI Overviews 各每月 7 次检查，并含所列 AI／AEO 与内容工具。Premium 每月 5,999 印度卢比，含 5 个活跃、10 个注册站点、30 次竞品审计，ChatGPT、Claude 与 Perplexity 各每月 15 次检查，以及品牌情报、GEO 曝光、引用追踪和白标 PDF。

summary.en: Standard ₹999/mo: 2 active/4 registered sites, 10 competitor audits/mo, AI Overview quota not stated; Pro ₹2,999/mo: 3 active/6 registered sites, 20 competitor audits, 7 checks/engine across 4 engines; Premium ₹5,999/mo: 5 active/10 registered sites, 30 competitor audits, 15 checks/engine across ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity.
summary.zh: Standard ₹999/月：2 活跃／4 注册站点、每月 10 次竞品审计，AI Overview 次数未公布；Pro ₹2,999/月：3 活跃／6 注册站点、20 次竞品审计，4 个引擎各 7 次；Premium ₹5,999/月：5 活跃／10 注册站点、30 次竞品审计，ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity 各 15 次。

description.en: Paid plans renew automatically each month and can be canceled. The terms allow a full refund within seven days of a first purchase if free-tier usage has not been exceeded; later cancellations are prorated for the unused period minus payment-processing fees.
description.zh: 付费套餐每月自动续费，可取消。条款允许首次购买后 7 天内、且未超过免费档用量时全额退款；后续取消按未使用周期比例退款，并扣除支付手续费。

summary.en: Automatic monthly renewal; conditional 7-day first-purchase refund, then prorated refunds minus fees.
summary.zh: 每月自动续费；首次购买 7 天有条件全额退款，之后按未用周期扣手续费退款。

description.en: Free users receive only limited result categories. Standard lists up to three Google AI Overview Auditor runs per month, while Pro lists up to seven ChatGPT Optimization runs per month; Premium raises ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity checks to fifteen each. These caps should be reviewed separately from site and competitor audit allowances.
description.zh: 免费用户只获得有限的结果类别。Standard 的 Google AI Overview Auditor 每月最多 3 次，Pro 的 ChatGPT Optimization 每月最多 7 次；Premium 将 ChatGPT、Claude 与 Perplexity 检查提高至各 15 次。这些上限应与站点和竞品审计额度分开评估。

summary.en: AI Overview and ChatGPT checks have tier-specific monthly caps separate from audit quotas.
summary.zh: AI Overview 与 ChatGPT 检查有分档月度上限，与审计配额分开。

description.en: The pricing page describes ten Technical SEO subareas while the features page says twelve. GA4 AI Traffic Attribution is marked COMING SOON on the features page even though a pricing table has listed it under Standard, so it should not be treated as a live capability.
description.zh: 定价页写技术 SEO 十个子领域，功能页写十二个。GA4 AI Traffic Attribution 在功能页标为 COMING SOON，尽管定价表曾将其列入 Standard，因此不应视为已上线能力。

summary.en: 10-vs-12 Technical SEO copy conflict; GA4 AI Traffic Attribution is still coming soon.
summary.zh: 技术 SEO 10 与 12 项文案冲突；GA4 AI 流量归因仍未上线。

description.en: The privacy policy says Meta advertising measurement is enabled unless marketing cookies are rejected; after subscription, payment amount and a SHA-256 email hash are reported to Meta. Audit data is kept until 90 days after subscription end, with imported Google Search Console/Analytics API data deleted within 30 days of disconnection or account deletion and backups cleared within 90 days. Data may be transferred to India, the US and the EU.
description.zh: 隐私政策称，除非拒绝营销 Cookie，否则启用 Meta 广告衡量；订阅后会向 Meta 报告支付金额和邮箱的 SHA-256 哈希。审计数据保留至订阅结束后 90 天，断开连接或删除账户后 30 天内删除导入的 Google Search Console／Analytics API 数据，备份 90 天内清除。数据可能跨境至印度、美国和欧盟。

summary.en: Meta measurement defaults on unless rejected; cross-border processing and tiered deletion windows apply.
summary.zh: 除非拒绝否则默认启用 Meta 衡量；有跨境处理和分阶段删除期限。

description.en: The score is a proprietary diagnostic rather than a ranking or citation guarantee. AI features depend on third-party model providers, and the terms explicitly disclaim guaranteed rankings, citations, traffic or revenue.
description.zh: 该分数是专有诊断指标，不是排名或引用保证。AI 功能依赖第三方模型供应商；条款明确不保证排名、引用、流量或收入。

summary.en: Proprietary score and third-party AI providers; no ranking, citation or traffic guarantee.
summary.zh: 专有分数并依赖第三方 AI；不保证排名、引用或流量。

description.en: IndexGraph is audit-first: its free tier emphasizes technical and entity readiness, and Standard costs ₹999/month. Geoptie Starter is $49/month with 15 monitoring prompts, two brands, daily tracking and four selectable engines, plus unlimited audit reports and content generations. Compare a technical diagnostic entry point with ongoing prompt/brand monitoring, keeping INR and USD prices separate.
description.zh: IndexGraph 以审计为入口：免费档侧重技术和实体就绪度，Standard 每月 999 印度卢比。Geoptie Starter 每月 49 美元，含 15 个监测提示词、2 个品牌、每日追踪和 4 个可选引擎，并提供不限次审计报告与内容生成。应比较技术诊断入口与持续提示词／品牌监测，不换算印度卢比与美元。

description.en: Free single-page AI visibility audit for rendered content, crawler access and citability signals.
description.zh: 免费单页 AI 曝光审计，检查渲染内容、爬虫访问和可引用性信号。

en: Inspect rendered HTML, clean markdown and links, plus robots.txt and llms.txt, without login, an account or an API key.
Score AI crawler access, structured data, content citability, expertise/trust, entity clarity and llms.txt, with prioritized fixes.
zh: 无需登录、账户或 API Key，即可检查渲染 HTML、清洁 Markdown、链接以及 robots.txt 和 llms.txt。
评估 AI 爬虫访问、结构化数据、内容可引用性、专业／信任、实体清晰度和 llms.txt，并给出优先修复项。

audience.en: Developers and SEO teams checking whether one public page exposes the content and technical signals AI systems rely on.
audience.zh: 希望检查单个公开页面是否暴露 AI 系统依赖的内容与技术信号的开发者和 SEO 团队。

description.en: Run a free, no-account audit of one public URL to inspect what Firecrawl can render and extract, whether robots and llms instructions allow access, and which structured-data, entity and content changes would make the page easier to cite.
description.zh: 对一个公开 URL 运行免费免账户审计，查看 Firecrawl 能渲染和提取什么、robots 与 llms 指令是否允许访问，以及哪些结构化数据、实体和内容调整有助于页面被引用。

summary.en: Free no-account single-page audit of rendered content, robots/llms and citability signals.
summary.zh: 免费免账户单页审计，检查渲染内容、robots／llms 和可引用性信号。

description.en: For full-site work, move from the standalone audit UI to Firecrawl's API and use crawl, scrape or map operations to collect multiple public pages. API usage consumes credits and is billed separately from the standalone UI's limited daily checks.
description.zh: 需要整站处理时，可从独立审计界面转到 Firecrawl API，用 crawl、scrape 或 map 采集多个公开页面。API 用量消耗 credits，与独立界面有限的每日检查分开计费。

summary.en: Full-site collection uses the credit-based Firecrawl API; UI checks are limited daily.
summary.zh: 整站采集使用按 credits 计费的 Firecrawl API；界面检查每日限量。

label.en: Firecrawl AI Visibility Audit product page
label.zh: Firecrawl AI Visibility Audit 产品页
SEOmator GEO Audit 对比依据

description.en: The standalone audit is free without an account, but the official page only says a limited number of checks are available each day and does not publish the count. Separately, the Firecrawl API Free plan provides 1,000 credits per month, no credit card and two concurrent requests; API credits are not the same thing as the UI's undisclosed daily audit allowance.
description.zh: 独立审计免费且无需账户，但官方页面只说明每天可检查有限次数，未公布具体数量。另外，Firecrawl API Free 每月提供 1,000 credits，无需信用卡，支持 2 个并发请求；API credits 与界面未公开的每日审计额度不是同一概念。

summary.en: Free UI has an undisclosed daily check limit; API Free is 1,000 credits/month with 2 concurrent requests.
summary.zh: 免费界面每日次数未公开；API Free 每月 1,000 credits、2 并发。

description.en: Hobby costs $19/month or $16/month billed annually ($190/year) for 5,000 monthly credits and five concurrent requests. Standard costs $99/month or $83/month annually ($990/year) for 100,000 credits and 25 concurrent requests. Growth costs $399/month or $333/month annually ($3,990/year) for 500,000 credits and 50 concurrent requests. Scale costs $749/month or $599/month annually ($7,190/year) for 1,000,000 credits and 100 concurrent requests. Enterprise pricing is custom.
description.zh: Hobby 每月 19 美元，或年付折合 16 美元/月（190 美元/年），含每月 5,000 credits、5 并发。Standard 每月 99 美元，或年付折合 83 美元/月（990 美元/年），含 100,000 credits、25 并发。Growth 每月 399 美元，或年付折合 333 美元/月（3,990 美元/年），含 500,000 credits、50 并发。Scale 每月 749 美元，或年付折合 599 美元/月（7,190 美元/年），含 1,000,000 credits、100 并发。Enterprise 单独报价。

summary.en: Hobby $19/mo or $16/mo billed annually ($190/yr), 5,000 credits/mo, 5 concurrent; Standard $99/mo or $83/mo billed annually ($990/yr), 100,000 credits/mo, 25 concurrent; Growth $399/mo or $333/mo billed annually ($3,990/yr), 500,000 credits/mo, 50 concurrent; Scale $749/mo or $599/mo billed annually ($7,190/yr), 1,000,000 credits/mo, 100 concurrent; Enterprise custom.
summary.zh: Hobby 月付 19 美元或年付折合 16 美元/月（190 美元/年），5,000 credits/月、5 并发；Standard 月付 99 美元或年付折合 83 美元/月（990 美元/年），100,000 credits/月、25 并发；Growth 月付 399 美元或年付折合 333 美元/月（3,990 美元/年），500,000 credits/月、50 并发；Scale 月付 749 美元或年付折合 599 美元/月（7,190 美元/年），1,000,000 credits/月、100 并发；Enterprise 定制。

description.en: Base API costs are one credit per scraped or crawled page, one per map call, two per ten search results, two per browser minute for Interact and one per page per Monitor check. JSON format adds four credits per page. Paid plans can add credits in $5 increments: 1,000 on Hobby, 2,000 on Standard, 2,500 on Growth and 5,000 on Scale. Scale carries unused plan credits for one month; Enterprise rollover is custom. Purchased credits expire when the subscription is canceled.
description.zh: API 基础成本为 scrape／crawl 每页 1 credit、map 每次 1 credit、search 每 10 条 2 credits、Interact 每浏览器分钟 2 credits、Monitor 每页每次检查 1 credit。JSON 格式每页额外 4 credits。付费档可按 5 美元加购：Hobby 1,000、Standard 2,000、Growth 2,500、Scale 5,000 credits。Scale 的未用套餐 credits 结转一个月，Enterprise 结转规则定制；购买的 credits 在取消订阅时过期。

summary.en: Scrape/crawl 1 credit/page; JSON +4; $5 adds 1,000/2,000/2,500/5,000 credits on Hobby/Standard/Growth/Scale; Scale rolls unused credits one month, Enterprise custom.
summary.zh: scrape／crawl 每页 1 credit；JSON 加 4；5 美元在 Hobby／Standard／Growth／Scale 分别加购 1,000／2,000／2,500／5,000 credits；Scale 结转一个月，Enterprise 定制。

description.en: The standalone UI audits one page and does not query ChatGPT or Perplexity directly. It analyzes the page content and technical signals those systems depend on; it is not ongoing brand-mention, prompt or competitor monitoring.
description.zh: 独立界面只审计一个页面，不直接查询 ChatGPT 或 Perplexity。它分析这些系统依赖的页面内容和技术信号，不是持续的品牌提及、提示词或竞品监测。

summary.en: Single-page technical/content audit only; no direct AI-answer or brand-mention queries.
summary.zh: 仅单页技术／内容审计；不直接查询 AI 回答或品牌提及。

description.en: The terms state that SideGuide Technologies Inc. d/b/a Firecrawl is a Delaware company, payments are handled by Stripe, fees are non-refundable and cancellation stops future charges at the end of the current period. Users grant a broad, continuing license to submitted content and feedback.
description.zh: 条款载明运营方 SideGuide Technologies Inc. d/b/a Firecrawl 为特拉华州公司，Stripe 处理付款，费用不可退款；取消后当前账期结束停止后续扣费。用户对提交内容和反馈授予广泛、持续的授权。

summary.en: Non-refundable billing and a broad continuing license to submitted content/feedback.
summary.zh: 不可退款计费；对提交内容／反馈授予广泛持续授权。

description.en: The privacy policy is dated 2024-12-26 and describes US storage and processing, use of data for marketing/advertising, and retention until a written deletion request without a fixed deletion period. Review the current vendor terms before submitting sensitive page data.
description.zh: 隐私政策日期为 2024-12-26，说明数据在美国存储和处理、用于营销／广告，并在书面删除请求前保留，没有固定删除期限。提交敏感页面数据前应复核厂商当前条款。

summary.en: Older 2024 privacy policy; US processing, marketing use and no fixed deletion period.
summary.zh: 隐私政策为 2024 年旧版；美国处理、营销用途、无固定删除期限。

description.en: Firecrawl's free UI is a single-page audit of rendered HTML, markdown, links, robots.txt and llms.txt and does not query AI answers. SEOmator GEO Audit is free without registration for up to 50 pages, with six weighted categories, fourteen AI crawler checks, platform readiness, JSON-LD and a PDF. Firecrawl uses rendered-page extraction; SEOmator states that it reads raw HTML without executing JavaScript.
description.zh: Firecrawl 免费界面是单页审计，检查渲染 HTML、Markdown、链接、robots.txt 和 llms.txt，不查询 AI 回答。SEOmator GEO Audit 免注册免费，每次最多 50 页，含六类加权评分、14 个 AI 爬虫检查、平台就绪度、JSON-LD 和 PDF。Firecrawl 提取渲染后的页面；SEOmator 明确读取不执行 JavaScript 的原始 HTML。

description.en: AI citation monitoring that links prompts to cited domains and URLs, with AI referral analytics.
description.zh: 将提示词与被引域名、URL 关联的 AI 引用监测，并提供 AI 引荐流量分析。

en: Map each monitored prompt to cited domains and URLs, inspect citation gaps and filter evidence by topic, prompt, platform, region and language.
Connect AI referral tracking, GA4 and Search Console to analyze landing pages and cited-but-not-clicked pages; higher tiers add crawler visibility.
zh: 将每个监测提示词关联到被引域名和 URL，分析引用缺口，并按主题、提示词、平台、地区与语言筛选证据。
连接 AI 引荐追踪、GA4 与 Search Console，分析落地页和已引用未点击页面；更高档增加爬虫可见性。

audience.en: Content and growth teams that need prompt-level citation evidence and a view of the visits those citations generate.
audience.zh: 需要提示词级引用证据，并了解引用带来多少访问的内容与增长团队。

description.en: Track a brand, competitors and third-party sources for a fixed prompt set, then identify prompts where the brand is not cited or where only competitors are cited. Results can be filtered and exported by topic, prompt, platform, region and language.
description.zh: 为固定提示词集追踪自有品牌、竞品和第三方来源，找出品牌未被引用或仅由竞品引用的提示词。结果可按主题、提示词、平台、地区和语言筛选并导出。

summary.en: Prompt-to-domain/URL citation mapping with gap analysis, filters and export.
summary.zh: 提示词到域名／URL 的引用映射，支持缺口分析、筛选和导出。
