summary.zh: 权重为自有启发式；分引擎评分用于比较方面，不能预测引用。

description.en: Live Probe generates three queries and sends them to one OpenAI model with web search. It does not test the ChatGPT consumer product or the other engines, and answers can change between runs; answer-capsule length is also a writing heuristic rather than an engine requirement.
description.zh: Live Probe 生成三个查询，并发送给一个带网页搜索的 OpenAI 模型。它不测试 ChatGPT 消费端产品或其他引擎，回答可能在不同运行间变化；Answer Capsule 的长度也只是写作启发式，不是引擎要求。

summary.en: Live Probe tests one OpenAI model with three changing queries, not ChatGPT or every engine; capsule length is heuristic.
summary.zh: Live Probe 用三个会变化的查询测试一个 OpenAI 模型，不覆盖 ChatGPT 或所有引擎；胶囊长度为启发式。

description.en: Lumina is operated by Julien El-Bahy as a private individual in Austria, is not a registered business and states that it has no commercial intent. The public footer provides an imprint and privacy policy, but no dedicated Terms of Service page was found.
description.zh: Lumina 由奥地利个人 Julien El-Bahy 运营，不是注册企业，并声明无商业意图。公开页脚提供 imprint 和隐私政策，但未找到独立服务条款页面。

summary.en: A private individual operates the free tool; a substantive imprint and privacy policy exist, but no dedicated Terms page was found.
summary.zh: 该免费工具由个人运营；有实质性 imprint 和隐私政策，但未找到独立条款页。

description.en: The extension's on-page checks run locally, while cloud AI requests are forwarded to OpenAI and data requests to DataForSEO. API keys stay in the browser or pass through the proxy; IP-based credit counters delete after 24 or 48 hours, cached DataForSEO answers remain for 24 hours to 7 days, and daily cost records without IP addresses are kept for 40 days.
description.zh: 扩展的页面检查在本地运行，云端 AI 请求转发给 OpenAI，数据请求转发给 DataForSEO。API key 保存在浏览器或仅通过代理传递；基于 IP 的额度计数在 24 或 48 小时后删除，缓存的 DataForSEO 回答保留 24 小时至 7 天，不含 IP 的每日成本记录保留 40 天。

summary.en: Cloud calls reach OpenAI/DataForSEO; keys stay browser-side or pass through, IP counters delete in 24–48 hours and cost records in 40 days.
summary.zh: 云端调用会发送给 OpenAI／DataForSEO；key 保存在浏览器或仅传递，IP 计数 24–48 小时删除，成本记录 40 天删除。

description.en: Lumina GEO Readiness is free with no signup and runs its core 66-check audit and 50-URL batches without limits; its three AI features share 10 free calls per day, or become unlimited with a user-supplied OpenAI key. Radar by Pixelmojo charges $5/$12/$40 for 1/3/10 full audits and $199/month for 40 audits plus weekly monitoring of up to 12 approved questions, but combines technical checks with paid live AI-response tests. Choose Lumina for repeated free diagnostics and self-managed AI costs; choose Radar for a packaged live-answer audit and scheduled monitoring.
description.zh: Lumina GEO Readiness 免费且无需注册，核心 66 项检查和 50 URL 批量审计不限次数；三项 AI 功能共用每天 10 次免费额度，用户提供 OpenAI key 后可不限次数。Radar by Pixelmojo 的 1／3／10 次完整审计分别收费 5／12／40 美元，每月 199 美元含 40 次审计及最多 12 个已批准问题的每周监测，并将技术检查与付费实时 AI 回答测试结合。需要反复免费诊断并自行管理 AI 成本时选 Lumina；需要打包的实时回答审计和定期监测时选 Radar。

description.en: An AI search workspace that combines answer-engine visibility tracking with prompt generation, content briefs and drafts, citation-readiness scoring, review workflows and CMS publishing.
description.zh: 将答案引擎可见度追踪、提示词生成、内容简报与草稿、引用就绪度评分、审核流程和 CMS 发布集中在同一工作区的 AI 搜索平台。

en: Track visibility, mentions, position, share of voice, sentiment, citations and cited source domains by AI model, country, language and prompt.
Compare competitors with leaderboards and head-to-head views, and schedule tracked prompts daily, weekly or monthly.
Generate content briefs and drafts from weak prompts or content gaps, score citation readiness, and review or approve output before publishing.
Import existing articles and publish through integrations such as WordPress; every plan also includes a website builder.
Export through reporting, API and MCP starting on Starter; higher plans add more workspaces, API keys, MCP servers and log capacity.
Plan and track outreach and include social posts and backlinks; guest posts start on Starter.
zh: 按 AI 模型、国家、语言和提示词追踪可见度、提及、位置、声量份额、情绪、引用与被引来源域名。
通过排行榜和正面对比比较竞品，并可按每天、每周或每月安排提示词追踪。
根据表现薄弱的提示词或内容缺口生成内容简报与草稿，评估引用就绪度，并在发布前审核或批准输出。
导入已有文章并通过 WordPress 等集成发布；所有套餐均含网站构建器。
从 Starter 起提供报表、API 和 MCP 导出；更高套餐增加工作区、API key、MCP 服务器和日志容量。
规划并追踪外联，套餐含社交帖文和反向链接；访客文章从 Starter 起提供。

audience.en: GEO, SEO, content and growth teams that need answer monitoring and content execution in one workspace.
audience.zh: 需要在同一工作区完成回答监测与内容执行的 GEO、SEO、内容和增长团队。

description.en: Build a recurring benchmark for brand visibility, cited sources and competitor share of voice across selected answer engines and markets.
description.zh: 针对选定答案引擎和市场，建立品牌可见度、引用来源与竞品声量份额的定期基准。

summary.en: Benchmark brand visibility, citations and competitor share by engine and market.
summary.zh: 按引擎和市场比较品牌可见度、引用与竞品声量。

description.en: Turn prompts where the brand is weak or absent into briefs, drafts and optimization tasks, then review and publish approved content.
description.zh: 将品牌表现薄弱或缺失的提示词转化为简报、草稿和优化任务，审核后发布获批内容。

summary.en: Convert answer and content gaps into reviewed briefs, drafts and published pages.
summary.zh: 把回答与内容缺口转化为经审核的简报、草稿和发布页面。

description.en: Feed measured answer performance into reporting, API or MCP workflows for agencies and multi-workspace teams.
description.zh: 将测得的回答表现接入报表、API 或 MCP 工作流，服务代理商和多工作区团队。

summary.en: Use reporting, API and MCP for agency and multi-workspace workflows.
summary.zh: 用报表、API 和 MCP 支持代理商与多工作区流程。

description.en: Monthly self-serve plans are Lite at €49, Starter at €139 and Growth at €449. Lite includes 40 prompts, 6,000 responses per month, 5 content creations, 5 optimizations, 10 agent pages and 1 workspace, with Google AI Mode and Google AI Overviews. Starter includes 180 prompts, 24,000 responses, 10 creations, 10 optimizations, 20 agent pages, 20 product improvements and 2 workspaces, adding ChatGPT and Gemini. Growth includes 450 prompts, 48,000 responses, 40 creations, 40 optimizations, 100 agent pages, 200 product improvements, 400 outreach actions and 6 workspaces, adding Perplexity and Bing AI Mode. All three have unlimited users.
description.zh: 月付自助套餐为 Lite €49、Starter €139、Growth €449。Lite 含 40 个提示词、每月 6,000 次响应、5 次内容创作、5 次优化、10 个代理页面和 1 个工作区，覆盖 Google AI Mode 与 Google AI Overviews。Starter 含 180 个提示词、24,000 次响应、10 次创作、10 次优化、20 个代理页面、20 项产品改进和 2 个工作区，并增加 ChatGPT 与 Gemini。Growth 含 450 个提示词、48,000 次响应、40 次创作、40 次优化、100 个代理页面、200 项产品改进、400 次外联操作和 6 个工作区，并增加 Perplexity 与 Bing AI Mode。三档均不限用户数。

summary.en: Lite €49/mo: 40 prompts/6,000 responses; Starter €139: 180/24,000; Growth €449: 450/48,000. Content, agent-page and workspace quotas rise by tier.
summary.zh: Lite €49/月含 40 提示词/6,000 响应；Starter €139 含 180/24,000；Growth €449 含 450/48,000；内容、代理页面与工作区额度逐档增加。

description.en: Yearly billing is €399 for Lite, €1,199 for Starter and €3,999 for Growth, billed upfront for 12 months. The page displays monthly equivalents of €33, €100 and €333 respectively. Prices exclude VAT and other applicable taxes, renew automatically, and cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. Fees are generally non-refundable, subject to specific contractual exceptions.
description.zh: Lite、Starter、Growth 的年付账单分别为 €399、€1,199、€3,999，一次性预付 12 个月；页面显示的月均折算价分别为 €33、€100、€333。价格不含增值税及其他适用税费，自动续费，取消在当前账期结束时生效。费用原则上不退，特定合同例外除外。

summary.en: Yearly upfront: €399 Lite, €1,199 Starter, €3,999 Growth (displayed €33/€100/€333 per month); VAT excluded, auto-renewing and generally non-refundable.

description.en: Lite and Starter offer seven-day trials that require a payment card and convert to paid unless canceled. Growth and Enterprise have no trial. Unused allowances do not roll over. Enterprise promises unlimited prompts, responses, workspaces, agent pages, content and product improvements subject to fair use; overages may be restricted, upgraded or charged at platform rates.
description.zh: Lite 与 Starter 提供七天试用，需要支付卡，未取消则转为付费。Growth 与 Enterprise 无试用。未使用额度不结转。Enterprise 在合理使用前提下承诺不限提示词、响应、工作区、代理页面、内容和产品改进；超限可能被限制、要求升级或按平台费率收费。

summary.en: Seven-day card-required trials on Lite/Starter auto-convert; Growth/Enterprise have none. No rollover; Enterprise unlimited is fair-use limited.
summary.zh: Lite／Starter 七天试用需支付卡并自动转付费；Growth／Enterprise 无试用；额度不结转，Enterprise 不限量受合理使用限制。

description.en: Enterprise is custom-priced and adds Grok, Claude, Mistral and DeepSeek, SSO, a Brand Agent with its own MCP server, unlimited API and MCP access, and dedicated support. Starter includes 5 API keys, 1 MCP server and a 25,000,000 log count; Growth raises these to 20 keys, 10 MCP servers and 100,000,000. Reporting and API/MCP export start at Starter, while every plan includes social posts and backlinks and guest posts start at Starter.
description.zh: Enterprise 定制定价，增加 Grok、Claude、Mistral、DeepSeek、SSO、带独立 MCP 服务器的 Brand Agent、不限 API 与 MCP 访问及专属支持。Starter 含 5 个 API key、1 个 MCP 服务器和 25,000,000 日志计数；Growth 提升至 20 个 key、10 个 MCP 服务器和 100,000,000。报表及 API／MCP 导出从 Starter 起提供；所有套餐含社交帖文与反向链接，访客文章从 Starter 起提供。

summary.en: Enterprise custom adds four engines, SSO and unlimited API/MCP; API/MCP and reporting start at Starter, with 5 keys/1 server versus Growth's 20/10.
summary.zh: Enterprise 定制，增加四个引擎、SSO 与不限 API／MCP；API／MCP 和报表从 Starter 起，5 key/1 服务器对比 Growth 的 20/10。

description.en: One response is one tracked prompt run on one AI model, so multi-model schedules consume the allowance faster than the prompt count alone suggests. Tracking can be daily, weekly or monthly on every plan, but Meta AI is not tracked. Engine coverage expands by tier and Enterprise.
description.zh: 一次响应等于一个受追踪提示词在一个 AI 模型上的一次运行，因此多模型安排的额度消耗快于仅看提示词数量。所有套餐均可每天、每周或每月追踪，但不追踪 Meta AI。引擎覆盖随套餐与 Enterprise 扩展。

summary.en: Responses count prompt runs per model; multi-model schedules use quota faster. Meta AI is not tracked and engines vary by plan.
summary.zh: 响应按提示词逐模型运行计次；多模型更快耗额度；不追踪 Meta AI，引擎随套餐变化。

description.en: Measurements are snapshots of Opttab's own tracked prompts, not observations of real users' private ChatGPT conversations. Personalized answers can differ, and users should not place personal or confidential data in tracked prompts. No ranking, mention, citation, traffic, conversion, sales or revenue outcome is guaranteed.
description.zh: 测量是 Opttab 自行追踪提示词所得的快照，不是对真实用户私密 ChatGPT 对话的观察。个性化回答可能不同，用户不应在受追踪提示词中放入个人或机密数据。不保证排名、提及、引用、流量、转化、销售或收入结果。

summary.en: Tracked-prompt snapshots are not private user conversations or personalized results; avoid sensitive prompts and expect no outcome guarantee.
summary.zh: 追踪提示词快照不等于私密用户对话或个性化结果；避免敏感提示词，且不保证业务结果。

description.en: AI-generated output requires human review. As between Opttab and the customer, the customer owns generated output as far as law permits, but copyright protection is not guaranteed and similar output may be generated for others. The service is for business use only and users must be at least 18.
description.zh: AI 生成内容需要人工审核。在 Opttab 与客户之间，客户在法律允许范围内拥有生成输出，但不保证版权保护，也可能为其他人生成相似输出。服务仅供商业使用，用户须年满 18 岁。

summary.en: Human review is required; output ownership is not a copyright guarantee and similar output may exist. Business users must be 18+.
summary.zh: 需人工审核；输出所有权不等于版权保证，也可能存在相似输出；商业用户须年满 18 岁。

description.en: The operator is Opttab B.V., a Netherlands private limited company at Keizersgracht 520H, 1017 EK Amsterdam, KvK 42094716, VAT NL869689575B01; its managing director is Arda Ulusoy. Dutch law and Amsterdam courts apply. Privacy identifies OpenAI, Anthropic and Google as AI providers under terms that do not permit training on API-submitted data, and Opttab says it does not use customer data to train models.
description.zh: 运营方为荷兰私人有限公司 Opttab B.V.，地址 Keizersgracht 520H, 1017 EK Amsterdam，KvK 42094716，税号 NL869689575B01，董事为 Arda Ulusoy；适用荷兰法律与阿姆斯特丹法院。隐私政策列明 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 为 AI 提供商，其条款不允许用 API 提交数据训练；Opttab 表示不使用客户数据训练模型。

summary.en: Operated by Opttab B.V. in Amsterdam under Dutch law; named AI providers' API terms and Opttab's policy bar training on customer data.
summary.zh: 由阿姆斯特丹 Opttab B.V. 依荷兰法运营；所列 AI 提供商的 API 条款与 Opttab 政策禁止用客户数据训练。

description.en: Customer data is stored in the EU on AWS Ireland, with some providers outside the EEA under adequacy or standard contractual clause safeguards. Data can be exported during the subscription and for 30 days after it ends, then deleted subject to legal requirements.
description.zh: 客户数据存储在欧盟的 AWS Ireland；部分提供商位于欧洲经济区外，适用充分性认定或标准合同条款保障。订阅期间及结束后 30 天内可导出数据，之后按法律要求删除。

summary.en: EU storage on AWS Ireland with safeguarded non-EEA processing; export is available through 30 days after subscription end.
summary.zh: 数据存于 AWS Ireland 欧盟节点，非欧洲经济区处理有保障；订阅结束后 30 天内仍可导出。

description.en: Choose Opttab when answer analytics and content production must share one workflow and you need a lower entry plan for prompt tracking. DeepSmith also combines tracking and content, but its $99/month Pro plan includes 20 articles and CSV/API export; Opttab starts API/MCP and reporting at Starter and counts each prompt run separately for every model.
description.zh: 需要把回答分析与内容生产放在同一流程，并希望以较低门槛开始提示词追踪时选 Opttab。DeepSmith 同样结合追踪与内容，但其每月 99 美元的 Pro 含 20 篇文章及 CSV／API 导出；Opttab 从 Starter 起提供 API／MCP 和报表，并逐模型计入每次提示词运行。

label.zh: Opttab GEO 与 AEO 平台

description.en: A paid SEO research platform whose AI Visibility workspace tracks prompts and shows the domains, pages, linking sources and authority metrics cited in AI answers.
description.zh: 付费 SEO 研究平台，其 AI Visibility 工作区追踪提示词，并展示 AI 回答引用的域名、页面、链接来源与权威度指标。

en: Track prompts weekly on GPT, Gemini and Google AI Mode, with 150, 300 or 600 prompts on Standard, Medium or Large.
Inspect total citations, unique cited pages and domains, and how often the tracked domain is cited.
View Domain Authority and Spam Score distributions, linking domains and linking pages beside citation data.
Filter cited pages into all cited pages, pages where only the brand is mentioned, and pages where the brand is not mentioned.
Open prompt and response associations and export citation tables for further analysis.
Use 3, 6 or 12 AI Visibility dashboards and 2, 10 or 50 AI Content Briefs per month on the three AI-enabled plans.
zh: 在 GPT、Gemini 与 Google AI Mode 上每周追踪提示词，Standard、Medium、Large 分别含 150、300、600 个。
查看引用总数、唯一被引页面与域名，以及被追踪域名被引用的次数。
在引用数据旁查看 Domain Authority、Spam Score 分布、链接域名和链接页面。
将被引页面筛选为全部被引页面、仅提及品牌的页面和未提及品牌的页面。
打开提示词与回答的关联，并导出引用表进行进一步分析。
三个启用 AI 的套餐分别提供 3、6、12 个 AI Visibility 看板，以及每月 2、10、50 份 AI Content Brief。

audience.en: SEO and digital marketing teams that need AI citation evidence connected to a broader search research workflow.
audience.zh: 需要把 AI 引用证据接入更广泛搜索研究流程的 SEO 与数字营销团队。

description.en: Identify which domains and pages AI answers cite for tracked prompts, then filter for pages that mention the brand and pages that do not.
description.zh: 识别 AI 回答针对受追踪提示词引用的域名和页面，并筛选提及品牌与未提及品牌的页面。

summary.en: Find cited domains and pages, split by whether they mention the brand.
summary.zh: 查找被引域名和页面，并按是否提及品牌分类。

description.en: Assess citation sources with Domain Authority, Spam Score and linking-domain or linking-page context instead of treating every citation as equally authoritative.
description.zh: 结合 Domain Authority、Spam Score 及链接域名或页面背景评估引用来源，而非把所有引用视为同等权威。

summary.en: Evaluate citation sources with authority, spam and linking context.
summary.zh: 结合权威度、垃圾分数和链接背景评估引用来源。

description.en: Use tracked prompt results and AI Content Briefs to prioritize search-content research while keeping citation evidence in the same Moz Pro workspace.
description.zh: 利用受追踪提示词结果和 AI Content Brief 确定搜索内容研究优先级，同时在同一 Moz Pro 工作区保留引用证据。

summary.en: Prioritize content research with prompt results and AI Content Briefs beside citation evidence.
summary.zh: 根据提示词结果与 AI Content Brief 安排内容研究，并同时查看引用证据。

description.en: Standard is $99 USD/month or $950 billed for the first year, displayed as $79/month, and includes 150 tracked prompts, 3 AI Visibility dashboards, weekly GPT/Gemini/Google AI Mode tracking, 2 AI Content Briefs per month, 1 user and 3 tracked sites. Medium is $179/month or $1,719 for the first year, displayed as $143/month, with 300 prompts, 6 dashboards, 10 briefs, 2 users and 10 sites. Large is $299/month or $2,868 for the first year, displayed as $239/month, with 600 prompts, 12 dashboards, 50 briefs, 3 users and 25 sites. The annual amounts are labeled first-year bills, not permanent annual prices.
description.zh: Standard 为每月 99 美元或首年账单 950 美元，页面显示折合 79 美元/月，含 150 个受追踪提示词、3 个 AI Visibility 看板、每周 GPT／Gemini／Google AI Mode 追踪、每月 2 份 AI Content Brief、1 名用户和 3 个追踪站点。Medium 为每月 179 美元或首年 1,719 美元，显示折合 143 美元/月，含 300 个提示词、6 个看板、10 份简报、2 名用户和 10 个站点。Large 为每月 299 美元或首年 2,868 美元，显示折合 239 美元/月，含 600 个提示词、12 个看板、50 份简报、3 名用户和 25 个站点。年金额明确标为首年账单，并非永久年价。

summary.en: Standard $99/mo or $950 first year: 150 prompts/3 dashboards/2 briefs. Medium $179 or $1,719: 300/6/10. Large $299 or $2,868: 600/12/50; users and sites also scale.
summary.zh: Standard 月付 $99／首年 $950，含 150 提示词/3 看板/2 简报；Medium $179／$1,719，含 300/6/10；Large $299／$2,868，含 600/12/50；用户与站点也逐档增加。

description.en: A separate Starter plan is advertised at $49/month for one website, but the fetched pricing section does not enumerate its AI Visibility prompt, dashboard or brief quotas. Enterprise requires contacting sales. Additional AI Visibility dashboards cost $20 each and additional prompts cost $50 per 100 prompts.
description.zh: 另有 Starter 套餐宣传为每月 49 美元、1 个网站，但本轮读取的定价区段未列明其 AI Visibility 提示词、看板或简报额度。Enterprise 需联系销售。额外 AI Visibility 看板每个 20 美元，额外提示词每 100 个 50 美元。

summary.en: Starter is $49/month for one site, but its AI quotas were not published in the fetched section; Enterprise is sales-led. Add-ons: $20/dashboard and $50/100 prompts.
summary.zh: Starter 每月 $49、1 个站点，但读取区段未公布 AI 额度；Enterprise 联系销售；加购为每看板 $20、每 100 提示词 $50。

description.en: The free trial applies to Medium monthly only, requires a valid card and may create an up-to-$1 authorization that is voided. It converts to paid automatically and should be canceled at least 24 hours before the trial ends; the public help page does not state the trial duration. Upgrading the plan or buying add-ons during the trial ends it and starts paid billing.
description.zh: 免费试用仅适用于 Medium 月付，需要有效支付卡，可能产生最高 1 美元但会撤销的预授权。试用自动转为付费，应在结束前至少 24 小时取消；公开帮助页未说明试用时长。试用期间升级套餐或购买附加项会结束试用并开始付费计费。

summary.en: Trial: Medium monthly only, card required, possible voided $1 hold, auto-converts; cancel 24+ hours early. Duration is not published and upgrades end the trial.
summary.zh: 试用仅限 Medium 月付，需支付卡，可能撤销 $1 预授权并自动转付费；至少提前 24 小时取消；时长未公布，升级会结束试用。

description.en: Self-serve subscriptions renew monthly or annually according to the selected term. Cancellation is available at any time, prevents future renewal and retains access until the paid term ends. General Conditions state that cancellation does not produce a refund, and fees generally exclude applicable taxes.
description.zh: 自助订阅按所选周期每月或每年自动续费。可随时取消，取消阻止后续续费并保留至已付费周期结束。通用条款规定取消不产生退款，费用通常不含适用税费。

summary.en: Monthly or annual auto-renewal; cancel anytime for the end of the paid term. Cancellation is non-refundable and taxes are generally extra.
summary.zh: 按月或按年自动续费；可随时取消并保留至付费期结束；取消不退费，通常另计税费。

description.en: Do not infer Starter's AI quotas from Standard, Medium or Large: the public pricing section reviewed here does not enumerate them. The three higher plans also differ in users, tracked sites, prompt capacity, dashboards and monthly AI Content Briefs, so compare equivalent plan levels rather than the entry price alone.
description.zh: 不要用 Standard、Medium 或 Large 的 AI 额度推断 Starter：本轮查看的公开定价区段未列明这些数据。三个较高套餐在用户数、追踪站点、提示词容量、看板与每月 AI Content Brief 上也不同，应比较相同档位而非只看起步价。

summary.en: Starter AI quotas are unverified; prompt, dashboard, brief, site and user limits differ across the higher plans.
summary.zh: Starter 的 AI 额度未核实；较高套餐的提示词、看板、简报、站点和用户限制各不相同。

description.en: Citation reports describe answers to the prompts and schedule selected for the project. They are not a census of every AI answer or a guarantee of future citations, rankings, traffic or revenue.
description.zh: 引用报告描述项目所选提示词和安排下的回答，不是对所有 AI 回答的全量普查，也不保证未来引用、排名、流量或收入。

summary.en: Citation reports are limited to the selected prompts and schedule, not all AI answers or a future-performance guarantee.
summary.zh: 引用报告仅覆盖所选提示词与安排，不代表所有 AI 回答，也不保证未来表现。

description.en: The privacy policy does not specifically identify AI processors, prompt handling or a vendor-side commitment not to train on AI Visibility data. General Conditions prohibit the subscriber from using service data to train AI systems, but that is a restriction on the customer and is not evidence of Moz's own model-training policy.
description.zh: 隐私政策未具体列明 AI 处理商、提示词处理方式或 Moz 不训练 AI Visibility 数据的自身承诺。通用条款禁止订阅者使用服务数据训练 AI 系统，但这是对客户的限制，不能证明 Moz 自身的模型训练政策。

summary.en: AI processors, prompt handling and Moz's no-training position are unspecified; the no-training clause restricts customers only.
summary.zh: AI 处理商、提示词处理和 Moz 自身不训练立场未明确；不训练条款仅限制客户。

description.en: The legal operator is SEOmoz, Inc., a Delaware corporation at 360 Park Ave. S., 17th Floor, New York, NY 10010; Moz identifies itself as a Ziff Davis company. New York law applies, with US billing addresses subject to New York arbitration and class-action and jury waivers. The privacy policy discloses sharing with Ziff Davis companies and global processors, international transfers under DPF or SCC mechanisms, and account-data retention for the account's life plus a reasonable legally compliant period.
description.zh: 法律运营方为特拉华州公司 SEOmoz, Inc.，地址 360 Park Ave. S., 17th Floor, New York, NY 10010；Moz 自称为 Ziff Davis 旗下公司。适用纽约州法律，美国账单地址受纽约仲裁、集体诉讼与陪审团放弃条款约束。隐私政策披露与 Ziff Davis 公司及全球处理商共享、依 DPF 或 SCC 机制进行国际传输，账户数据保留至账户存续期加上合理合法期限。

summary.en: SEOmoz, Inc. is a Delaware company within Ziff Davis; New York law and US arbitration/waivers apply. Group sharing, international transfers and account-life retention are disclosed.
summary.zh: SEOmoz, Inc. 是 Ziff Davis 旗下特拉华州公司；适用纽约法律及美国仲裁/弃权条款；披露集团共享、国际传输和账户存续期留存。

description.en: Choose Moz Pro when citation investigation needs Domain Authority, Spam Score, linking-domain and linking-page context, filters and table exports. LLM Pulse is focused on cited domains, hosts and pages, brand mention detection and citation shares; compare prompt counting, engine coverage and dashboards because Moz charges responses per prompt-model runs while LLM Pulse counts a tracked prompt once across its included models.
description.zh: 需要结合 Domain Authority、Spam Score、链接域名与链接页面背景、筛选和表格导出来调查引用时选 Moz Pro。LLM Pulse 侧重被引域名、主机和页面、品牌提及检测与引用份额；应比较提示词计数、引擎覆盖和看板，因为 Moz 按提示词逐模型运行计费，而 LLM Pulse 对一个受追踪提示词在其所含模型间只计一次。

label.zh: Moz Pro AI 研究工作流
Moz AI Visibility 引用帮助

label.en: Moz Pro and AI Explorer General Conditions
label.zh: Moz Pro 与 AI Explorer 通用条款
LLM Pulse 引用来源文档（对比参考）
LLM Pulse 定价（对比参考）

description.en: A local-business AI visibility audit service that generates industry and location questions, checks brand mentions, competitor share and citations across AI platforms, and provides prioritized fixes.
description.zh: 面向本地企业的 AI 可见度审计服务，按行业与地区生成问题，跨 AI 平台检查品牌提及、竞品份额和引用，并提供按优先级排列的修复建议。

en: Audit a local business using its URL, industry and optional city to generate geographically relevant questions.
Measure brand mentions, competitor share, citations and remediation suggestions across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Mistral and You.com.
Use free, one-off or recurring audit options, with manual and scheduled audits on higher plans.
Set a custom competitor list, use AI accuracy and multi-region or product-line tracking on higher tiers.
Receive PDF reports, email alerts, article allowances, fix lists and white-label reporting on eligible plans.
Add eight-platform coverage, custom query volume, 300+ monthly audits, SLA and automated fixes with Enterprise.
zh: 使用企业网址、行业和可选城市审计本地企业，生成与地区相关的问题。
跨 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Claude、Gemini、Mistral 和 You.com 衡量品牌提及、竞品份额、引用与修复建议。
提供免费、一次性或定期审计选项，较高套餐支持手动和定时审计。
在较高档位设置自定义竞品名单，并使用 AI 准确性、多地区或产品线追踪。
在适用套餐获得 PDF 报告、邮件提醒、文章额度、修复清单和白标报告。
Enterprise 可增加八平台覆盖、自定义问题量、每月 300+ 次审计、SLA 和自动修复。

audience.en: Local businesses and agencies that want repeatable AI-answer audits for location-specific brand discovery and competitor visibility.
audience.zh: 希望对本地品牌发现和竞品可见度进行可重复 AI 回答审计的本地企业与代理商。

description.en: Generate local questions around a business, industry and optional city, then inspect where AI answers mention the brand, cite sources or recommend competitors.
description.zh: 围绕企业、行业和可选城市生成本地问题，再检查 AI 回答在何处提及品牌、引用来源或推荐竞品。

summary.en: Audit local AI recommendations for brand mentions, competitor share and citations.
summary.zh: 审计本地 AI 推荐中的品牌提及、竞品份额和引用。

description.en: Turn audit findings into a prioritized fix list and AI action plan, with higher plans adding alerting, scheduled measurements and article creation.
description.zh: 把审计结果转为按优先级排列的修复清单和 AI 行动计划，较高套餐另加提醒、定时测量和文章生成。

summary.en: Convert audit findings into prioritized fixes, with alerts, scheduling and articles on eligible plans.
summary.zh: 把审计发现转为优先修复项，适用套餐另含提醒、定时测量与文章。

description.en: Manage multiple client locations or brands through Agency and Enterprise plans, using shared audit pools, team access, white-label subdomains and custom queries.
description.zh: 通过 Agency 与 Enterprise 管理多个客户位置或品牌，使用共享审计额度池、团队访问、白标子域名和自定义问题。

summary.en: Manage multi-client audits with pooled quotas, team access, white-label reporting and custom queries.
summary.zh: 用共享额度池、团队访问、白标报告和自定义问题管理多客户审计。

description.en: Free is €0 with no card, one audit per 90 days, ChatGPT only, 20 queries, a visibility score and the top three issues; an email is requested to deliver the report. Starter is a €29 one-off purchase, not a subscription, with one audit on four platforms, 26 queries and 104 AI checks, competitor names, the full fix list, PDF and one article per audit.
description.zh: Free 为 0 欧元、无需支付卡，每 90 天一次审计，仅用 ChatGPT、20 个问题、可见度评分和前三个问题；报告通过邮箱交付。Starter 为一次性购买 29 欧元而非订阅，包含四平台一次审计、26 个问题和 104 次 AI 检查、竞品名称、完整修复清单、PDF 和每次审计一篇文章。

summary.en: Free: €0, one audit/90 days, ChatGPT, 20 queries, email report. Starter: €29 one-off, four platforms, 26 queries/104 checks, PDF, competitors and one article.
summary.zh: Free：€0、每 90 天一次、ChatGPT、20 问题、邮箱报告；Starter：一次性 €29、四平台、26 问题/104 检查、PDF、竞品与一篇文章。

description.en: Pro is €79/month, cancel anytime, with 10 audits per month, five platforms, 26 queries and 130 checks per audit, a custom competitor list, fix list, AI action plan, email alerts and four articles per month. Brand is €149/month for one brand with 50 manual and scheduled audits, six platforms and 156 checks per audit, AI accuracy audits, product-line and multi-region tracking, 10 saved competitors, 30 articles per month and fix files.
description.zh: Pro 为每月 79 欧元，可随时取消，含每月 10 次审计、五平台、每次审计 26 个问题和 130 次检查、自定义竞品名单、修复清单、AI 行动计划、邮件提醒和每月四篇文章。Brand 为单个品牌每月 149 欧元，含 50 次手动和定时审计、六平台和每次审计 156 次检查、AI 准确性审计、产品线与多地区追踪、10 个已保存竞品、每月 30 篇文章和修复文件。

summary.en: Pro €79/mo: 10 audits, five platforms, 26 queries/130 checks each, alerts, competitors, action plan and 4 articles. Brand €149: 50 audits, six platforms/156 checks, multi-region and 30 articles.
summary.zh: Pro €79/月：10 次审计、五平台、每次 26 问题/130 检查、提醒、竞品、行动计划与 4 篇文章；Brand €149：50 次审计、六平台/156 检查、多地区与 30 篇文章。

description.en: Brand Plus is presented as a +€100/month add-on that raises Brand to 80 audits per month and adds a custom domain, removal of 'Powered by VisibAI' and priority support; structured data lists Brand Plus at €249/month, consistent with €149 plus €100. Agency is €149/month for up to 25 clients with 50 audits per month shared across clients, six platforms and 156 checks, up to 20 custom queries, 10 competitors per client, a white-label subdomain, agency dashboard, 10 team members and 30 pooled articles. Agency Plus adds €100/month for 80 audits, custom domain, unbranded PDFs and priority support; structured data lists €249/month.
description.zh: Brand Plus 展示为每月加购 100 欧元，使 Brand 增至每月 80 次审计，并增加自定义域名、移除“Powered by VisibAI”和优先支持；结构化数据列出的 Brand Plus 为每月 249 欧元，与 149 加 100 一致。Agency 为每月 149 欧元，最多 25 个客户、客户间共享每月 50 次审计、六平台和 156 次检查、最多 20 个自定义问题、每客户 10 个竞品、白标子域名、代理商看板、10 名团队成员和共享的 30 篇文章额度。Agency Plus 每月加购 100 欧元，获得 80 次审计、自定义域名、无品牌 PDF 和优先支持；结构化数据列出 249 欧元。

summary.en: Agency €149/mo: up to 25 clients sharing 50 audits, six platforms, custom queries, white-label, 10 seats and 30 pooled articles. Brand/Agency Plus add €100/mo for 80 audits and extra white-label/support benefits; structured totals are €249.
summary.zh: Agency €149/月：最多 25 客户共享 50 次审计、六平台、自定义问题、白标、10 席位和共享 30 篇文章；Brand/Agency Plus 加 €100/月获 80 次审计及更多白标/支持权益，结构化总额为 €249。

description.en: Enterprise is custom-priced for eight platforms, 300+ audits per month by contract, custom queries, a dedicated SLA and automatic fixes. Annual plans are advertised as 'pay for 10 months, get 12,' but annual totals are not published and should not be calculated from that slogan. One-off audits are charged at purchase and monthly subscriptions are billed in advance; cancellation takes effect at the billing-period end. A seven-day refund policy applies to first-time purchases.
description.zh: Enterprise 为定制价格，按合同提供八平台、每月 300+ 次审计、自定义问题、专属 SLA 和自动修复。年付套餐宣传“付 10 个月得 12 个月”，但未公布年度总额，不应据此自行计算。一次性审计在购买时扣费，月订阅提前账单；取消在当前计费周期结束时生效。首次购买适用七天退款政策。

summary.en: Enterprise: custom eight-platform contract with 300+ audits/month. Annual billing advertises 10 months for 12 but publishes no totals; monthly plans bill in advance, cancellation is period-end, and first-time purchases have a 7-day refund window.
summary.zh: Enterprise 定制八平台合同，每月 300+ 次审计；年付宣传付 10 个月得 12 个月但无总额；月付提前账单、周期末取消，首次购买享 7 天退款窗口。

description.en: The score documentation describes a weighted average of appearance rate, mention quality, citation rate, position and cross-platform consistency without publishing numerical weights. A benchmark article instead says the score is currently 50% answer visibility and 50% technical readiness. The article uses 976 websites from February 22 to October 12, 2026, while the homepage says 800 websites across 28 industries, refreshed November 26. Treat the score as the vendor's proprietary metric, not a validated universal ranking.
description.zh: 评分文档称分数是出现率、提及质量、引用率、位置和跨平台一致性的加权平均，但未公布数值权重。基准文章则称当前分数为 50% 回答可见度加 50% 技术准备度。文章使用 2026 年 2 月 22 日至 10 月 12 日的 976 个网站，而首页称覆盖 28 个行业的 800 个网站、于 11 月 26 日刷新。应把该分数视为厂商专有指标，而非经过验证的通用排名。

summary.en: Official score definitions conflict: five unspecified-weighted factors versus 50/50 visibility/readiness; benchmark samples also differ (976 versus 800). It is not a universal ranking.
summary.zh: 官方评分口径冲突：五项未公布权重对比 50/50 可见度/准备度；基准样本也有 976 与 800 的差异；并非通用排名。

description.en: The homepage says Mistral uses model training memory while ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and You.com use live web retrieval. AI answers can vary between scans, and the reviewed documentation does not publish a repeat-sampling protocol or geographic controls. The industry benchmark is self-selected and only shows industries with at least 15 sites, so its percentages are not a representative population estimate.
description.zh: 首页称 Mistral 使用模型训练记忆，而 ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity、Gemini 和 You.com 使用实时网页检索。AI 回答可能随扫描变化，本轮查看的文档未公布重复抽样协议或地区控制。行业基准为自选样本，且只展示至少有 15 个网站的行业，因此其百分比不代表总体估计。

summary.en: Mistral uses training memory, answers vary, and repeat-sampling or geographic controls are unpublished; benchmarks are self-selected and industry-thresholded.
summary.zh: Mistral 使用训练记忆，回答会变化，重复抽样或地区控制未公布；基准为自选样本且有行业样本量门槛。

description.en: The homepage video says industry and location are auto-detected, while first-audit documentation says the user provides the industry and optionally a city. Confirm these inputs before comparing audits from different configurations. The terms describe informational reports, not a guarantee of visibility improvement; report resale requires an Agency plan.
description.zh: 首页视频称行业和地区自动识别，而首次审计文档称用户提供行业并可选择填写城市。比较不同配置的审计前应先确认这些输入。条款说明报告仅供信息参考，不保证可见度提升；转售报告需要 Agency 套餐。

summary.en: Input descriptions conflict: auto-detection versus user-entered industry and optional city; reports are informational and resale requires Agency.
summary.zh: 输入说明冲突：自动识别对比用户填写行业和可选城市；报告仅供参考，转售需 Agency。

description.en: Bianchi Web is operated by Francesco Bianchi as a sole trader registered in Prague, Czech Republic; Kelviq is Merchant of Record. Privacy documentation names AI and infrastructure providers and says business API terms do not allow provider training on submitted data. Account and audit history remain while the account is active, and deletion requests are handled within 30 days, but maximum retention for no-account emailed reports is not stated. Italian law and courts apply, with EU consumer ODR rights and liability limited to fees paid in the prior 30 days.
description.zh: Bianchi Web 由 Francesco Bianchi 作为个体经营者运营，注册于捷克布拉格；Kelviq 为商户记录方。隐私文件列出 AI 和基础设施处理商，并称商业 API 条款不允许处理商使用提交数据训练。账户和审计历史在账户存续期间保留，删除请求在 30 天内处理，但无账户邮箱报告的最长保留期未说明。适用意大利法律和法院，保留欧盟消费者 ODR 权利，责任限于前 30 天支付的费用。

summary.en: Prague sole trader Francesco Bianchi operates Bianchi Web; Kelviq bills. Provider no-training is described for business APIs. Anonymous-report retention is unstated; Italian law and a 30-day-fee liability cap apply.
summary.zh: Bianchi Web 由布拉格个体经营者 Francesco Bianchi 运营，Kelviq 收款；商业 API 有处理商不训练说明；匿名报告保留期未说明；适用意大利法律及前 30 天费用责任上限。

description.en: Choose VisibAI for free, one-off or recurring local-business audits with competitor lists and multi-platform fixes; Rank.ai is better suited to recurring daily city-specific questions. Rank.ai asks ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini through APIs with web search and separates Google Maps grid scans from AI answers. Its Starter is $49/month or $39/month billed yearly at $468, with five AI questions; Free has no ongoing AI questions. Sampling methods and scores are not universal rankings, so compare query design, platforms and audit frequency before switching.
description.zh: 需要免费、一次性或定期的本地企业审计，并包含竞品名单和多平台修复建议时选 VisibAI；更适合持续每日追踪城市特定问题时看 Rank.ai。Rank.ai 通过带网页搜索的 API 询问 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini，并把 Google Maps 网格扫描与 AI 回答分开。其 Starter 为每月 49 美元或按年账单 468 美元、折合每月 39 美元，含五个 AI 问题；Free 无持续 AI 问题。抽样方法和分数并非通用排名，切换前应比较问题设计、平台与审计频率。

label.zh: Rank.ai Local 产品（对比参考）

description.en: An AI visibility and crawler-log analytics service that combines repeated AI-answer sampling with read-only server or CDN log analysis and official crawler IP verification.
description.zh: AI 可见度与爬虫日志分析服务，把重复 AI 回答抽样与只读服务器或 CDN 日志分析、官方爬虫 IP 核验结合起来。

en: Analyze server or CDN crawler logs without changing site responses, including on the free plan.
Recognize 13 crawlers across eight vendors, verify claimed AI-crawler hits against vendor-published IP ranges and exclude unverified hits from metrics.
Separate live-retrieval crawlers from training crawlers and from human referral traffic.
Sample AI answers for mention rate, share of voice, prominence and citation frequency without blending them into one score.
Track weekly measurements, diagnostic families, rechecks, Search Console data and history within plan limits.
Configure Cloudflare, Vercel and Netlify log ingestion, or use answer measurements without connected logs.
zh: 分析服务器或 CDN 爬虫日志而不改变站点响应，免费套餐也包含该能力。
识别八家厂商的 13 种爬虫，依据厂商公布的 IP 段核验声称的 AI 爬虫命中，并将未核验命中排除在指标外。
把实时检索爬虫与训练爬虫、真人推荐流量区分开。
抽样 AI 回答的提及率、声音份额、显著度和引用频率，不合并成单一分数。
在套餐限制内追踪每周测量、诊断类别、复查、Search Console 数据和历史记录。
配置 Cloudflare、Vercel 和 Netlify 日志接入，或不连接日志只使用回答测量。

audience.en: Technical SEO, analytics and growth teams that need to distinguish verified AI crawler activity from sampled AI-answer visibility and human referrals.
audience.zh: 需要区分已核验 AI 爬虫活动、抽样 AI 回答可见度和真人推荐流量的技术 SEO、分析与增长团队。

description.en: Confirm which claimed AI crawler requests come from published vendor IP ranges, then review crawled pages and separate training crawlers from live-retrieval crawlers.
description.zh: 确认声称的 AI 爬虫请求中哪些来自厂商公布的 IP 段，再查看被抓取页面，并区分训练爬虫和实时检索爬虫。

summary.en: Verify AI crawler requests against vendor IP ranges and separate retrieval from training crawlers.
summary.zh: 依据厂商 IP 段核验 AI 爬虫请求，并区分检索与训练爬虫。

description.en: Monitor brand mentions, competitor share of voice, prominence and citations across repeated AI-answer samples, with weekly measurements on paid plans.
description.zh: 在重复 AI 回答样本中监测品牌提及、竞品声音份额、显著度和引用，付费套餐按周测量。

summary.en: Track brand and competitor answer visibility with weekly repeated sampling on paid plans.
summary.zh: 付费套餐通过每周重复抽样追踪品牌和竞品回答可见度。

description.en: Use rechecks to investigate meaningful changes in answer visibility, and read crawler-log counts alongside answer estimates without treating either as proof of human referral revenue.
description.zh: 使用复查调查回答可见度的显著变化，并把爬虫日志计数与回答估计并列阅读，而不把任一数据当作真人推荐收入的证明。

summary.en: Investigate answer changes with rechecks and compare log counts with estimates, not referral revenue proof.
summary.zh: 用复查调查回答变化，把日志计数与估计并列比较，但不视为推荐收入证明。

description.en: Crawl is free with no card and does not expire. It includes one answer measurement per domain ever, one snapshot each on Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, 10 prompts with one repetition, the top three access findings, no rechecks, 30 days of history, 100,000 crawler-log lines per month, one brand and two team members. Crawler-log ingestion recurs monthly even though the free answer measurement is one per domain ever.
description.zh: Crawl 免费、无需支付卡且不过期。包含每个域名一次回答测量，在 Google AI Overviews、Google AI Mode、ChatGPT、Gemini 和 Perplexity 各一次快照、10 个提示词和一次重复、前三个访问问题、无复查、30 天历史、每月 100,000 行爬虫日志、一个品牌和两名团队成员。虽然免费回答测量每个域名仅一次，但爬虫日志接入按月持续。

summary.en: Crawl: free, no card, 1 answer measurement/domain ever, 5-engine snapshot, 10 prompts, no rechecks, 30-day history, 100K log lines/month, 1 brand and 2 seats.
summary.zh: Crawl：免费、无需卡、每域名仅 1 次回答测量、五引擎快照、10 提示词、无复查、30 天历史、每月 10 万日志行、1 品牌和 2 席位。

description.en: Starter is $49 USD/month or $490/year with weekly measurements, 25 prompts and three repetitions, all diagnostic families, one recheck per month, 90 days of history, 500,000 log lines per month, one brand and five team members. Pro is $149/month or $1,490/year with weekly measurements, 100 prompts shared across up to three brands and three repetitions, all diagnostics, six rechecks per month, 13 months of history, 2 million log lines per month, Search Console, three brands and 15 team members. Taxes are added where applicable.
description.zh: Starter 为每月 49 美元或每年 490 美元，含每周测量、25 个提示词和三次重复、全部诊断类别、每月一次复查、90 天历史、每月 500,000 行日志、一个品牌和五名团队成员。Pro 为每月 149 美元或每年 1,490 美元，含每周测量、最多三个品牌共享的 100 个提示词和三次重复、全部诊断、每月六次复查、13 个月历史、每月 200 万行日志、Search Console、三个品牌和 15 名团队成员。适用税费另加。

summary.en: Starter $49/mo or $490/yr: 25 prompts, 1 recheck/mo, 500K log lines/mo. Pro $149/mo or $1,490/yr: 100 prompts across 3 brands, 6 rechecks/mo, 2M log lines/mo and Search Console; taxes extra.
summary.zh: Starter $49/月或 $490/年：25 提示词、每月 1 复查、每月 50 万日志行；Pro $149/月或 $1,490/年：3 品牌共享 100 提示词、每月 6 复查、每月 200 万日志行及 Search Console；税费另计。

description.en: Starter has a 14-day trial once per account and site, requires a card and converts automatically unless canceled. The separate Crawl plan does not require a card. Every plan limit is a hard stop; there is no usage-overage billing.
description.zh: Starter 提供每个账户和站点一次的 14 天试用，需要支付卡，未取消则自动续为付费。单独的 Crawl 套餐无需支付卡。所有套餐额度都是硬性上限，不按超量使用收费。

summary.en: Starter trial: 14 days, once per account/site, card required, auto-converts; free Crawl needs no card. All limits are hard stops with no overage billing.
summary.zh: Starter 试用 14 天、每账户/站点一次、需卡并自动转付费；免费 Crawl 无需卡；额度均为硬上限，无超量收费。

description.en: Paid plans renew automatically monthly or annually. Cancellation leaves access through the paid period and then moves the account to free. Fees are non-refundable except where law requires.
description.zh: 付费套餐按月或按年自动续费。取消后仍可使用至已付费期结束，随后账户转为免费。除法律要求外，费用不退款。

summary.en: Paid plans auto-renew monthly or yearly; cancellation keeps access to period end, then downgrades to free. Fees are non-refundable except as legally required.
summary.zh: 付费套餐按月或按年自动续费；取消后保留至周期末再转免费；除法律要求外不退款。

description.en: AI-answer results are repeated samples with uncertainty ranges, not exact counts. Paid plans use at least three repetitions per prompt; rechecks use nine or more repetitions per engine and require statistical significance after multiple-comparison correction plus at least a five-point movement. Provider or model changes are marked rather than credited to the customer.
description.zh: AI 回答结果是带不确定区间的重复样本，不是精确计数。付费套餐每个提示词至少重复三次；复查每个引擎使用至少九次重复，并要求经多重比较校正后具有统计显著性，且移动至少五点。服务商或模型变化会标注，而不归因于客户。

summary.en: Answers are sampled estimates: paid plans repeat 3+ times; rechecks use 9+ per engine and require corrected significance plus a 5-point move. Model changes are marked.
summary.zh: 回答为抽样估计：付费套餐重复至少 3 次；复查每引擎至少 9 次，需校正显著性和 5 点变化；模型变化会标注。

description.en: Answer sampling is US English without individual history or settings and uses a third-party data provider for ChatGPT and Gemini apps, Google result pages and Perplexity Sonar API. Results proxy a controlled sample, not any one person's experience. Crawler-log counts are exact records, but crawler activity alone does not prove human AI referrals, citations, rankings, traffic or revenue.
description.zh: 回答抽样使用无个人历史或设置的美国英语，并借助第三方数据提供商获取 ChatGPT、Gemini 应用、Google 结果页和 Perplexity Sonar API。结果是受控样本的代理，不代表任何个人的体验。爬虫日志计数是精确记录，但爬虫活动本身不能证明真人 AI 推荐、引用、排名、流量或收入。

summary.en: Sampling is US English through a third-party provider, not a person's answers. Log counts are exact records, but crawls do not prove referrals, citations, rankings or revenue.
summary.zh: 抽样为经第三方提供商进行的美国英语样本，不代表个人回答；日志计数精确，但爬取不能证明推荐、引用、排名或收入。

description.en: Claimed crawler hits are verified against vendor-published IP ranges refreshed every 24 hours; if refresh fails, the last known-good ranges remain. Verified hits count toward metrics and unverified hits are shown separately. Google-Extended and Applebot-Extended are robots.txt tokens, not crawlers; Google AI Overviews and AI Mode use Googlebot rather than a separate Google AI crawler.
description.zh: 声称的爬虫命中会对照每 24 小时刷新一次的厂商公布 IP 段核验；刷新失败时保留最后可用版本。已核验命中计入指标，未核验命中单独显示。Google-Extended 与 Applebot-Extended 是 robots.txt 令牌而非爬虫；Google AI Overviews 和 AI Mode 使用 Googlebot，而非单独的 Google AI 爬虫。

summary.en: IP ranges refresh daily and may fall back to the last good version; only verified hits count. Extended robots tokens are not crawlers, and Google AI uses Googlebot.
summary.zh: IP 段每日刷新，失败时沿用最后可用版本；仅已核验命中计数；Extended 令牌不是爬虫，Google AI 使用 Googlebot。

description.en: Lemon Tree Ventures, LLC operates Shruwd from Dover, Delaware; privacy requires business use and age 16+, while Terms require age 18+. DataForSEO collects AI answers and Anthropic may draft setup suggestions from homepage or Search Console data. Ordinary visitor log lines are discarded on receipt and requester IPs are not stored; raw AI answers remain 400 days, per-page crawler detail 90 days and daily crawler totals while the account is open. Workspace erasure can be requested within 30 days. Delaware law applies.
description.zh: Shruwd 由特拉华州多佛市的 Lemon Tree Ventures, LLC 运营；隐私政策要求商业使用且年满 16 岁，条款要求年满 18 岁。DataForSEO 收集 AI 回答，Anthropic 可能根据首页或 Search Console 数据起草设置建议。普通访客日志行在收到时丢弃，请求方 IP 不保存；原始 AI 回答保留 400 天、每页爬虫详情保留 90 天、每日爬虫汇总在账户存续期间保留。可在 30 天内请求删除工作区。适用特拉华州法律。

summary.en: Delaware LLC; privacy says business use/16+, Terms say 18+. Third parties process answers; raw answers stay 400 days, page crawler detail 90 days, daily totals while open. Erasure requests: 30 days.
summary.zh: 特拉华州 LLC；隐私称商业使用/16+，条款称 18+；第三方处理回答；原始回答保留 400 天、页面爬虫详情 90 天、每日汇总存续至账户关闭；删除请求 30 天。

description.en: Choose Shruwd when one workspace must combine repeated AI-answer measurements with exact, IP-verified crawler-log counts. Known Agents separately offers AI Chat Referral Tracking for human traffic from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other chat platforms, plus crawler reporting. Compare volume and retention: Shruwd's free plan includes 100,000 log lines per month but only one answer measurement per domain, while Known Agents' current monthly Free plan allows one project and 100,000 events, Startup $29 for three projects and 1 million events, and Growth $299 for ten projects and 10 million events. Never substitute crawler requests for measured human referrals.
description.zh: 需要同一工作区结合重复 AI 回答测量与精确、经 IP 核验的爬虫日志计数时选 Shruwd。Known Agents 则分别提供追踪来自 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等聊天平台的真人 AI 推荐流量，以及爬虫报告。应比较用量和保留规则：Shruwd 免费套餐含每月 100,000 行日志但每个域名仅一次回答测量；Known Agents 当前月付 Free 含一个项目和 100,000 事件，Startup 29 美元含三个项目和 100 万事件，Growth 299 美元含十个项目和 1,000 万事件。不要用爬虫请求替代实测真人推荐。

label.en: Known Agents AI Chat Referral Tracking (comparison reference)
label.zh: Known Agents AI 聊天推荐追踪（对比参考）
Known Agents 定价（对比参考）

description.en: Monitor brand visibility and recommendations in AI answers, identify cited sources and competitors, and use Sway's Lynx agent to write and test fixes. Starter tracks one brand across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity; paid plans start at $99 USD/month after a 7-day free trial, with API access and direct site delivery starting on higher tiers.
description.zh: 监测品牌在 AI 回答中的可见度与推荐，识别引用来源和竞品，并使用 Sway 的 Lynx 智能体编写和测试修复方案。Starter 可追踪一个品牌，覆盖 ChatGPT、Google AI Overviews、Google AI Mode、Claude、Gemini 和 Perplexity；付费套餐在 7 天免费试用后每月 99 美元起，API 访问和直接站点交付从更高套餐起提供。

audience.en: In-house marketing, SEO and growth teams that want answer-level visibility monitoring plus a guided remediation workflow for their own website.
audience.zh: 希望获得回答级可见度监测，并为其自有网站使用引导式修复流程的企业内部营销、SEO 和增长团队。

en: Daily checks of ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode; monthly checks of Claude, Gemini and Perplexity on every plan
Prompts derived from the customer's Google Search Console with brand-name searches excluded from the score
Question, answer, source and competitor views with brand presence, recommendation share and citation rate
Lynx agent writes prioritized fixes, which require user approval before changes are published
Before-and-after fix measurement compares 42 days before shipment with 7 days after and evaluates results at days 14, 28 and 49
Starter, Pro and Agency include six to 24 months of history, unlimited seats and MCP access
zh: 所有套餐每日检查 ChatGPT、Google AI Overviews 和 Google AI Mode，每月检查 Claude、Gemini 和 Perplexity
从客户 Google Search Console 提取提示词，品牌名搜索不计入得分
问题、回答、来源和竞品视图，展示品牌出现率、推荐份额和引用率
Lynx 智能体编写优先级修复方案，变更发布前需用户批准
修复前后测量对比发布前 42 天与发布后 7 天，并在第 14、28、49 天评估结果
Starter、Pro 和 Agency 提供 6 至 24 个月历史、无限席位和 MCP 访问

description.en: Run an initial visibility audit across six AI answer surfaces using non-branded prompts derived from Search Console, then review brand mentions, recommendations, cited pages and rivals in one question-level report.
description.zh: 使用从 Search Console 提取的非品牌提示词，在六个 AI 回答入口进行初始可见度审计，并在同一问题级报告中查看品牌提及、推荐、引用页面和竞品。

summary.en: Audit six AI answer surfaces with non-branded Search Console prompts and review mentions, recommendations, sources and rivals.
summary.zh: 使用 Search Console 非品牌提示词审计六个 AI 回答入口，并查看提及、推荐、来源和竞品。

description.en: Track answer visibility over time and compare brands or countries within a plan's quota, with daily sampling for ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode and monthly sampling for Claude, Gemini and Perplexity.
description.zh: 在套餐额度内持续追踪回答可见度并比较品牌或国家；ChatGPT、Google AI Overviews 和 Google AI Mode 每日抽样，Claude、Gemini 和 Perplexity 每月抽样。

summary.en: Track visibility over time across brands and countries, with daily sampling for three Google/ChatGPT surfaces and monthly sampling for three other engines.
summary.zh: 跨品牌和国家持续追踪可见度；三个 Google/ChatGPT 入口每日抽样，另外三个引擎每月抽样。

description.en: Have Lynx draft prioritized content or technical fixes, approve changes before publication, and use Sway's before-and-after measurements to judge whether a fix changed answer visibility.
description.zh: 让 Lynx 起草优先级内容或技术修复方案，在发布前批准变更，并使用 Sway 的前后对比测量判断修复是否改变了回答可见度。

summary.en: Draft and approve Lynx fixes, then measure whether the change affected AI answer visibility.
summary.zh: 起草并批准 Lynx 修复方案，再测量变更是否影响 AI 回答可见度。

description.en: Give agencies a client reporting workflow with white-label reports and pitch reports on Agency, while Starter and Pro provide standard reports for in-house or client analysis.
description.zh: Agency 通过白标报告和推介报告为代理商提供客户报告流程，Starter 和 Pro 则提供用于内部或客户分析的标准报告。

summary.en: Agency adds white-label and pitch reports for client work; Starter and Pro provide standard reporting.
summary.zh: Agency 增加白标和推介报告以支持客户工作；Starter 和 Pro 提供标准报告。

description.en: Starter costs $99 USD/month and includes one brand, 50 prompts checked daily, one country, six months of history, written and measured fixes, unlimited seats and MCP access. It does not include API access or direct delivery of fixes to the customer's site.
description.zh: Starter 每月 99 美元，包含一个品牌、每日检查 50 个提示词、一个国家、6 个月历史、编写和测量修复方案、无限席位和 MCP 访问；不包含 API 访问或把修复直接交付到客户站点。

summary.en: Starter: $99 USD/month for 1 brand, 50 daily prompts, 1 country, 6 months of history and measured fixes; no API or direct site delivery.
summary.zh: Starter：每月 99 美元，含 1 品牌、每日 50 提示词、1 国家、6 个月历史和修复测量；无 API 或直接站点交付。

description.en: Pro costs $249 USD/month with three brands, 150 prompts checked daily, up to three countries per brand, 12 months of history, fixes delivered to the site, sentiment by topic and API access. Agency costs $499 USD/month with ten brands, 350 prompts checked daily, any country, 24 months of history, white-label reports, pitch reports and everything in Pro.
description.zh: Pro 每月 249 美元，含三个品牌、每日检查 150 个提示词、每品牌最多三个国家、12 个月历史、修复交付到站点、按主题的情绪分析和 API 访问。Agency 每月 499 美元，含十个品牌、每日检查 350 个提示词、任意国家、24 个月历史、白标报告、推介报告以及 Pro 的全部功能。

summary.en: Pro: $249 USD/month, 3 brands, 150 daily prompts, up to 3 countries/brand, 12 months history, site delivery and API. Agency: $499/month, 10 brands, 350 daily prompts, 24 months history and white-label reports.
summary.zh: Pro：每月 249 美元，3 品牌、每日 150 提示词、每品牌最多 3 国家、12 个月历史、站点交付和 API；Agency：每月 499 美元，10 品牌、每日 350 提示词、24 个月历史及白标报告。

description.en: Sway offers a 7-day free trial without a card. Paddle is the merchant of record and handles cards, invoices and sales tax. The first payment is fully refundable within 14 days; monthly renewals are not refunded except where law requires or a service problem prevented use. Paid plans can be canceled at any time and access continues to the end of the paid period.
description.zh: Sway 提供无需支付卡的 7 天免费试用。Paddle 为登记商户，处理支付卡、发票和销售税。首次付款后 14 天内可全额退款；除法律要求或服务问题导致无法使用外，月度续费不退款。付费套餐可随时取消，访问权持续至已付费期结束。

summary.en: 7-day trial, no card. Paddle handles payment and tax; first payment refundable within 14 days. Monthly renewals are generally non-refundable, and cancellation keeps access to period end.
summary.zh: 7 天试用、无需卡；Paddle 处理支付和税费；首次付款 14 天内可退；月度续费原则上不退款，取消后保留至周期末。

description.en: All six AI engines are included, but sampling differs: ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode are checked daily, while Claude, Gemini and Perplexity are checked monthly. Claude, Gemini and Perplexity are asked through APIs with web search and no chat history; each prompt is asked from its country, but Gemini cannot set a country. Results represent a controlled sample rather than every user's answers.
description.zh: 六个 AI 引擎均包含在内，但抽样频率不同：ChatGPT、Google AI Overviews 和 Google AI Mode 每日检查，Claude、Gemini 和 Perplexity 每月检查。Claude、Gemini 和 Perplexity 通过启用网页搜索的 API 提问，且不使用聊天历史；每个提示词从对应国家提问，但 Gemini 无法设置国家。结果是受控样本，不代表所有用户的回答。

summary.en: Sampling is daily for ChatGPT/Google surfaces and monthly for Claude/Gemini/Perplexity; three engines use API web search without history, and results are controlled samples.
summary.zh: ChatGPT/Google 入口每日抽样，Claude/Gemini/Perplexity 每月抽样；后三者使用无历史的 API 网页搜索，结果为受控样本。

description.en: Prompts come from Search Console and brand-name searches are excluded from the score, so accounts with limited relevant Search Console data may get a narrow prompt set. Daily checks continue when monthly lookup limits are exhausted, but new lookups wait until the next month. Monthly lookup limits are 30 on Starter, 100 on Pro and 300 on Agency; brand-lookup limits are 1, 2 and 10 respectively.
description.zh: 提示词来自 Search Console，品牌名搜索不计入得分，因此相关搜索数据有限的账户可能获得较窄的提示词集合。月度查询额度用完后每日检查仍继续，但新查询要等到下个月。Starter、Pro 和 Agency 的每月查询额度分别为 30、100 和 300，品牌查询额度分别为 1、2 和 10。

summary.en: Prompts depend on Search Console and exclude brand-name searches. Lookups reset monthly: 30/100/300 total and 1/2/10 brand lookups across Starter/Pro/Agency.
summary.zh: 提示词依赖 Search Console 且排除品牌名搜索；Starter/Pro/Agency 每月总查询为 30/100/300，品牌查询为 1/2/10。

description.en: Plan limits are hard caps: Starter includes 100 tracked keywords and 500 site-audit pages, Pro includes 500 keywords and 1,000 pages, and Agency includes 1,000 keywords and 5,000 pages. API access starts on Pro, and direct WordPress or Elementor delivery is listed for Pro and Agency; Starter writes and measures fixes without publishing them to the site.
description.zh: 套餐额度为硬性上限：Starter 含 100 个追踪关键词和 500 个站点审计页面，Pro 含 500 个关键词和 1,000 个页面，Agency 含 1,000 个关键词和 5,000 个页面。API 从 Pro 起提供，Pro 和 Agency 列出 WordPress 或 Elementor 直接交付；Starter 编写和测量修复但不发布到站点。

summary.en: Hard caps: 100/500/1,000 tracked keywords and 500/1,000/5,000 audit pages. API starts on Pro; direct WordPress/Elementor delivery is Pro/Agency only.
summary.zh: 硬性上限：追踪关键词 100/500/1,000，审计页面 500/1,000/5,000；API 从 Pro 起，WordPress/Elementor 直接交付仅 Pro/Agency。

description.en: Fix measurement needs enough answers on both sides of a change. Sway compares 42 days before shipment with 7 days after, judges results at 14, 28 and 49 days, and labels a comparison with fewer than eight answers on either side as too early to tell. The measurement is evidence of change in the sampled answers, not a guarantee of ranking or recommendation.
description.zh: 修复效果测量需要变更前后都有足够回答。Sway 对比发布前 42 天与发布后 7 天，并在第 14、28、49 天判断结果；任一侧少于八个回答时标记为“尚无法判断”。该测量证明抽样回答中的变化，不保证排名或推荐。

summary.en: Fix tests compare 42 days before with 7 days after and need at least 8 answers per side; they measure sampled change, not guaranteed rankings or recommendations.
summary.zh: 修复测试对比前 42 天与后 7 天，每侧至少需 8 个回答；衡量的是抽样变化，不保证排名或推荐。

description.en: Sway is operated by Roei Shoustak, trading as Sway, in Tel Aviv, Israel. The terms require users to be 18 or older, authorize access to connected accounts and include a class-action waiver; the privacy policy says personal data may be processed in the United States and other countries.
description.zh: Sway 由以色列特拉维夫的 Roei Shoustak 以 Sway 商号运营。条款要求用户年满 18 岁、授权访问已连接账户，并包含集体诉讼弃权；隐私政策称个人数据可能在美国及其他国家处理。

summary.en: Israeli sole trader; users must be 18+, authorize connected-account access and accept a class-action waiver. Personal data may be processed in the US and elsewhere.
summary.zh: 以色列个体经营者；用户须年满 18 岁、授权连接账户并接受集体诉讼弃权；个人数据可能在美国等地处理。

description.en: Choose Sway when the main job is monitoring brand visibility across multiple AI answer surfaces and moving from findings to approved fixes with before-and-after measurement. Compare the plan's prompt, country and history quotas and the daily-versus-monthly sampling cadence; teams that only need a one-time audit or crawler-log analytics should check whether those workflows are covered elsewhere.
description.zh: 主要需求是跨多个 AI 回答入口监测品牌可见度，并从发现推进到经批准的修复及前后效果测量时，可选 Sway。应比较套餐的提示词、国家和历史额度，以及每日与每月抽样频率；只需要一次性审计或爬虫日志分析的团队，应确认其他工具是否更合适。

description.en: Audit whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Mode and Google AI Overviews recommend a local business, see which rivals they recommend instead, and review the exact questions, answers, sources and Google Maps context. RecoRadar has a free plan with one audit per month; paid plans start at $19 USD/month for one business or $49/month for agencies with 30 monthly audits and weekly tracking for five businesses.
description.zh: 审计 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Google AI Mode 和 Google AI Overviews 是否推荐某家本地企业，查看它们转而推荐哪些竞品，并检查具体问题、回答、来源和 Google Maps 背景。RecoRadar 免费套餐每月提供一次审计；付费套餐单个企业每月 19 美元起，代理商套餐每月 49 美元，含 30 次月度审计和五个企业的每周追踪。

audience.en: Local businesses, marketing agencies and SEO consultants that need repeatable AI recommendation audits, competitor context and client-ready local visibility reports.
audience.zh: 需要可重复的 AI 推荐审计、竞品背景和可直接交付客户的本地可见度报告的本地企业、营销代理商与 SEO 顾问。

en: Six city-specific customer questions per business, with the business name excluded from the questions
Reports show whether each AI recommends the business, the exact answer and sources, rival recommendations and Google Maps position
ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini use official APIs with web search; Google AI Mode and AI Overviews use DataForSEO and are labeled as such
Weekly tracking emails changes in recommendation counts, a new report link and a fresh pitch
Starter and Agency add cited-directory pages, AI-agent site checks, prospect lists, market scans and follow-up tests
Agency adds white-label reports, custom questions and daily checks for tracked businesses
zh: 每家企业使用六个包含城市名的客户问题，问题中不包含企业名称
报告展示各 AI 是否推荐该企业、具体回答和来源、竞品推荐以及 Google Maps 位置
ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini 使用启用网页搜索的官方 API；Google AI Mode 和 AI Overviews 使用 DataForSEO 并明确标注
每周追踪通过邮件发送推荐数量变化、新报告链接和新的推介文案
Starter 和 Agency 增加被引用目录页面、AI 智能体站点检查、潜在客户名单、市场扫描和后续测试
Agency 增加白标报告、自定义问题和已追踪企业的每日检查

description.en: Run a local visibility audit for one business to see whether five AI surfaces recommend it, which competitors appear instead, and which pages and directories are cited for city-specific customer questions.
description.zh: 为单家企业运行本地可见度审计，查看五个 AI 入口是否推荐它、出现的是哪些竞品，以及针对城市客户问题引用了哪些页面和目录。

summary.en: Audit one local business across five AI surfaces and see rival recommendations, cited pages and city-specific answers.
summary.zh: 在五个 AI 入口审计单家本地企业，查看竞品推荐、引用页面和城市相关回答。

description.en: Use Google Maps position, ratings and reviews for the top three rivals alongside AI recommendations to understand the local competitive context behind a visibility result.
description.zh: 将 Google Maps 位置、前三竞品的评分和评论与 AI 推荐并列使用，以理解可见度结果背后的本地竞争背景。

summary.en: Read AI recommendations beside Google Maps position and the ratings and reviews of the top three rivals.
summary.zh: 将 AI 推荐与 Google Maps 位置及前三竞品的评分和评论并列阅读。

description.en: Send prospects or clients a branded report with every question, answer and source, a paste-ready pitch and a non-expiring link; Starter and Agency add PDF download and custom branding, while Agency removes RecoRadar branding.
description.zh: 向潜在客户或客户发送包含全部问题、回答和来源、可直接粘贴的推介文案及不过期链接的品牌报告；Starter 和 Agency 增加 PDF 下载和自定义品牌，Agency 移除 RecoRadar 品牌。

summary.en: Share client-ready reports with all answers and sources; paid tiers add PDF and branding, and Agency removes RecoRadar branding.
summary.zh: 分享含全部回答和来源的客户报告；付费套餐增加 PDF 和品牌定制，Agency 移除 RecoRadar 品牌。

description.en: Track local clients week to week without spending plan audits, then use Starter or Agency follow-up tests, cited-page change tracking and market scans to investigate why recommendations changed.
description.zh: 每周持续追踪本地客户而不消耗套餐审计额度，再使用 Starter 或 Agency 的后续测试、被引用页面变化追踪和市场扫描调查推荐为何变化。

summary.en: Track clients weekly without using audits, then investigate recommendation changes with follow-up tests, page-change tracking and market scans.
summary.zh: 每周追踪客户而不消耗审计，再通过后续测试、页面变化追踪和市场扫描调查推荐变化。

description.en: Free costs $0 with no card and includes one audit per month, ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, the full report with RecoRadar branding, every question, answer and source, a paste-ready pitch, report-open notifications and report links that do not expire.
description.zh: Free 为 0 美元且无需支付卡，包含每月一次审计、ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini、带 RecoRadar 品牌的完整报告、全部问题、回答和来源、可直接粘贴的推介文案、报告打开通知和不过期的报告链接。

summary.en: Free: $0, no card, 1 audit/month on ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini, full branded report, pitch and non-expiring report links.
summary.zh: Free：0 美元、无需卡、每月 1 次审计，覆盖 ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini，含完整品牌报告、推介文案和不过期链接。

description.en: Owner costs $19 USD/month for one business, checked every week, with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Mode and Google AI Overviews, the full report and a PDF copy.
description.zh: Owner 每月 19 美元，适用于一家企业，每周检查，覆盖 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Google AI Mode 和 Google AI Overviews，提供完整报告和 PDF 副本。

summary.en: Owner: $19 USD/month for 1 business, checked weekly across all five AI surfaces, with a full report and PDF.
summary.zh: Owner：每月 19 美元，1 家企业每周检查，覆盖全部五个 AI 入口，含完整报告和 PDF。

description.en: Starter costs $49 USD/month with 30 audits per month, all five AI surfaces, weekly tracking for five businesses without using audits, custom logo, color and booking link with a Powered by RecoRadar line, PDF download, 25 lead-form checks per day, CSV prospect lists up to 50 rows, market scans up to 100 businesses, cited-page change tracking, follow-up tests, cited-directory pages, AI-agent site checks and questions about up to two neighborhoods.
description.zh: Starter 每月 49 美元，含 30 次月度审计、全部五个 AI 入口、五个企业的不消耗审计的每周追踪、带 Powered by RecoRadar 字样的自定义标志、颜色和预约链接、PDF 下载、每天 25 次线索表单检查、最多 50 行的 CSV 潜在客户名单、最多 100 家企业的市场扫描、被引用页面变化追踪、后续测试、被引用目录页面、AI 智能体站点检查，以及最多两个社区的问题。

summary.en: Starter: $49 USD/month, 30 audits, all five AI surfaces, weekly tracking for 5 businesses, custom branding, PDF, lead form, market scans and follow-up tests.
summary.zh: Starter：每月 49 美元，30 次审计、五个 AI 入口、5 家企业每周追踪、自定义品牌、PDF、线索表单、市场扫描和后续测试。

description.en: Agency costs $149 USD/month with 100 audits per month, all five AI surfaces, weekly tracking for 20 businesses without using audits, no RecoRadar branding, PDF download, the core Starter prospecting and diagnostic features, custom questions for up to 20 per business and daily checks that use audits on six days of the week.
description.zh: Agency 每月 149 美元，含 100 次月度审计、全部五个 AI 入口、20 家企业的不消耗审计的每周追踪、无 RecoRadar 品牌、PDF 下载、Starter 的核心潜在客户与诊断功能、每家企业最多 20 个自定义问题，以及每周六天消耗审计的每日检查。

summary.en: Agency: $149 USD/month, 100 audits, all five AI surfaces, weekly tracking for 20 businesses, no RecoRadar branding, custom questions and daily checks.
summary.zh: Agency：每月 149 美元，100 次审计、五个 AI 入口、20 家企业每周追踪、无 RecoRadar 品牌、自定义问题和每日检查。

description.en: Top Pick is an optional $19 USD/month add-on for Starter and Agency that asks ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini to choose a single business. Polar is the merchant of record and handles cards, invoices and sales tax. At verification, the site advertised temporary promotions: 20% off for 12 months for the first 20 agencies and 50% off the first payment with code BLACKFRIDAY from November 27 to December 1, 2026; these are promotions rather than standard plan prices.
description.zh: Top Pick 是 Starter 和 Agency 的可选附加项，每月 19 美元，会让 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini 选择单一企业。Polar 为登记商户，处理支付卡、发票和销售税。核验时网站显示临时优惠：前 20 家代理商可享 12 个月八折，2026 年 11 月 27 日至 12 月 1 日使用 BLACKFRIDAY 代码可享首次付款五折；这些是促销，不是标准套餐价格。

summary.en: Top Pick adds $19 USD/month. Polar handles payment and tax. Temporary offers observed: 20% off for 12 months for the first 20 agencies and 50% off first payment Nov 27–Dec 1, 2026 with BLACKFRIDAY.
summary.zh: Top Pick 附加项每月 19 美元；Polar 处理支付和税费；观察到临时优惠：前 20 家代理商 12 个月八折，2026-11-27 至 12-01 用 BLACKFRIDAY 享首次付款五折。

description.en: Paid plans renew automatically and can be canceled from the billing page, with access continuing until the end of the paid period. Unused audits do not roll over, no extra credits can be purchased and failed audits are returned. The first payment is refundable in full within 14 days once per customer; renewals, upgrades and partial months are not refunded, and accepting a refund ends the paid plan immediately.
description.zh: 付费套餐自动续费，可在账单页面取消，访问权持续至已付费期结束。未使用审计不结转，不能购买额外额度，失败的审计会返还。每位客户首次付款后 14 天内可获全额退款一次；续费、升级和不足一个月的费用不退款，接受退款后付费套餐立即结束。

summary.en: Paid plans auto-renew; cancel anytime with access to period end. Audits do not roll over. First payment refundable within 14 days once; renewals and partial months are not refunded.
summary.zh: 付费套餐自动续费，可随时取消并保留至周期末；审计不结转；首次付款 14 天内可退一次，续费和不足月费用不退。

description.en: Google AI Mode and Google AI Overviews are included only on Owner, Starter and Agency. Google has no official API for these surfaces, so RecoRadar uses DataForSEO and Google Search to collect them; every report discloses that source. The free plan covers only ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.
description.zh: Google AI Mode 和 Google AI Overviews 仅包含在 Owner、Starter 和 Agency 中。Google 没有面向这些入口的官方 API，因此 RecoRadar 使用 DataForSEO 和 Google Search 收集，且每份报告都会注明该来源。免费套餐仅覆盖 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini。

summary.en: Google AI Mode and AI Overviews require a paid plan and come from DataForSEO/Google Search because no official Google API exists; Free covers only ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.
summary.zh: Google AI Mode 和 AI Overviews 需付费套餐，并通过 DataForSEO/Google Search 获取，因为 Google 无官方 API；Free 仅覆盖 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini。

description.en: One audit means one business, six customer questions on three AI surfaces and 18 answers; Starter and Agency add the two Google AI surfaces for up to 30 answers. Asking every question twice uses two audits, running a business again counts as a new audit, and weekly tracking does not consume audits. Unused audits reset at the next billing period.
description.zh: 一次审计指一家企业、六个客户问题、三个 AI 入口和 18 个回答；Starter 和 Agency 增加两个 Google AI 入口，最多 30 个回答。每个问题问两次会消耗两次审计，再次运行同一企业算新审计，每周追踪不消耗审计。未使用审计在下一计费周期重置。

summary.en: An audit is 1 business, 6 questions and 18 answers, or up to 30 on Starter/Agency. Repeats and reruns consume audits; weekly tracking does not; unused audits reset monthly.
summary.zh: 一次审计为 1 企业、6 问题、18 回答，Starter/Agency 最多 30；重复和重跑消耗审计，每周追踪不消耗，未用审计按月重置。

description.en: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini answers are collected through official APIs with web search and no chat history, not from an individual customer's app. Location is approximate, model and timestamp are shown, and answers can vary; RecoRadar says a one- or two-count difference between audits is normal variation, while three or more is worth investigating.
description.zh: ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini 回答通过启用网页搜索且无聊天历史的官方 API 收集，不来自某个客户的应用。位置为近似值，报告显示模型和时间戳，回答可能变化；RecoRadar 称两次审计相差一两次属正常波动，三次及以上值得调查。

summary.en: API samples use web search without personal history and approximate location; answers vary. A 1–2 count difference is normal variation, while 3+ warrants investigation.
summary.zh: API 样本使用无个人历史的网页搜索和近似位置，回答会波动；相差 1–2 次属正常，3 次及以上值得调查。

description.en: Weekly tracking is limited to five businesses on Starter and 20 on Agency. Agency daily checks beyond the included weekly check use plan audits on six days of the week. The Top Pick add-on costs extra, follow-up tests use one additional audit, and custom questions above ten per business use two audits on Agency.
description.zh: 每周追踪在 Starter 上最多五个企业，在 Agency 上最多 20 个。Agency 除包含的每周检查外，每日检查会在每周六天消耗套餐审计。Top Pick 附加项需额外付费，后续测试额外消耗一次审计，Agency 每家企业超过十个自定义问题时使用两次审计。

summary.en: Weekly tracking covers 5 businesses on Starter and 20 on Agency; Agency daily checks use audits 6 days/week. Top Pick costs extra, and some follow-up/custom-question tests consume extra audits.
summary.zh: Starter/Agency 每周追踪分别为 5/20 家企业；Agency 每日检查每周 6 天消耗审计；Top Pick 额外收费，部分后续测试和自定义问题消耗额外审计。

description.en: Reports are shared by non-expiring links that remain available to anyone with the URL until deleted. The privacy policy describes approximate location, device and report-open tracking, plus third-party processors for AI answers, payments, email and analytics. RecoRadar is operated by Valerius vl. Omerovic Denis in Mostar, Bosnia and Herzegovina.
description.zh: 报告通过不过期的链接分享，任何拿到 URL 的人在删除前都可查看。隐私政策描述了近似位置、设备和报告打开追踪，以及用于 AI 回答、支付、邮件和分析的第三方处理方。RecoRadar 由波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那莫斯塔尔的 Valerius vl. Omerovic Denis 运营。

summary.en: Non-expiring report links are accessible to anyone with the URL until deleted. Privacy covers approximate location, device/open tracking and third-party processors; operator is in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
summary.zh: 不过期报告链接在删除前任何持有 URL 者均可查看；隐私涉及近似位置、设备/打开追踪和第三方处理方；运营方位于波黑。

description.en: Choose RecoRadar when the primary need is local-business AI recommendation audits for prospects or clients, including rival recommendations, Google Maps context and repeat tracking. Compare audit quotas, the five-business Starter tracking limit and the DataForSEO dependency for Google AI surfaces; teams needing broad multi-brand monitoring or technical crawler-log analysis should check whether those workflows are covered elsewhere.
description.zh: 主要需求是针对潜在客户或客户进行本地企业 AI 推荐审计，并需要竞品推荐、Google Maps 背景和重复追踪时，可选 RecoRadar。应比较审计额度、Starter 五个企业的追踪上限，以及 Google AI 入口对 DataForSEO 的依赖；需要广泛多品牌监测或技术爬虫日志分析的团队，应确认其他工具是否更合适。
